articleTitle: Leveraging Transfer Learning-based Fine-tuned ResNet50 Model for Maize Leaf Disease Classification
abstract: The anticipation of corn leaf disease is crucial in precision agriculture, facilitating prompt actions to protect crop output and quality. This study utilizes a pre-trained ResNet50 deep-learning model as a predictor for maize leaf disease classification. This model has been implemented on an extensive dataset comprising images of both healthy and diseased maize leaves collected from Kaggle. The proposed ResNet50 architecture has been implemented for multiclass classification containing the corn blight, corn common rust, corn grey spot and healthy class. Along with the multiclass classification, the binary class classification results have been also analyzed for corn blight vs corn common rust, corn blight vs corn grey spot, and corn common rust vs corn grey spot. The accuracy results have been shown at different numbers of epochs for multiclass classification as 94.70%, 95.02%, 94.80%, 95.49%, and 96.40% at epochs 10, 15, 20, 25, and 30. Further, the accuracy of corn blight vs corn common rust, corn blight vs corn grey spot, and corn common rust vs corn grey spot have been also identified as 91.10%,98.30%, and 98.70%, respectively. The proposed model has shown remarkable performance for both multi and binary classification. The performance can further be enhanced by performing data augmentation for increasing the number of images in the dataset.

articleTitle: Accurate Neoplasm Diagnosis with Comprehensive Machine Learning and Deep Learning Approaches

authors.preferredName: Samavedam V S S Srinivasa Kumar

abstract: Machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) technologies break in the new line of medical diagnostics that offer tremendous benefits in term of accuracy, efficiency and predicting the outcome of disease, specifically neoplasm detection and classification. In this work, a thorough study of various deep learning and machine learning techniques is presented, including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), Decision Trees, Support Vector Machines (SVMs) as well as other ones, that are applied to the diagnostic task of neoplastic diseases. By means of number of experiments and comparison studies, we do research work to evaluate the extend of these computational methods to change the etiopathogenesis of the disease. The time of diagnosis can be significantly reduced due to the dictation of diagnosis and the detection and classification of the disease become more precise. The integration of ML and DL technologies within clinical settings may not only enhance the diagnostic capabilities but also drive the development of customized treatment plans suitable to a patient's specific characteristics of their disease pathology. Also, our study report on the adaptability of the systems in which they can constantly update their diagnostic performance by taking a new stock of data.

articleTitle: Weed Plant Detection in Agricultural Field Using Deep Learning Integrated with IOT
abstract: The Weed Plant Detection in Agricultural Field Images explores the application of Deep Learning (DL) methods in the field of agriculture, specifically focusing on weed detection and classification. These tasks are crucial for weed management. Achieving higher crop yields. Identifying weeds within crops presents challenges due to their appearance. The paper examines data collection, dataset preparation, DL algorithms for weed identification, and evaluation metrics. It highlights the use of learning techniques that involve pre-trained models. The introduction of an approach utilizing the VGG16 Algorithm is discussed, which combines learning with advanced image processing to enable real-time weed identification. This approach aims to minimize yield loss and reduce herbicide usage. It also emphasizes that this technology is scalable and adaptable to crops while integrating into autonomous farming equipment, promoting sustainable agriculture.

articleTitle: Detecting Cyber Threats in Real-Time: A Supervised Learning Perspective on the CTU-13 Dataset
abstract: This Paper uses the CTU-13 dataset, a large and varied database containing network traffic events, to investigate the use of machine learning(ML) methods for the detection of cyberattacks. The goal is to create reliable intrusion detection models that can precisely locate and categorise instances of both benign and malevolent behaviour in network data. With the use of well-known techniques including Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), Adaptive Gradient Boosting (AdaBoost), Logistic Regression(LR) and Naive Bayes(NB), the paper attempts to evaluate these models' effectiveness in the environment of cyber threat detection. Accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score are among the evaluation measures that offer a thorough grasp of the models' efficacy. This study provides insights into the advantages and disadvantages of each algorithm by methodical testing, ad-justing parameters, and cross-validation. It also provides helpful suggestions for choosing the best infrastructure for improving security using machine learning-based threat detection. The results are intended to guide the creation of flexible and potent defence systems against changing cyber threats in actual network environments. According to the data, With an accuracy rate of 96%, the XGBoost model outperforms the other models (NB, LR and AdaBoost) with accuracy rates of 78%, 85%, and 90%, respectively.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Models for Age and Gender Prediction using Facial Images
abstract: In recent years, there have been notable developments in facial recognition technology, with deep learning models being crucial in enhancing accuracy and dependability. Age and gender prediction, also known as demographic prediction, is an area of study that uses various computational algorithms to estimate the age and gender of persons based on diverse data sources. In this research, an approach to deep learning to accurately identify the age group and gender of face imagery and investigation focuses on the efficacy of two cutting-edge deep learning models, ResNet152V2 for gender prediction and VGG16 for age prediction, when it comes to estimating age and gender from facial photos. After being trained on a sizable collection of face photos, the models together attained remarkable accuracy rates. the integration of the two models' predictions to produce a single model that predicts gender and age at the same time. The overall accuracy of 89.84% is attained by this combined model, indicating the ability of deep learning algorithms to reliably predict demographic data from facial photos.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence-Based ResNet50, Xception, and VGG16 Models for an Efficient Detection of Lung Cancer
abstract: Lung cancer is a fatal disease that frequently occurs, thus effective and accurate methods for detection are essential to ensure early intervention. In this research, we employed deep learning architectures ResNet50, Xception and VGG16 to analyze their effectiveness in the lung cancer images classification. Each model was trained and tested on a large dataset where each model performed very accurately. ResNet50 reached an accuracy of up to 90.33% during epoch Upgrade. We also studied precision, recall and F1-score metrics to evaluate the performance of these models in distinguishing between cancerous and noncancer cases. 0.978 precision, 0.982 recall and a percentage accuracy of about 98.86% has been resulted by VGG16 model. The best results were obtained from the VGG16 model among all other models with these figures mentioned above such as These results put emphasis on the usefulness of deep learning models like VGG16, as they provide a good foundation for developing more effective diagnostic tools in medical imagery. This card reveals the use of advanced computational techniques that allow for better results in diagnosis and treatment of lung cancer.

articleTitle: Massive MIMO Hybrid Beamforming
abstract: With the increasing demand for high speed and reliable wireless communication, hybrid beamforming techniques have gained significant attention. This project presents an innovative approach to enhance signal transmission efficiency by combining massive MIMO technology with symbol precoding. The objective is to form beams that can be shared by multiple users, allowing simultaneous data transmission while minimizing interference. The beams formed by adjusting phase and amplitude of the signals sent from multiple antennas, are simultaneously transmitted to the intended users. At the user devices, signal detection and decoding processes are performed to recover the transmitted information by combining the received signals based on the beamforming vectors. This ensures maximum signal strength and interference cancellation.

articleTitle: Utilizing Machine Learning and employing the XGBoost Classification Technique for evaluating the likelihood of Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD)
abstract: In this study, the XGBoost classification method, a machine learning algorithm investigated, is employed to assess the probability of an individual developing autism spectrum disorder (ASD). The study use a dataset that encompasses a wide range of elements and practical training, such as behavioural characteristics, demographic data, and clinical markers linked to Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD). The XGBoost method, known for its simplicity and effectiveness in classification tasks, is employed to analyze patterns in the dataset and make predictions related to the likelihood of autism. The research starts with the first stage of data preparation, which access the processes of feature selection and normalisation. These steps are undertaken to optimise the performance of the model. Following this, a thorough assessment of the XGBoost method is undertaken, taking into account various hyperparameter configurations and evaluating its efficacy in properly categorising and accessing people into Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) and non-ASD groups. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the algorithm in identifying subtle patterns within the dataset, so enhancing our comprehensive comprehension of the elements that influence the risk of autism. The implications of the research extend beyond diagnostic applications, as the model's proven accuracy can assist clinicians and researchers in early identification and intervention for individuals at risk of Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD). This research adds significant value to ongoing efforts focused on enhancing the precision and efficacy of autism risk assessments through the incorporation of machine learning methods. Ultimately, this research aims to provide timely and targeted therapies, leading to enhanced results.

articleTitle: Regularized Dense Layered LeNet towards Mushroom Type Classification
abstract: Among the edible varieties of fungi, mushrooms possess the strongest nutrients found in the plant. Nevertheless, because of their great demand for food and significant benefits to medical research, it is imperative to identify the different varieties of mushrooms within the current species. The deep learning technology has recently rendering the CNN models towards classification of various object in interdisciplinary fields. This paper proposes Regularized Dense Layered LeNet (RDL-LeNet) that categorizes the mushroom types with high accuracy. The Mushrooms Classification Dataset, which includes 3150 mushroom pictures was used for this execution. The Mushrooms Classification dataset was fitted with the existing CNN models to select the best CNN model. To determine the most efficient CNN framework, the Mushrooms Classification dataset was fitted using the available CNN models. When compared to the other CNN model, the LeNet performs better, with an accuracy rate of 90.67%. LeNet has now been chosen to adjust the quantity of dense layers. LeNet typically consist of three convolutions, two pooling layers, and two dense layers. In order to suggest the recommended framework RDL-LeN et, the LeNet is now changed by adding an additional dense layer that is made up of a single block of batch normalization, relu optimization, and drop out at the end that further compresses the output into vector size of 84. The RDL-LeNet is made up of three convolutional layers, two pooling layers, and three dense layers. The third dense layer consists of a single block that is made up of batch normalization, relu optimization, and dropout, ultimately leading to the final output layer. The suggested RDL-LeNet and the current CNN have been implemented with the Mushroom Classification Dataset. The experiment demonstrates that the suggested RDL-LeNet model works better in the categorization of mushroom types, with a high accuracy of 98.68%.

articleTitle: ECG-Based Sleep Apnea Detection Using Convolutional and Long Short-Term Memory Networks
abstract: Sleep apnea, which is one of the most common sleep disorders that can lead to undesirable health outcomes if not treated and requires PSG as a standard diagnostic test for the diagnosis. Among the physiological parameters monitored by PSG during sleep are brain activity eye movement muscle activities heart rate and airflow. All of this makes it possible to identify apnea periods in sleep, which is a key symptom for sleep apnea diagnosis. Although PSG is acknowledged as a gold standard, there are other research interests in non-invasive diagnostic tools. One of such methods focuses on the possible role a single-signal ECG may play in sleep apnea diagnosis. One of the most important tools for measuring heart activity is ECG, giving useful information on what happens in a human being's heart. The suggested method is the segmentation of ECG signals and then feature extraction from them. This means that we might even be able to find sleep apnea markers without the intense long-term PSG monitoring. Lastly, the accuracy of our model at testing phase was determined to be 86.18% that suggests it an easy-to-use and effective diagnostic tool for sleep apnea cases.

articleTitle: MRI Based Brain Tumor classification Using a Fine-Tuned EfficientNetB3 Transfer Learning Model
abstract: In this paper, the formidable task of classifying brain tumors in MRI imaging was addressed by employing an extensive compilation of brain tumor images. We showed that precisely adjusting a cutting-edge efficientNetB3 model using transfer learning considerably enhanced its performance in classifying brain cancers. the experimentation employs a hybrid dataset from the Kaggle, which is a combination of two different datasets (Kaggle brain-tumor-classification-mri and Kaggle brain-tumor). The proposed fine-tuned efficientNetB3 transfer learning model showed promising results by classifying multi-class brain tumors with a testing accuracy of 98.13%.

articleTitle: Classification of Banana Plant Leaves Based on Nutrient Deficiency Using Vision Transformer
abstract: Banana is one of major fruit crop consumed in India and its production is merely impacted over the year by many factors where malnutrition is one of the key causes which impact banana plants growth and production of banana. Identification of particular type of malnutrition in early stage avoids the diseases and lower the impact of that particular malnutrition on the plant. Traditional monitoring of plants requires intensive time and relies on humans to judge the type of malnutrition suffered a plant, whereas computer vision techniques currently using in similar tasks such as diseases detection, computer vision also performs well on the discussed task which discloses in this study here we proposes a vision transformers-based solution to classify the leaves based on the particular type of malnutrition it has. Vision transformer models have low inductive biases which makes them not to focus on local regions but also consider global patterns in image which makes to produce better results over images taken from real world crop fields. Due to which classification task able to classify with accuracy of 90 percentage on the benchmark dataset which is taken from Maland university of India in Karnataka, which includes 7000 plus images of banana plant leaves when leaves are under deficiency of 8 unique nutrition.

articleTitle: An Ensemble Approach of CNN and GRU Models for Network and Server Intrusion
abstract: This research paper delves into the realm of cybersecurity by proposing an innovative ensemble model that blends Gated Recurrent Units (GRU) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) for network and server intrusion detection. CNNs excel in spatial feature extraction, particularly suited for analyzing network traffic patterns, while GRUs are adept at capturing temporal dependencies within sequential data. The integration of these models aims to leverage their complementary strengths, enhancing the overall robustness of intrusion detection systems. Through comprehensive training and evaluation on diverse datasets, the ensemble model showcases promising results, demonstrating improved accuracy and resilience against adversarial attacks compared to standalone CNN and GRU models. In addition to making a significant contribution to the rapidly developing field of deep learning in cybersecurity, this research offers practical implications for the development of more secure network and server environments in the face of dynamic cyber threats.

articleTitle: Analysis of Fraud Detection in Online Transactions Using Computational Models
abstract: Financial fraud is becoming a more serious menace to the financial industry. One important tool for identifying credit card fraud in online payments is data mining. There are two primary reasons why credit card fraud, a data mining issue, becomes challenging to identify: First of all, the characteristics of typical conduct and fraud are ever-evolving. Second, credit card data sets are highly corrupted, to start with. Theft or misuse of your credit card information for personal use without your knowledge or agreement is known as credit card fraud. User behavior in previous transactions must be verified to detect these frauds. It can be classified as a fraud or a legitimate transaction when comparing its usage pattern with that of existing transactions. The variables chosen, the data set measurement strategy, and the detection techniques employed all have a major impact on the capacity to identify fraud in credit card purchases. It seems that information extraction has become the main task in detecting online payment fraud. For highly distorted credit card fraud data, this article uses K-Nearest Neighbor and Logistic Regression techniques.

articleTitle: An Automatic Fine-Tuned InceptionV3 Model for Groundnut Leaf Disease Multiclass Classification
abstract: There are various diseases which attack the groundnut crops resulting in the worst quality of nut production. To create an automatic method for spotting them early, in the proposed work, a deep learning-based InceptionV3 model has been developed. This will help stop big yield losses due to the disease's effect on the crop. This study looks at using the InceptionV3 convolutional neural network (CNN) for detecting diseases in groundnut leaves. It compares how well Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) and Adam optimizers do the prediction at different numbers of epochs. The study uses a large collection of data that includes five diseased and healthy classes of groundnut leaves. This model shows excellent findings for groundnut leaf disease detection, which gets 97.30% accuracy with SGD and 96.56% correct prediction using an Adam optimizer. In this work, the results have been depicted with varying numbers of epochs. The proposed InceptionV3 is a popular deep-learning design for feature extraction, that helps the model spot small patterns and shows different types of diseases. This study shows the outcomes in terms of metrics such as accuracy, recall, precision, and F1 score. It helps to better understand how well an Inception V3model works for different disease types classification. The results show that when the Inception V3model is implemented with SGD, it performs well for groundnut leaf disease categorization. The results show its potential to be used for real-world tasks related to agriculture where the optimal classification is the matter of concern. Lastly, the results show that Inception V3is good for finding diseases in groundnut leaves on the basis of various parameters. The work also shows, how important it is to choose a correct optimizer method for a particular problem statement. The accuracy rates of 97.30% with SGD and 96.56% with Adam show how good the model is for real use in farms, it can also help farmers in classifying the diseases early on so they can manage them better without the production loss.

articleTitle: Diabetes Prediction using Support Vector Machine
abstract: Diabetes affects people worldwide, in both developed and developing nations, and is a serious health concern. The Worldwide Diabetes Federation reports that 285 million people globally are living with diabetes at this time, and in the next 20 years, that figure is predicted to rise to 380 million. Scientists are working on a very efficient, low-cost way to identify diabetes, which is vital to treat at an early stage. Data mining techniques for accurately predicting diabetes are often tested against the machine learning lab at UCI's Pima Indian diabetes database. In this research, a classifier for diabetes detection using support vector machine (SVM) machine learning technique is proposed. The primary objective is to effectively categorize diabetes from complex medical data. The outcomes of the trial suggest that Support Vector Machine has potential for accurate diabetes diagnosis.

Author Keywords: MODY (Maturity Onset Diabetes of the Young)

articleTitle: Secure eKYC: Blockchain Integration with Facial Recognition and FASNet-Based Anti-Spoofing Mechanism
abstract: The banking sector, a cornerstone of our society, witnesses a staggering volume of digital transactions annually, with approximately 8,804 crore transactions valued at 3,021 lakh crore Rupees [1] occurring in India. Given this significance, financial institutions, particularly banks, play a crucial role and are among the most frequently utilized institutions. Know Your Customer (KY C) processes within banks are integral for storing, verifying, and validating user details. However, the landscape is evolving with electronic KY C (eKY C). Addressing the need for a third-party KYC system, our project proposes a decen-tralized blockchain-based solution, ensuring tamper-proof data storage akin to legacy KY C systems. In response to biometric vulnerabilities, especially face recognition, our project integrates a Liveness Attack Detection (LAD) approach, contributing to the evolution of KYC processes by combining blockchain-based KYC with advanced biometric security measures for secure identity validation in financial transactions.

articleTitle: Optimizing IoT Capabilities: Leveraging FPGA for Superior Performance, Efficiency and Security
abstract: Nowadays IoT (Internet of Things) is used everywhere, like homes, industry, automation, health sector, hospitality, smart cities, farming, tourism, self-driving cars etc. IoT is implemented successfully on many available hardware devices such as Microcontrollers, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, ASIC (Application-Specific Integrated Chip), FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array) etc. Out of all these hardware platforms, FPGA is found to be more energy-efficient and the least power-consumable device. The use of FPGA with IoT is more reliable and effective in terms of power and energy saving. In this work, the integration of different technologies using IoT and FPGA is represented in the comparison table. The number of research works and publications on IoT using different hardware devices have been shown from year 2015 to 2023.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning-based EfficientNetB0 Smoker Surveillance System for Enhancing Public Safety
abstract: Smoking is one of the risk factors associated with health conditions. The increase in smoking leads to various health issues such as lung cancer, oral cancer, respiratory problems, heart diseases and many more. Smoking doesn't only affect smokers but also the people in their surroundings. There are various places where, smoking is banned such as health institutes, hospitals, petrol pumps etc. However, due to limited resources of smoke identification in these places, people keep using various smoking materials such as cigarettes, and vaping. In a recent study, it has been analyzed that smoking can be one of the ignition sources in the petrol pump which can result in the complete burning of the pump and the entire damage to human health as well to the environment. The infammable vapors from petrol burning can cause many health issues to animals and human bodies resulting explosive atmosphere. In the proposed work, an EfficientNetB0 model is applied for the smoker and non-smoker classification, which can be applied to the places which require the monitoring of the smoke. This model has been fine-tuned with epoch values set to 5 and 10, learning rate values set to 0.001, and batch sizes set to 8 and 16. The model has been implemented with a balanced dataset of 1120 images, where the data resizing to 224X224 has been performed. Further, the outcomes have been analyzed in accuracy and loss, where the highest accuracy has been achieved as 92.78<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> and the lowest loss of 0.1655 has been resulted. The proposed model can further be used in various other applications such as airlines, railway stations etc. which is the cost-effective and optimal solution to the problems caused by smoking habits.

articleTitle: Ranking of Institutes Using MCDM SAW Method Under Uncertainty
abstract: The combination of the Multiple Criteria Decision-Making (MCDM) with the Simple Additive Weighting (SAW) method is designed under uncertainty which gives the pioneering approach for the ranking of educational institutes. This paper tries to overcome the inherent challenges associated with the evaluation of institutes. In doing so, it has integrated fuzzy logic or other uncertainty modeling approaches with SAW. Real-world data from institutes that represent diverse categories based on many criteria such as academic performance, faculty quality, infrastructure, and student satisfaction were used for validation. This brings out the effectiveness of the MCDM SAW method under uncertainty, and thus it gives the final ranking, where the Institute 5 scores the top position (Si = 2.473), then Institutes 3 (Si = 2.41), 1 (Si = 2.101), 2 (Si = 1.963), and 4 (Si = 1.51). This will assist in developing an informed decision-making process within the educational sector and provide stakeholders with a reliable tool for optimization in the quality assessments of the institutes.

articleTitle: Navigating Public Opinion: Enhancing Sentiment Analysis on Social Media with CNN and SVM
abstract: Social networking sites have become essential forums for sharing thoughts, feelings, and criticism on a range of subjects. Sentiment analysis from user-generated information is essential for comprehending consumer behavior, market trends, and public opinion. In order to improve sentiment analysis across social media platforms, we provide a novel method in this research that integrates convolutional neural networks with support vector machines (SVM). First, we do trend analysis on a dataset of Twitter comments labeled favorable, adverse, and neutral to determine popular themes and attitudes. This trend analysis offers insightful information on how public opinion changes over time. Using CNNs, the suggested approach extracts relevant characteristics from the written information, identifying global as well as local patterns in the tweets. We can efficiently learn representations that capture the historical context and semantics associated with tweets by leveraging CNN's hierarchical structure. The SVM classifier further improves the sentiment forecasts based on the retrieved representations by using these learned features. Our model can perform robust sentiment analysis across a wide range of themes and linguistic styles found in social media data since it combines CNNs and SVMs. The Twitter dataset's experimental findings show how well our method works to reliably classify the sentiments that users convey in their remarks. Our CNN-SVM hybrid model performs better than other sentiment analysis techniques, attaining higher accuracy, precision, and recall scores. Furthermore, adding trend analysis to the sentiment analysis process improves its interpretability and provides deeper insights into the public's evolving attitudes and trending issues over social media platforms. All things considered, our suggested methodology offers a viable framework for analyzing sentiment across social networking sites, providing accuracy and interpretability by fusing CNN and SVM approaches with trend analysis. This study bears important implications for utilization in market studies, brand management, and public perception management in the digital era, as well as for the progress of sentiment analysis methodologies.

articleTitle: Performance of High-Gain Quasi-Resonant SEPIC Converter fed by PV with Fuzzy Logic Controller
abstract: Increasing environmental issues such as global warming is caused by the use of petroleum products. Alternative to petro products are sustainable sources photovoltaic (PV), wind energy etc., in modern electrical energy systems. The supply for electrical demand often have low dc output voltages by these sources, hence voltage matching is required. An economical choice for voltage matching is a standard boost converter, but has a disadvantage that the voltage at the converter output can be boosted up to two times the converter input. To get higher voltage, the sepic converter duty cycle is wide-ranging to attain high voltage, but with a significant semiconductor device conduction loss. Further, the switching devices and diodes are made resilient for higher output voltage; regardless, using such high-rating devices results in increased dissipations and overall expense. To overcome this drawback, a quasi-resonant sepic dc/dc converter with high gain is connected to PV source. The dc/dc converter produce an optimal dc voltage for electric vehicle charging applications. The converter is controlled by PI controller and the results are compared to fuzzy logic control (FLC) system.

articleTitle: Implementation on Traffic Light Controller Using ARTIX-7 FPGA Board
abstract: There are serious power outages in several development countries right now. Using the Vivado development environment and the Artix-7 FPGA board, this article explores the design and construction of a traffic light controller. This chip has a total power consumption of 1.436W. With a thermal margin of 56.8 degrees Celsius and hardware utilization percentages of 0.05% for LUT, 0.05% for FF, 4.29% for IO, and 3.13% for BUFG, it boasts a low power consumption of 0.399 watts per chip. The Artix-7 boasts superior DSP capabilities, a large company-provided support and environment, and lightning-fast connectivity.

articleTitle: Anemia Detection And Severity Prediction Using Classification Algorithms With Optimized Hyperparameters, Boosting Techniques And XAI
abstract: Anemia is a blood disorder where there's a shortage of blood cells or haemoglobin. If not detected or treated promptly it can pose health risks. Detecting anemia accurately and, on time is crucial for managing and preventing complications. In this study we analyzed a sample of 364 individuals to explore how different classification algorithms perform in detecting anemia and predicting its severity. We considered Logistic regression, K-Neighbours-Classifier (KNN) Support-Vector-Machine (SVM), decision-tree and Random-forest algorithms. We fine-tuned the hyperparameters using grid and random search validation techniques to optimize their performance. Additionally, we used boosting techniques like AdaBoost, Gradient Boosting, CatBoost and XGBoost to improve accuracy. To understand the model's predictions better we employed Local Interpretable Model Explanations (LIME) and SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations). Among the models evaluated the random forest model's with optimized hyperparameters showed the best accuracy, in detecting anemia followed by CatBoost. In the severity prediction again random-forest turned out to give the most accurate results. This research emphasizes the significance of using classification algorithms and interpretability techniques to achieve detection of anemia and predict its severity.

articleTitle: A Fine-tuned Deep Learning-based VGG16 Model for Cotton Leaf Disease Classification
abstract: This research paper explored the innovative utilization of deep learning algorithms for cotton leaf disease classification, the VGG16 model fine-tuned being the most powerful tool in diagnosing bacterial blight, curl virus, fusarium wilt, and distinguishing these from healthy leaf states. Typically, traditional disease detection methods are prone to human error and are labor-intensive, which makes this paper propose an alternative that uses CNN that is automatic, accurate, and scalable. The VGG16 model that was initially developed for massive image recognition tasks was later fine-tuned to fit the cotton leaf disease classification task and take advantage of a large dataset annotated with leaf images with high resolution. These images which are diverse sets of symptoms as well as other environmental conditions used, processed, and then augmented to help the model in training effectively. The findings of the research emphasize the transformative capability of applying deep learning technology for the identification and management of diseases in agriculture. The study has provided a diagnostic scalable, efficient, and accurate tool that contributes to the advancement of sustainable agriculture by enabling targeted, more effective disease management strategies. The fact that the fine-tuned VGG16 model has been proved successful in our research sets a new direction for the following studies concerning the use of other CNN architectures and the combination of these technologies with existing digital agriculture systems. This development guarantees a giant leap in the agricultural field and also offers a plausible solution to the challenge of plant diseases that impact crop yields and agricultural production.

articleTitle: Cascaded Approach for Image Segmentation and Classification for Skin Cancer Detection
abstract: With advancements in medical sciences, the detection and classification of skin cancer in patients is a field where extensive efforts are been put in by researchers to improve real-time solutions. It is a state where the growth of skin cells goes out of control. Since cancer evolves with respect to time, hence, to classify the type of skin cancer we need to segment the image properly before classification, which can lead to more reliable results in the detection of the type of cancer that has occurred. In this paper, we have proposed a cascaded approach to detect the type of skin cancer where instead of directly feeding an input as an input for classification, we first input the original image to U-net for segmentation and derive the granular details from it. Followed by which, the segmented image is fed and forwarded to CNNs through which the classification of the cancer is performed. We have implemented and compared the performances of MobileNet, DenseNet121, and ResNet50 in the classification of skin cancer disease.

articleTitle: Real-Time Facial Expression Recognition Using Convolutional Neural Networks for Adaptive User Interfaces
abstract: Facial expression recognition plays a crucial role in enabling natural and intuitive human-computer interaction. However, existing approaches often struggle with robustness and accuracy, particularly in unconstrained environments with varying illumination, occlusions, and pose variations. This research proposes a novel real-time facial expression recognition system based on convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to address these challenges. The proposed system leverages state-of-the-art deep learning architectures and techniques to accurately recognize a wide range of facial expressions in real-time. Through extensive data preprocessing, augmentation, and a carefully designed CNN architecture, the system aims to achieve high accuracy and generalization capabilities across diverse scenarios. The recognized facial expressions are then utilized to enable adaptive user interfaces that can dynamically adapt to the user's emotional state, enhancing the overall user experience. Comprehensive experiments and user studies are conducted to evaluate the system's performance, robustness, and effectiveness in improving human-computer interaction. The proposed approach has the potential to significantly impact various domains, including gaming, healthcare, education, and beyond, by enabling emotion-aware computing and personalized interfaces.

articleTitle: Enhancing Security in HIL-based Augmented Industrial Control Systems: Insights from Dataset Analysis and Model Development
abstract: This Paper offers a comprehensive investigation into the enhancement of safety in HIL-based ICS-augmented industrial control systems via the use of data analysis and mode creation to accomplish this. The state-of-the-art security behavior mode for industrial control systems that are based on HIL technology is being investigated using a variety of artificial intelligence algorithms, with recall serving as a performance indicator. The implementation of comparative performance assessments is the first step into unexplored areas for these algorithmic techniques; let's get started! In this part, we take a comprehensive look into the outcomes that occur when Random Forest Logistic Regression KNN approaches are evaluated. When it comes to recall, in addition to various conceivable algorithms that may be used between them. Our findings indicate that the method with the best performance in terms of recall is logistic regression. This is the strategy that we discovered to be the most effective. This demonstrates that it is capable of accurately identifying significant occurrences within the collection. In addition to providing valuable insights regarding the implementation of machine learning approaches to enhance the safety of HIL-based Augmented ICS, the results of this study serve as a foundation for future advancements in this very important field of research.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Automatic Bus Fare Collection System Using RFID Technology
abstract: The “Bus Fare” system is introducing innovatively inclusive solution for the seamless and effective collection process fares in the public transportation domain. By leveraging Radio-Frequency Identification (RFID) technology, passengers can conveniently gain access through RFID authentication. The fare charges are primarily determined depending on the specific chosen drop-off station; subsequently, upon disembarking, the appropriate amount gets automatically deducted from the passenger's designated account. This remarkable transaction is visually displayed on an LCD screen, alongside with the auditory confirmation through a buzzer! The supporting system is meticulously powered by a battery and meticulously regulated by a voltage regulator, ensuring acontinued smooth operation. By harmonizing this comprehensive integration of advance technologies, the “Bus Fare Collection” system promises to significantly refine and energize the fare collection process. Thus, enhancing not just the efficiency but as well as the convenience for both the passengers and transit operators simultaneously! Implementing such advanced technologies assures a progressive shift towards a more seamless and reliable transportation system - a future we eagerly await!

articleTitle: MobileNetV3 for Mango Leaf Disease Detection:An efficient Deep Learning Approach for Precision Agriculture
abstract: India, renowned for its vast agricultural landscape, especially in mango cultivation, faces substantial challenges with leaf diseases that significantly affect mango yield and quality. These issues pose economic challenges for the agricultural sector. The task of accurately diagnosing these diseases is complex and time-intensive. Addressing this, our study leverages advanced machine learning techniques and high-processing computational resources. We utilize the publicly available MangoLeafBD(MBD) dataset, which contains 4000 high-resolution images of mango leaves, sourced from diverse orchards in Bangladesh using mobile phone cameras. This dataset, with its meticulously edited images, is crucial for effectively training machine learning models. Using the MobileNetV3(MV3) architecture, known for its enhanced accuracy and efficiency, we have developed a mobile application for real-time mango leaf disease diagnosis. This application, integrating Android's Camerax API, facilitates immediate, on-site disease detection. The retraining of MV3 on the MBD dataset has achieved an impressive accuracy of 98%, demonstrating its potential in agricultural technology. This advancement not only contributes significantly to plant pathology but also offers a practical solution for farmers, enhancing disease management and promoting sustainable agricultural practices.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of High-Speed, Low-Power CMOS D Flip-Flop and Counters using Double Gate FinFET Technology
abstract: As Semiconductor technology advances, there is a growing demand for energy-efficient digital circuits in various applications, including portable devices and data centers. FinFET (Fin Field Effect Transistor) technology has emerged as a promising solution to meet these demands. FinFET technology, a leading innovation in the semiconductor industry, is known for its capability to deliver exceptional performance and energy efficiency. This paper provides an overview of the designing and simulation of counter using 10nm FinFET technology in LT -spice, a popular electronic circuit simulation tool. Conventional CMOS technology faces challenges related to short-channel effects as technology scales down, resulting in performance degradation. Power consumption and noise are reduced by 57.13%, 46.02% when counter are designed, implemented with FinFET based D-Flip Flop. Incontrast, FinFETs offer superior resistance to short-channel effects and have emerged as a promising solution for advancing technology scaling. Finally, the results obtained from the proposed Jhonson Counter, asynchronous counters using FINFET are better when compared to Static CMOS Logic.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Detection by Prototypical Networks using Few Shot Learning
abstract: The presented study attempts to use a meta-learning paradigm, based on the Breast Ultrasound Image (BUSI) dataset. With the Protonet convolutional neural network architecture and a novel augmentation methodology, the main objective is to accurately classify breast ultrasonography images into benign, malignant, and normal categories. The utilization of few-shot learning in the meta-learning framework guarantees flexibility and generalization, especially in situations with the scarcity of annotated medical image datasets. Our experimental findings demonstrate the strong effectiveness of the meta-learning strategy by revealing notable improvements in classification performance on the BUSI dataset. Images are processed efficiently using multithreading. This highlights the model's robust generalization to unknown data, securing its potential for significant applications in the identification of breast cancer. Notably, when the number of labeled examples are k = 5, 10, 15 the test accuracies achieved are 85.75%, 91.28%, 91.67%. This model outperforms other CNN models in terms of efficiency.

articleTitle: Construction and Practical Research of Big Data Industry-University-Research Integration Platform for Digital Talents of Financial Professionals
abstract: The financial industry has shown a rapid digital trend in recent years, mainly manifested in the following aspects. First of all, the development of Internet technology has led to the rise of many online financial platforms, which not only changed the traditional way of financial services, but also greatly improved the efficiency of financial business processing. Secondly, the application of advanced technologies such as big data and artificial intelligence has made significant progress in risk management, customer profiling, and investment decision-making in the financial industry. Finally, the introduction of digital technology has also promoted cross-border integration and innovation in the financial industry, promoting the upgrading and development of the entire industry.

articleTitle: Tabu Search Algorithm: Optimizing the Search Runtime
abstract: In the realm of combinatorial optimization, the Tabu Search algorithm has proven to be a powerful tool for solving complex problems. However, its practical implementation often encounters computational challenges, particularly in managing the frequently accessed” tabu list.” In this paper, authors introduced the Drop-set data structure, a novel approach designed to streamline the management of the tabu list within the Tabu Search algorithm. The Drop-set data structure enables the efficient addition and removal of elements from the tabu list in constant time, alleviating the computational burden associated with traditional data structures. Through experimental evaluation conducted on the well-known knapsack problem, authors demonstrated the performance enhancements achieved by integrating the Drop-set data structure into the Tabu Search algorithm. Results indicate promising reductions in computational time, thereby propelling the algorithm's convergence speed and improving solution quality. This research not only presents a practical solution to enhance Tabu Search but also establishes a foundation for the development of future optimization algorithms that can benefit from the integration of the Drop-set data structure.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based VGGNet, GoogleNet, and DenseNet121 Models for Cervical Cancer Prediction
abstract: Cervical cancer is still a serious health issue in the world and underscores the importance of developing accurate, effective diagnostic tools. This research investigates cervical cancer detection by using the three latest deep learning models, DenseNet121, VGGNet and Google Net. The evaluation refers to the analysis of accuracy of models under various learning rates as 0.01 and 0.001, VGGNet model was found to be superior with an accuracy of 98.93%. Compared to the above figures, DenseNet121 and GoogleNet achieved accuracies of 93.21% and 93.67%, respectively. This result highlights VGGNet's better ability to provide accurate cervical cancer detection under this learning rate. When an adjustment was made as regards to the value of learning rate by setting it at 0.001, on the other hand, DenseNet121 and VGGNet exhibited accuracies of 93.27% and 89.99% respectively, whereas GoogleNet resulted it as 97.33%. These results imply that the choice of learning rate greatly impacts deep learning models' performance in cervical cancer detection. The VGGNet model outperformed with a higher learning rate while GoogleNet demonstrated its strength compared to lower rates. Study shows that it is possible to optimize deep learning models for cervical cancer detection thus improving diagnostic accuracy and ultimately, patients' outcomes.

articleTitle: Detection of Real Time Malicious Intrusions Using GAN (Generative Adversarial Networks) in Cyber Physical System
abstract: The project understands that computer viruses, malware, and aggressive strikes on computer networks are a constant danger. This shows how important breach detection is as a proactive defense technology. Deep learning is used to detect and correct cyber security gaps and breaches in IoT-driven cyber-physical systems to improve security. The goal of the project is to make intruder detection better than what current systems can do by focusing on things like accuracy, efficiency, and lowering false positives. This draws attention to the progress and new ideas in defense. A generative adversarial network, a cutting-edge deep learning technique, is used by the method to reach the project's goals. It also stands out by comparing uncontrolled and deep learning-based methods to discrimination, showing a complete and effective way to handle privacy. In our project, we successfully used an ensemble method to improve the accuracy of our predictions by combining several separate models. It's worth mentioning that it has a mixed design that combines CNN and LSTM, which stands for Congressional Neural Networks and Long Short-Term Memory. When applied to the KDD-Cup dataset, this hybrid model got an amazing accuracy of 99%. This shows that our ensemble method works well for finding intrusions in IoT-based defense systems.

articleTitle: Enhancing Solar PV System with High-Gain DC/DC Converters
abstract: High-gain DCDC converters are notable for their ability to step up or down the voltage with little losses. The use of Solar PV systems with the converters enhances the efficiency of the overall system. These converters are designed efficiently to boost/buck the voltage output of PV arrays depending upon the load connected to it, thereby increasing overall energy yield. The study investigates the benefits of using high-gain DC-DC converters, such as increased energy conversion efficiency and the capacity to maximize power production even in changing solar circumstances, using a combination of theoretical analysis and real-world experience. In this system, our objective is to replace the DC-DC converter which has high efficiency and try to increase voltage gain at the output.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection Method of New Energy Vehicle Battery Based on Isolated Forest Algorithm
abstract: The battery anomaly detection is critical in new energy vehicle batteries, however it has an issue with erroneous performance positioning. The typical Decision tree algorithm is unable to address the anomaly detected issue in new energy vehicle batteries, and the result is insufficient. As a result, a Isolated forest algorithm-based anomaly detection method of new energy vehicle battery is provided, and the anomaly detection method of new energy vehicle battery is assessed. To begin, the outlier detection theory is used to discover the influencing elements, and the indicators are split based on the battery anomaly detection's needs to decrease interference factors in the battery anomaly detection. The outlier detection theory is then used to create a Isolated forest algorithm battery anomaly detection scheme, and the outcomes of the battery anomaly detection are thoroughly examined. The MATLAB simulation results reveal that, under particular evaluation conditions, the Isolated forest algorithm outperforms the standard Decision tree algorithm in terms of battery anomaly detection accuracy and time of influencing variables.

articleTitle: Computer Network Privacy Security Technology Based on Cloud Computing
abstract: In the face of information security trends, key technical challenges, and scenarios, many higher education institutions began to reflect on data security and privacy protection, and actively took various response measures. Considering that in practice, due to the influence of information asymmetry, experience, social relations, and other factors, it is difficult to estimate the utility of privacy protection for users, this paper adopts pre communication data encryption and end-to-end verification technology based on cloud computing to verify the privacy security of network sessions. When analyzing the impact of different degrees of privacy protection on enterprise competitive strategies, to simplify the deployment difficulty of cloud computing, this paper uses the average value of two enterprise privacy protection utilities to represent the expected utility that users think privacy protection can bring to network security. Research shows that intensive network privacy security is aware that open data needs to ensure data integrity, otherwise it will lose reproducibility. Modern scientific research is open and super collaborative. 35% of the private security cost in computer network privacy security technology can play the purpose of network security protection in more than 60% of the Internet data sets in the current table network. In particular, the remote cooperation of two or more institutions increases the risk of malicious tampering of data, the prevalence of false information in the international community, and has become a powerful network security scheme to compete for influence and rights through social media.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis of VGG16 and ResNet50 Models in Sign Language Recognition
abstract: Sign language recognition is an essential aspect of facilitating effective communication between the deaf community and the rest of the population. The paper describes a method for addressing the problem of sign language misinterpretation by utilizing machine learning models. We proposed a convolutional neural network (CNN) - based sign language recognition system using pre-trained models such as VGG16 and Resnet50. The models are trained using a dataset that contains 26 ASL alphabets and numbers ranging from 1 to 10. Label encoding and one hot encoding are used to convert categorical labels into numerical representations, which are required for training ML models. A dense layer with dropout is applied to the classification head to reduce overfitting. When compared to Resnet50, the VGG16 architecture with customized layers for sign language identification performs better. The VGG16 model attained an accuracy of 99.92% while the Resnet50 model attained an accuracy of 99.47%. The outcomes demonstrate improved accuracy since we used a larger dataset to train the model than previously known datasets.

articleTitle: Traffic System Monitoring
abstract: An intelligent traffic monitoring system is underway in India, addressing the prevalent challenges in the diverse traffic landscape, including accidents due to factors like careless driving and inadequate infrastructure. The project utilizes Raspberry Pi and advanced computer vision techniques to establish a sophisticated monitoring infrastructure. The system's key goals involve vehicle recognition, speed estimation, and detection of violations like triple riding and helmet non-compliance. Violations, especially speeding incidents, are meticulously recorded, compiled in an Excel spreadsheet, and promptly forwarded via email for review and resolution. The integration of webcams with Raspberry Pi enables real-time traffic surveillance. Beyond enhancing traffic management, this technology aims to tackle road safety issues prevalent in various Indian traffic scenarios. Overall, the initiative emphasizes the crucial role of traffic system monitoring in ensuring safe and efficient road usage, reducing journey times and mitigating environmental impacts.

articleTitle: Guarding Against Command and Control (C2) Agents Utilizing Real-World Applications for Communication Channels
abstract: Command and Control (C2) agents are a criti-cal component of many cyberattacks, enabling adversaries to maintain covert control over compromised systems. In recent years, attackers have increasingly leveraged real-world applications, such as social media and collaborative platforms, as C2 channels to evade detection. This paper proposes a behavioural-based network-level filtering approach to enhance cybersecurity defences against these threats. The suggested method includes creating a way to look at network traffic and find patterns and oddities that point to C2 agent activity, as well as setting up network-level filtering to spot malicious traffic and attempts to communicate from C2 agents. This network-level filtering approach aims to provide a proactive and effective defence against C2 attacks, particularly those utilising non-traditional communication channels. Initial results, obtained through testing a Random Forest model on real-world traffic, demonstrate promising outcomes, with the model successfully distinguishing between benign and malicious activities.

articleTitle: Stock Market Prediction Using Machine Learning
abstract: The inherent volatility of the financial market has long posed a challenge when it comes to investing in a portfolio of assets. Basic models lack the ability to precisely predict future asset prices. Machine learning, the discipline of enabling computers to perform tasks that often require human intelligence, is currently the dominant trend in scientific research. The aim of this essay is to create a model using a Machine Learning method. The main objective of this research is to evaluate the degree of precision at which a Machine Learning algorithm can provide predictions. Predicting stock market prices is a complex task that typically involves significant collaboration between humans and computers. The network is trained and evaluated to assess its accuracy using datasets of varying sizes, and the results are documented in a tabular style. The aim of this study is to predict stock market prices with the intention of making more knowledgeable and precise financial decisions.

articleTitle: A Maximum Relevance Minimum Redundancy and Random Forest based feature selection and classification of gene expression data
abstract: Feature selection is essential for improving the accuracy of models and interpretability in the field of machine learning. This research paper investigates the application of Minimum Redundancy Maximum Relevance (mRmR) feature selection on gene expression datasets to enhance the performance of classification models. The study focuses on the critical task of identifying relevant genes that contribute significantly to the classification of biological samples. mRmR, known for its ability to select informative and non-redundant features, is employed to rank and select a subset of genes based on their relevance to the classification task. The performance of the mRmR-enhanced Random Forest model is evaluated and compared against a baseline model without feature selection. Along with random forest classifier, SVM and k-NN are also used for classification and their accuracies are being evaluated. The experimental results demonstrate the efficiency of the mRmR feature selection method in improving the classification performance of the three classification models on gene expression data.

articleTitle: Application of Breadth-First Path Finding Algorithm in Mobile Game Path Finding
abstract: In order to solve the challenges of the application of path finding in mobile games, in view of the shortcomings of the existing whale algorithms, this study proposes an innovative application method in game path finding based on breadth-first path finding algorithm. This new scheme uses the principles of optimal path theory to accurately identify and locate key influencing factors, and accordingly performs a sensible classification of indicators to reduce possible interference. At the same time, by using the unique mechanism of breadth-first path finding algorithm, this scheme cleverly constructs the design strategy of game path finding. The empirical results show that the proposed scheme shows a significant improvement compared with the traditional whale algorithm in key performance indicators such as the accuracy of application and the processing efficiency of key factors in game path finding, showing its obvious strong advantages. In smartphones, the application of game path finding plays a crucial role, which can accurately predict and optimize the growth trend and output results of the application in mobile game path finding. However, in the face of complex simulation tasks, traditional whale algorithms show some inherent shortcomings, especially when dealing with multi-level challenges, their performance is often unsatisfactory. To overcome this problem, this study introduces a new idea of application in game path finding optimized by breadth-first path finding algorithm, and accurately controls the influencing parameters through the optimal path theory, which is used as the road map for index allocation, and then uses the breadth-first path finding algorithm to innovate and construct a system scheme. The test results clearly point out that in the context of the evaluation criteria, the new scheme has been significantly optimized in terms of accuracy and processing speed for a variety of challenges, showing stronger performance superiority. Therefore, in the application of path finding in mobile games, the simulation scheme based on the breadth-first path finding algorithm successfully overcomes the shortcomings of the traditional whale algorithm and significantly improves the accuracy and operation efficiency of the simulation.

articleTitle: Unlocking Deeper Data Insights on Social Media: Removing Hashtag and Tweets Spam for Improved Content Analysis
abstract: Users of social media platforms now rely heavily on hashtags to communicate and retrieve messages about certain events, making these platforms an important source of news and information. However, the misuse of hashtags, including spamming and hijacking, can hinder effective communication and lead to the propagation of misinformation. This study proposes a robust methodology for identifying and addressing hashtag spam, emphasizing the crucial significance of data cleansing in ensuring the accuracy and reliability of information. The methodology includes removing punctuation marks and separating duplicate values to create a cleaner and standardized dataset. Hashtags are retrieved using a partially manual spam identifier, which involves human interaction to enhance the overall procedure and improve the precision of the proposed solution. The study also highlights the importance of real-time trend analysis in detecting and removing potentially harmful content, as well as the potential for adaptive filtering mechanisms to dynamically assess the relevance of hashtags within tweets. By integrating both spam and non-spam datasets, the study provides comprehensive insights into social media data and sets the stage for addressing real-time detection, the development of spam tactics, ethical concerns, and monitoring user behaviour. Overall, this research contributes to a nuanced understanding of the challenges of hashtag spam and the importance of data accuracy in social media analysis.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Detection Using Deep Learning
abstract: Breast cancer, a potentially life-threatening disease, highlights the crucial need for early and accurate detection. This study investigates the application of deep learning methods, particularly CNN and the VGG19 architecture, for automated breast cancer detection using the MIAS dataset. The primary aim is to utilize CNNs and VGG19 to improve the accuracy and efficiency of early diagnosis by learning hierarchical representations of mammographic images. The MIAS dataset, a standard in mammography research, offers annotated mammograms for training and evaluation. Preprocessing techniques like image normalization and augmentation are employed to optimize model performance. The results demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed models, showing high sensitivity and specificity in distinguishing between benign and malignant lesions. Specifically, the CNN model achieves an impressive accuracy of 98%, while the VGG19 model attains a notable accuracy of 97%. This research contributes to advancing automated breast cancer detection through deep learning, promising improved outcomes.

articleTitle: Automated Road Safety Enhancement Through Deep Learning A Robust Convolutional Neural Network Approach for Pothole Detection
abstract: When potholes are present, there is a tremendous threat to the safety of road equipment and driving. This study proposes a unique approach that employs Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to automate the process of recognising potholes in road visualisations. Convolutional neural network (CNN) model development and training, input preparation, and model correctness verification are the phases in the process. The findings reveal that potholes can be appropriately found using the recommended technology, which makes it practical to implement safer and better road repair procedures.

articleTitle: Performance Improvement of PEDOT:PSS/c-Si Solar Cell Through Back Surface Field Material Selection
abstract: This study explores the photovoltaic potential of hybrid solar cells employing various back surface field (BSF) materials. Our objective is to evaluate the power conversion efficiency (PCE), open-circuit voltage (Voc), short-circuit current (J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sc</inf>), and fill factor (FF) for each material, identifying the most promising candidate for superior solar cell performance. The analysis includes systematic variations in thickness and doping of Silicon layer, BSF layer. Moreover, study of solar cell responses under varying temperature conditions is conducted with the aim of optimizing the maximum Power Conversion Efficiency (PCE). The study concludes with an optimized <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$J$</tex> - <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$V$</tex> curve, spotlighting specific thickness and doping concentrations that yield maximum PCE, Voc, Jsc, and FF and best BSF material for the hybrid solar cell. These findings provide valuable insights for material selection and optimization in the design of efficient hybrid solar cells.

articleTitle: Predictive Maintenance Framework for Urban Metro Vehicles
abstract: Our study emphasizes the critical role of Predictive Maintenance (PdM) in safeguarding companies against system failures and accidents. By timely identifying and classifying potential failures, PdM can help reduce the risk of accidents, enhance safety measures, minimize downtime, and improve vehicle maintenance. To this end, we utilized two Machine Learning algorithms, XG Boost and Logistic Regression, to predict the occurrence of failures and determine the superior framework for specific types of failure prediction. Our proposed method is based on the MetroPT dataset and brings numerous advantages to metro and rail operators. By proactively predicting maintenance requirements, management can address potential system failures before they become serious issues. This approach significantly bolsters vehicle reliability and reduces downtime in the metro network, ensuring a more resilient and dependable transportation system. The analog sensors data, including air tank pressure, compressor oil temperature, and flowmeter values, play a vital role in this framework.

articleTitle: VANET-Based Ad-Hoc Simulation of Vehicle Trajectories in Accident Scenarios
abstract: This study addresses the challenges of traffic accident analysis in areas where installing cameras or VANET roadside units is hindered by difficult terrain and high costs. Recognizing that accidents can occur unpredictably across diverse landscapes, we propose a novel ad hoc data transmission method for simulating the trajectory of vehicles during accidents. This approach leverages the adaptability of ad hoc networks to provide a reliable and efficient means of data collection in the absence of traditional traffic monitoring infrastructure. Our simulation results indicate that this method can effectively reconstruct accident scenarios, thus offering valuable insight into traffic management and emergency response strategies in challenging environments. Moreover, it can assist the police in determining the violations committed by the vehicle involved in the accident.

articleTitle: Comparison of GLCM and DCT features for Malayalam Palm Leaf Character Recognition
abstract: This study presents a comprehensive comparison of two distinct feature extraction techniques, namely Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) and Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT), for the purpose of Malayalam palm leaf character recognition. The study focuses on the extraction of features from palm leaf images, employing GLCM to capture spatial relationships of pixel intensities and DCT to represent the frequency domain information. Extracted features are trained using different statistical classifiers. A thorough evaluation is conducted to assess the performance of both sets of feature vectors in the context of Malayalam palm leaf character recognition. The experimental results demonstrate the efficacy of DCT than GLCM in capturing the unique characteristics of Malayalam characters, providing valuable insights for the development of robust recognition systems in the domain of historical document analysis and digitization. Random Forest (RF), AdaBoost, and Decision tree (DT) demonstrate strong performance on the DCT feature set.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis and Recovery Strategy of Smart Grid Based on Deep Learning
abstract: The research on fault diagnosis and recovery strategy is critical in important role in smart grid, however it has an issue with erroneous performance positioning. The typical Particle swarm arithmetic is unable to address the inaccurate fault location issue in important role in smart grid, and the result is insufficient. As a result, a Deep learning-based research on smart grid fault diagnosis and recovery strategy is provided, and research on smart grid fault diagnosis and recovery strategy is assessed. To begin, the gradient descent theory is used to discover the influencing elements, and the indicators are split based on the research on fault diagnosis and recovery strategy's needs to decrease interference factors in the research on fault diagnosis and recovery strategy. The gradient descent theory is then used to create a Deep learning research on fault diagnosis and recovery strategy scheme, and the outcomes of the research on fault diagnosis and recovery strategy are thoroughly examined. The MATLAB simulation results reveal that, under particular evaluation conditions, the Deep learning outperforms the standard Particle swarm arithmetic in terms of research on fault diagnosis and recovery strategy accuracy and time of influencing variables.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Optimization Control Method of Air Conditioning System Based on Load Forecasting
abstract: In modern society, as a key facility in various types of buildings, the operating status of air conditioning systems directly affects the comfort of indoor environments and energy utilization efficiency. With the increasingly serious energy crisis and environmental problems, how to achieve energy conservation and emission reduction in air conditioning systems has become a highly concerned research topic. Load forecasting, as the basis for optimizing control of air conditioning systems, can provide decision-making basis for the future operational needs of the system in advance. The hierarchical optimization control method for air conditioning systems is a method of finely controlling the air conditioning system based on load prediction results. By grading the air conditioning system and developing corresponding control strategies based on the operational characteristics of different levels, the operational efficiency of the system can be improved and energy consumption can be reduced.

articleTitle: Potato Leaf Disease Classification using Pre Trained Deep Learning Techniques -A Comparative Analysis
abstract: Potatoes are essential for food production and consumption, but pests and illnesses can cause major economic losses. To quickly identify potato leaf diseases, image processing, computer vision, and deep learning can be used. We propose the “Potato Leaf Disease” dataset with 4072 photos of varied circumstances to address current dataset limitations. Our comparison investigation used DenseNet121, ResNet50, VGG19, EfficientNetB0, InceptionV3, and MobileNetV2 for feature extraction and SVM, KNN, and Random Forest for classification. The most accurate model was EfficientNetB0 with SVM Linear Kernel at 94.81%. Model efficiency in varied environmental situations shows dataset realism. Training took 38.0030 seconds and testing 1.3503 seconds. This study highlights the need of realistic datasets and presents a reliable potato leaf disease classification method. The dataset and model offer new opportunities for agricultural sustainability and crop security, making them useful for the potato business.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Management and Operation and Maintenance of New Power System
abstract: The intelligent directing and sustaining the operation of micro-grid groups problem analysis is critical in new power system, however it has an issue with erroneous performance positioning. The typical Whale algorithm is unable to address the the phase limit issue in new power system, and the result is insufficient. As a result, a Blockchain technology-based analysis of the intelligent directing and sustaining the operation of micro-grid groups of the new electric power system is provided, and the analysis of the intelligent directing and sustaining the operation of micro-grid groups of the new electric power system is assessed. To begin, the node communication theory is used to discover the influencing elements, and the indicators are split based on the intelligent directing and sustaining the operation of micro-grid groups problem analysis's needs to decrease interference factors in the intelligent directing and sustaining the operation of micro-grid groups problem analysis. The node communication theory is then used to create a Blockchain technology intelligent directing and sustaining the operation of micro-grid groups problem analysis scheme, and the outcomes of the intelligent directing and sustaining the operation of micro-grid groups problem analysis are thoroughly examined. The MATLAB simulation results reveal that, under particular evaluation conditions, the Blockchain technology outperforms the standard Whale algorithm in terms of intelligent directing and sustaining the operation of micro-grid groups problem analysis accuracy and time of influencing variables.

articleTitle: Increased Efficient Usage of Power in Cognitive Radio Networks Utilizing Hybridized Handover of Spectrum
abstract: The reduction of efficient utilizations of energies in networks connected wirelessly due to rapid spectrums usage necessitates networks connected by radios interacting cognitively which is of greater power efficiency compared to conventionally operated schemes. Development of networks connected by radios interacting cognitively, prompted by a decrease in available spectrums bandwidth, is now widely employed for data transmission. Research works now-a-days economies of power consuming along with delays in handover are often disregarded over handover verdict together with sensing of spectrums cooperatively, aiming to enhance sensing efficacy and system throughput. Efforts to enhance the efficient utilizations of energies of the sensing process are being made. An process of thresholds on the basis of initial utilizer pattern of traffics are proposed for controlling of mobilities inside the assigned spectrums. Utilizing a threshold method, calculations are performed for probability-based wait-and-stay along with Quality of Services' handover values. Furthermore, a method is designed towards selection of channels containing most value of throughputs along with minimal power utilization. The recommended technique aims to reduce fake alarm and wrong-detections, while also maintaining handover delays with improving data-rate along with efficient utilizations of energies. Through this approach, enhancements are achieved in data-rates, economies of power usage, workings of sensors with handover times while minimizing wrong-findings

articleTitle: UniFeed: University Information Hub
abstract: In an era of rapid change, universities are realizing the important role of effective communication in the management process. Unifeed is emerging as a revolutionary platform that provides a centralized platform for the university's message sharing ecosystem. This article provides an in-depth look at Unifeed's origins, development, features and potential impact, highlighting its role in promoting transparency, accessibility and community engagement. Unifeed meets the need to go beyond traditional communication channels by providing an easy way to share information. Unifeed not only improves business productivity by encouraging open dialogue and informed decision-making, it also helps increase business productivity and student achievement and shape the future of school communications.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Battery Monitoring PCB
abstract: In the present scenario the widespread integration of batteries into daily activities with the increasing prominence of local energy generation, there is a critical demand for advanced battery monitoring and management techniques to ensure best performance and reliability. As batteries play a crucial role in various applications, ensuring their best performance is essential. Impedance-based monitoring has appeared as a highly effective procedure for achieving this goal, with several techniques being proposed in recent years. The precise measurement of voltage and current across a circuit is fundamental for ensuring safety and compliance with operational specifications. This paper introduces an innovative approach to address this need, presenting a simplified circuit design that uses a single integrated circuit (IC) to accurately measure both voltage and current. This novel approach not only enhances measurement precision but also holds significant potential for widespread applicability in professional settings, enabling informed decision-making and proactive risk mitigation.

articleTitle: Antenna Performance Prediction Using Machine Learning Algorithm
abstract: Antennas play a crucial role in our daily lives and have become an integral part of modern communication and technology. Traditional antenna design processes often involve time-consuming and expensive prototyping and testing iterations. The research focus on developing machine learning model that can forecast the performance characteristics of antennas based on their design parameters and operating conditions. Artificial intelligence methodologies like machine learning have the ability to enhance parameter optimization and develop predictive models using provided datasets. This project aims to harness the power of machine learning to predict antenna performance with unprecedented accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: 3-bit Flash ADC Using TIQ Comparator
abstract: High speed and low power consumption are critical requirements for many applications of an analog-to-digital converter (ADC).
