Implementing flash ADC, the fastest available ADC type, requires a significant amount of (Integrated Circuit)IC real estate. Significant disadvantages include its high power and area requirements. Threshold Inverter Quantization (TIQ) is a comparator that can be used to get around this problem. Using two cascading inverters as a voltage comparator gives this technique its name. Internal reference voltages are compared with the input voltage, which depends on the transistor sizes of the inverters. The priority encoder gives the digital output based on the highest order active input, ignoring all other active input. While TIQ is not as fast as Flash ADC, its small size and power efficiency make it a worthy replacement in situations where every milliwatt and square millimeter counts. The design structures are stimulated using CMOS 180nm technology which uses a Vdd of 1.8V and has a power consumption of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{26.39} (\mu \mathbf{W})$</tex> with a delay of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{32.96} (\mu \mathbf{s})$</tex>.

articleTitle: An Improved Approach for Yoga Pose Estimation of Images
abstract: This project focuses on advancing yoga pose estimation using deep learning. The dataset undergoes thorough preprocessing to ensure integrity, addressing issues like corrupted images. Drawing upon a pretrained VGG16 network and custom layers, the model is tailored for yoga pose intricacies. The model is evaluated on both training exercises and real-world tests, guiding further enhancements. The trained model is saved for future use, and testing involves systematic validation on new images using a translation dictionary for result interpretation. Our proposed model has achieved the accuracy of 97.30% with a validation loss of 52.82% and validation accuracy of 98.82% for Yoga Set 1 and accuracy of 97.48% with a validation loss of 55.63% and validation accuracy of 97.72% for Yoga Set 2. We expanded pose prediction from three to six poses using models. The high accuracy achieved suggests potential applications in not only pose recognition but also in providing valuable insights for improving form and technique. The project's outcomes contribute to computer vision and pave the way for applications in realtime feedback systems, promising advancements in yoga practice enhancement.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Performance of Conformable and Non-Conformable Patch Antennas
abstract: This paper presents a performance analysis between a conventional triangular shaped patch antenna and a future reconfigurable patch antenna. There are different materials with different electronic properties for the simulation of triangular shaped patch antenna. All the materials for the triangular patch antenna are simulated using FEKO tool. Materials selected for triangular patch antenna are Copper, Single-wall Carbon Nano-tube (SCNT), Multiple-wall Carbon Nano-tube (MCNT) and Graphene. For the futuristic antennas, cotton fabric based reconfigurable patch antenna is also analyzed and compared with triangular shaped patch antenna. Graphene based triangular patch antenna has been analyzed best out of other materials. Reconfigurable cotton fabric-based patch antenna provides better bandwidth and results are validated through simulation and experimental setup.

articleTitle: E-Commerce Recommendation Algorithm Based on Data Augmentation and Attention Mechanism
abstract: Aiming at the limitations of traditional digital mining algorithms in the research of e-commerce recommendation algorithms, a recommendation algorithm research scheme based on data augmentation and attention mechanism was proposed. Firstly, the influencing factors is accurately located through iterative statistical theory, and the indicators is reasonably divided to reduce interference, and the data augmentation and attention mechanism is used to construct a recommendation algorithm research scheme. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the proposed scheme is superior to the traditional digital mining algorithm in terms of the research accuracy of the recommendation algorithm and the processing time of influencing factors, and has obvious advantages. The research of recommendation algorithm plays an extremely important role in the era of intelligent e-commerce, which can accurately predict and optimize the growth characteristics and product generation in the era of intelligent e-commerce. However, traditional digital mining algorithms have certain limitations in solving the simulation problem of e-commerce recommendation, especially when dealing with complex problems. In this paper, this paper proposes a recommendation algorithm based on data augmentation and attention mechanism to better solve this problem. The scheme accurately locates the influencing factors through iterative statistical theory, so as to determine the division of indicators, and uses data augmentation and attention mechanism to construct the scheme. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the accuracy and speed of the scheme is significantly improved for different problems, and it has better performance. Therefore, the simulation scheme based on data augmentation and attention mechanism can better solve the limitations of traditional digital mining algorithms and improve the accuracy and efficiency of simulation in the research of e-commerce recommendation algorithms.

articleTitle: Analysis of Estimation Accuracy Between Kalman and LSTM Algorithm
abstract: Our work intends to compare the Kalman and LSTM algorithms on their ability to estimate the next state. In today's data world, a large base of information is available, and many studies are going on to establish the accurate predictor of future states, say, the stock market, earthquake, weather forecasting, etc., that play important roles in today's life. Kalman filter is a main estimating algorithm used in automotive rockets and satellite landings. However, the same confidence is not given to the learning models. This work intends to study the same system dependence of Kalman and develop the same confidence in the RNN model. The results show that RNN is 9.76% more accurate than Kalman for rapidly varying data. Presenting the main advantage of RNN to handle non-linear variations in the data.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influencing Factors of Bond Issuance Credit Spread Based on Stochastic Forest Regression Model
abstract: The analysis of the influencing factors of credit spread is critical in the credit of bond issuance, however it has an issue with erroneous performance positioning. The typical Ant colony algorithm is unable to address the inaccurate analysis and positioning issue in the credit of bond issuance, and the result is insufficient. As a result, a Random forest regression model-based analysis of influencing factors of bond issuance credit spread is provided, and the analysis of influencing factors of bond issuance credit spread is assessed. To begin, the decision tree theory is used to discover the influencing elements, and the indicators are split based on the analysis of the influencing factors of credit spread's needs to decrease interference factors in the analysis of the influencing factors of credit spread. The decision tree theory is then used to create a Random forest regression model analysis of the influencing factors of credit spread scheme, and the outcomes of the analysis of the influencing factors of credit spread are thoroughly examined. The MATLAB simulation results reveal that, under particular evaluation conditions, the Random forest regression model outperforms the standard Ant colony algorithm in terms of analysis of the influencing factors of credit spread accuracy and time of influencing variables.

articleTitle: Implementation of Grover's Algorithm based on Quantum Reservoir Computing
abstract: Quantum computing represents the leading edge of computational technology, leveraging the principles of quantum mechanics to execute targeted computations much faster than classical computers. In contrast to classical bits, which are limited to representing either 0 or 1, qubits, or quantum bits, exhibit the extraordinary property of superposition. This distinctive characteristic enables qubits to simultaneously occupy multiple states, empowering quantum computers to explore numerous potential solutions to a problem concurrently. This feature makes quantum computing particularly potent for specific tasks. Recent research endeavors have been sparked by the potential of advanced quantum computing technology, leading to the creation of simulations of quantum computers using classical hardware. Grover's quantum search algorithm serves as a notable illustration of quantum computing application, enabling quantum computers to conduct a database search within an unsorted array with a quadratic speedup in time efficiency compared to classical computers. This document presents the quantum Grover search algorithm and its application through 5-qubit quantum circuits, as well as a design framework to simplify the creation of an oracle for a greater number of qubits.

articleTitle: Melodies in the Machine - Gru's Role in Crafting Musical Elegance
abstract: This study explores the fascinating world of music generation using a powerful tool called Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU). Imagine a GRU as a smart composer who learns patterns and structures from various pieces of music. Similar to how you remember a catchy tune after hearing it a few times, a GRU can analyse and remember musical elements like rhythms, melodies, and harmonies. Unlike traditional methods where composers manually craft each note, a GRU takes a more automated approach. It processes a large dataset of existing music, grasps the underlying rules, and then starts composing its pieces. The focus was on three key aspects: pitch, step, and duration. By training the model on a dataset comprising MIDI files from the Maestro dataset, it learned patterns and structures within musical compositions. MIDI files were formatted properly to prepare the data for the GRU model. To do this, note sequences with corresponding pitch, step, and duration data had to be created. To promote the creation of realistic and varied musical sequences, a bespoke loss function was used during training. By adding positive pressure terms, this novel method increased the model's originality. By forecasting the following note using a predetermined note sequence, the trained GRU model was able to create new musical motifs. The trained model's efficiency was assessed using both quantitative and qualitative methods. This involved analysing the generated music's auditory experience in addition to loss measures.

articleTitle: Optimization of CNTFET and Effect of Channel Length Scaling on CNTFET and MOSFET Threshold Voltage
abstract: Among all semiconductors, the field effect transistor made of carbon nanotubes (CNTFET) is seen to be most likely to take the place of CMOS industry. Because of its physical limitations and Due to the numerous challenges associated with scaling down CMOS in the nanometer region, including high density, small gate control, high leakage current, and high power consumption, and many more the IC industry is currently having trouble continuing to reduce the size of MOSFET technology. Because of its smaller size and superior electrical characteristics, carbon nanotubes (CNTs) have the potential to open up new avenues for the semiconductor industry by substituting silicon. Therefore, the authors' main goal in this work is to compare and explain why CNT-FET devices are superior to MOSFET devices. in the nanoscale domain. SILVACO ATLAS software was used in this project to produce MOS-FETs and CNT-FETs.After examining the impact of channel length variation on MOS-FET and CNT-FET device threshold voltage, we found an unusual conclusion.. As soon as the channel length on CNT-FET devices drops, the threshold voltage increases. A CNT-FET device's threshold voltage is seen to rise quickly when the channel is shorter than ten nanometers, whereas a MOSFET device's threshold voltage is seen to significantly drop at the same channel length.

articleTitle: Reform and Practice of Material Sorting Training Course Based on Digital Twin Technology
abstract: In the production process of enterprises, material sorting is very important. Material sorting has manual and mechanical, among which manual material sorting requires practical training. The traditional practical training courses can no longer meet the problem of manual material sorting training in enterprise production. Therefore, this paper proposes a digital twin technology for practical analysis of material sorting. First of all, digital technology is used to reform and optimize the material sorting training course, and the indicators are divided according to the requirements of the material sorting training to reduce the interference factors in the material sorting training. Then, the digital technology optimizes the results of the material sorting training courses produced by the enterprise, forms a material sorting training program, and comprehensively analyzes the material sorting training results. MATLAB simulation shows that under the condition of certain evaluation standards, the effect of digital twin technology on the practical training of material sorting produced by enterprises and the feasibility of material sorting practical training are better than those of traditional practical training courses.

articleTitle: Disease Classification Model Using Capsule Networks Based on White Blood Cells
abstract: As a substitute for recurrent neural networks (RNNs), Deep Learning (DLs) has shown promise in text processing in the last several years. In this study, we looked at the recently announced capsule networks (CapsNets), which are gaining a lot of interest since they outperform Deep Learning (DLs) in image analysis, and we found that they function well for language categorization and sentiment analysis in some instances. Our experimental findings demonstrate that the suggested well-tuned CapsNets model may serve as a suitable (and, in some cases, superior and more cost-effective) alternative to sentence categorization models based on RNNs and DLs. We ran a battery of tests with randomly shuffled test data to see whether CapsNets could learn the sequence of words sequentially. Overall, our CapsNets model outperforms DL and RNN models in terms of classification performance and resilience to adversarial assaults.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Low Power Golay Encoder Architecture
abstract: In wireless communication, the transmission of a message from source to destination may be susceptible to distortion or corruption due to noise. Error detection involves identifying errors, while error correction entails restoring the original message. This work gives a through performance analysis of a Golay Encoder. To address these limitations of existing methods, a novel architecture has been introduced to generate the binary Golay code word of 23 bits output using the 12 bits input message signal using Clock gating technique. This new design emphasizes low power consumption, and it has been developed and confirmed through verification processes. Feedback shift registers based on linear (LFSR) cyclic redundancy check (CRC) and hardware architecture based on CRC [1]. These architectures do have some downsides. In order to reduce the power of Existing Method, we used the clock gating technology to reduce the power consumed by the clock signal. The main objective is to reduce the power consumption of the Existing Golay Encoder. As the major power consumption component is clock,we tried to reduce the usage of power by clock. The findings of this study aid in the selection and optimization of different clock gating technique. The results provided in this paper demonstrate the benefits of clock gating technique. This project is done uisng the Cadence 90nm technology. In this the total power of the system is reduced by 64.6%, the delay of the system is maintained constant and the area of the system is reduced by 2.7%.

articleTitle: Enhancing Photovoltaic Parameters in MA3Sb2I9-Based Perovskite Solar Cells Through Active Layer Optimization
abstract: The primary goal of this work is to investigate a TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/MA<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</inf>/Spiro-OMeTAD perovskite solar cell (PSC) by varying the acceptor density (NA) and thickness of the active layer. The device may be simulated with the help of the Solar Cell Capacitance Simulator (SCAPS-1D) application. The device's structure is optimized with MA<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</inf> functioning as the absorber or active layer, TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> functioning as the electron transport layer (ETL), and Spiro-OMeTAD functioning as the hole transport layer (HTL). The goal is to maximize photon absorption from solar energy and the show the effect of these variations on the PV parameters of the device. The device's performance is being analysed in relation to variations in thickness and the NA. At the maximum thickness and NA value, the highest PCE is recorded. The PV parameters of the MA<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</inf> based cells are therefore as follows: FF: 86.62%, PCE: 16.98%, Voc: 1.575V and J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SC</inf>: 12.44mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: HVAC Control Strategy Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
abstract: In view of the limitations of the traditional bee colony algorithm in the study of HVAC control strategy, a research scheme of air conditioning control strategy based on ant colony algorithm was proposed. Firstly, the influencing factors were accurately located through the swarm foraging theory, and the indicators were reasonably divided to reduce the interference, and the ant colony algorithm was used to construct a research scheme of air conditioning control strategy. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the proposed scheme is superior to the traditional bee colony algorithm in terms of research accuracy and processing time of influencing factors of air conditioning control strategy, and has obvious advantages. The study of air conditioning control strategy plays an extremely important role in HVAC, which can accurately predict and optimize the growth characteristics and product generation of HVAC. However, the traditional bee colony algorithm has certain limitations in solving the simulation problem of air conditioning control, especially when dealing with complex problems. In this paper, this paper proposes a research scheme based on ant colony algorithm to better solve this problem. In this scheme, the influencing factors were accurately located through the swarm foraging theory, so as to determine the division of indicators, and the ant colony algorithm was used to construct the scheme. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the accuracy and speed of the scheme is significantly improved for different problems, and it has better performance. Therefore, the simulation scheme based on ant colony algorithm can better solve the limitations of traditional bee colony algorithm and improve the simulation accuracy and efficiency in the study of HVAC control strategy.

articleTitle: Optimization of Cornering Lights in Adaptive Headlamps
abstract: Adaptive headlights with cornering lights can improve nighttime driving visibility and safety. However, current cornering light systems rely solely on steering angle input which causes inefficiencies. This paper explores integrating computer vision with steering-governed algorithms to optimize cornering lights. Our approach showed promising results in correcting headlamp angles at certain curves left unlit by steering algorithms alone. Findings reveal that computer vision integration enables reliable, efficient adaptive headlights, warranting further research for safer automotive lighting.

articleTitle: Lane Detection for Autonomous Vehicles using Image Transformation Techniques
abstract: Lane detection is critical in autonomous driving and advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), furnishing vital information for vehicle navigation and safety. The study introduces lane detection methodology leveraging established image processing techniques within the Image transformation frameworks, including the study of kernels. This approach accurately detects lane markings in real-time images or video streams with the help of Gaussian blur and Canny edge detection. The system's evaluation primarily focuses on structured roads under standard conditions, demonstrating its efficacy in such environments. However, the potential for enhancing vehicle autonomy and safety across varied driving scenarios remains prominent. Leveraging Image transformation capabilities and the insights gained from kernel studies, this research advances computer vision applications in the automotive sector, facilitating the evolution of more intelligent and adaptable driving systems. Furthermore, the study introduces a method for assessing the accuracy of the detected lanes by calculating the intersection over union (IOU).

articleTitle: Optimal Control of Construction Project Management Projects Relying on Deep Learning Algorithms
abstract: The project optimization control is critical in construction project management, however it has an issue with erroneous performance positioning. The typical Gray clustering algorithm is unable to address the inaccurate control positioning issue in construction project management, and the result is insufficient. As a result, a Rely on deep learning algorithm-based optimal control of construction project management projects is provided, and the optimal control of construction project management projects is assessed. To begin, the neural network theory is used to discover the influencing elements, and the indicators are split based on the project optimization control's needs to decrease interference factors in the project optimization control. The neural network theory is then used to create a Rely on deep learning algorithm project optimization control scheme, and the outcomes of the project optimization control are thoroughly examined. The MATLAB simulation results reveal that, under particular evaluation conditions, the Rely on deep learning algorithm outperforms the standard Gray clustering algorithm in terms of project optimization control accuracy and time of influencing variables.

articleTitle: VGG16 Transfer Learning Model for Diagnosing Multi-Class Kidney Disorder
abstract: Kidney stones are a frequent issue around the world, prompting many patients to visit emergency rooms in excruciating pain. The diagnosis of kidney stone disease involves the utilisation of many imaging techniques. The analysis and comprehensive evaluation of these photographs necessitate the expertise and scrutiny of professionals. Computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) methodologies are practical approaches that can be employed as adjunctive instruments to assist physicians in the process of making diagnoses. In this study, The utilisation of deep learning techniques in the field of artificial intelligence has shown remarkable progress, prompting a proposal to employ these techniques for the automated diagnosis of kidney stones through the analysis of coronal computed tomography images. This study gives a thorough examination of the performance of a machine learning model designed for categorization tasks. The study assesses the model's effectiveness by analysing training and validation metrics. The model has a training and validation accuracy of 99.7%, demonstrating its excellent ability to reliably categorise data instances. The outcomes of this research add to a better knowledge of the model's capabilities and prepare the way for its practical application in real-world circumstances.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Propagation Models in Urban VANET Environments: Assessing OLSR Routing Based Vehicular Networks
abstract: Amidst the rapid pace of technological advancement, vehicular communication emerges as a pivotal element in the modern urban landscape. Vehicular Ad hoc Networks (VANETs), operating within this ecosystem, serve as fundamental infrastructure, heavily shaped by routing protocols and propagation models. This study delves into the real-time ramifications of various propagation models on VANET performance, recognizing the dynamic and intricate nature of vehicular environments. The selection of an appropriate propagation model assumes paramount importance in establishing resilient communication networks, particularly within urban settings. This investigationassesses and compare the effectiveness of commonly utilized propagation models-Free Space, Nakagami and ITU-R P.1411 Loss Model, within the context of an Optimized Link State Routing (OLSR) based VANETin urban environments. By meticulously scrutinizing performance metrics such as Average Routing Goodput, Packet Loss Ratio, MAC/PHY-Overhead and Packet Delivery Ratio of Basic Safety Messages, employing in SUMO and NS3 platforms, which shed light on the intricate dynamics between propagation models and VANET performance. Importantly, the findings of this study underscore the limitations inherent in relying on a fixed propagation model and advocate for the dynamic adaptation of propagation models tailored to specific scenarios. The findings indicate a robust correlation between propagation models and the performance of OLSR within the VANET scenarios.

articleTitle: Automating Registration of Executables as Commands on the Ubuntu-Linux Platform
abstract: Linux, as a popular open-source operating system, owes much of its success to its modularity and extensibility through a vast array of executable commands. These commands enable users to interact with the system effectively and efficiently. This paper explores the crucial role of registering executables as commands in Linux and discusses a way to automate the registration process and delves into the advantages and implications of such registration. By integrating new functionalities into the Linux shell environment, users can access powerful tools and utilities directly from the command line, streamlining workflows and promoting productivity. The command registration process fosters a cohesive and consistent user experience, which is essential for both novice and expert users. The technical aspects of command registration include the mechanisms behind creating symbolic links, updating system paths, and handling user-specific configurations. There are also various methods of integrating executables as commands, such as package managers and custom scripts. This paper focuses on the process of automatically registering desired executables as commands in Linux, illustrating the advantages it offers in terms of overall user experience. As Linux continues to evolve, understanding and embracing these registration practices will be vital for ensuring a robust and cohesive operating environment that caters to the diverse needs of its users.

articleTitle: Optimal Capacitor Location in Radial Distribution Network to Improve Voltage Profile
abstract: The aim of this study was to enhance voltage profiles within radial distribution networks by strategically situating capacitors. The proposed approach integrates Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) with Backward-forward sweep analysis utilizing the Loss-Sensitive Index (LSI). The investigation encompasses two distinct radial distribution networks consisting of 15, 33 buses respectively. A detailed power flow analysis through the Backward-forward sweep offers valuable insights into the network's behavior. The fusion of LSI and PSO aids in pinpointing optimal locations for capacitor placement. The main objectives include minimizing losses and enhancing the voltage profile across the distribution network. This study provides a detailed examination of capacitor optimisation for a range of radial distribution networks, showing the effectiveness of the suggested method in these scenarios.

articleTitle: A Web-Based Interface for Comprehensive Staging Classification of Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis Through Convolutional Neural Networks
abstract: Alzheimer's Disease (AD) is a chronic neurodegenerative condition that results in behavioral changes, memory loss, and cognitive decline. Though there has been a lot of ongoing research, there is still no effective treatment for its diagnosis. Therefore, early detection of AD is necessary for managing symptoms and slowing its progression. The proposed approach enables the Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) to learn all the relevant features from the input processed Magnetic Resonance Images, followed by effective classification of the disease. The trained CNN model possesses the capability to categorize Alzheimer's into distinct ages like early, mild, and moderate. In addition, a web- based Graphical User Interface has been developed using Python library, to enhance user-friendliness and informational value. Through this intuitive interface, users can access comprehensive information regarding the symptoms linked with each stage and precautions to be taken for it.

articleTitle: Sentient Sound waves: Elevating Emotional Communication with AI-Generated Speech Technology
abstract: This research-based project is about a new way to put feelings into computer-generated speech. It has two stages: text emotion detection and emotional speech synthesis. In the former part, labeled text data is used to build models to spot the emotions. This model learns to change pitch, volume, and rhythm based on the given emotion. During the latter phase, the text is changed into neutral speech using text-to-speech (TTS) methods. The model is used for practice to find the emotion in the text, tagging the text with that emotion. Also, a deep-learning model known as a tacotron is employed to make an emotional-sounding speech. The model perfectly uses machine learning strategies to blend feelings into speech. This opens up possibilities for turning plain text into speech with feelings of varied emotions. The proposed system makes a novice and important contribution to natural language processing for emotion identification and deep learning for emotional speech synthesis.

articleTitle: Enhancing Crop Health, A Novel CNN-SVM Hybrid Model for Litchi Disease Detection
abstract: Litchi production has obstacles posed by many illnesses that can profoundly affect both the quantity and quality of the crop. This study introduces an innovative method for predicting diseases by combining Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Support Vector Machines (SVMs) into a hybrid model. The model under consideration integrates three convolutional layers, three max-pooling layers, and one fully connected layer. Our model has exceptional performance in accurately identifying several Litchi leaf diseases, as evidenced by extensive experimentation. The CNN-SVM hybrid architecture combines the advantages of both approaches, resulting in a powerful ability to extract features and classify data with reliability. The results of our research enhance the progress of precision agricultural techniques, providing farmers with a powerful tool to diagnose and treat diseases in Litchi orchards at an early stage.

articleTitle: Real-Time Mouth Movement Recognition Using Media Pipe and CNN
abstract: The requirement for food monitoring systems has increased rapidly for analyzing eating behavior to mitigate overweight, obesity, and related disorders. In response, a novel approach of automatic food intake and mouth movement recognition system is designed to assess the frequency of food intake, meal duration, and mouth movements. Datasets are collected using OpenCV and Mediapipe Holistic for capturing facial landmarks and hand gestures. The model is trained using TensorFlow and Keras, incorporating the CNN architecture for feature extraction and image classification. The trained model is tested on 15 subjects of age group (20–40) in real-time, achieving an impressive accuracy rate of 96%. This helps in understanding and addressing the complexities of eating behavior and its impact on a person's health.

articleTitle: Time-Specific Classification in Hindustani Classical Music
abstract: This study presents a novel approach to classify morning and evening raags in Indian classical music using a unique architecture named the “1d-SRiyam” network. The classification is based on time-specific characteristics, capturing the emotive expressions and melodic nuances inherent in each raag. The proposed model was compared with a conventional 1d CNN-LSTM model using evaluation metrics, including accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 scores. Results show that the 1d-SRiyam network outperforms the conventional model with an accuracy of 75% compared to 59%. The precision for classifying morning raags (class 0) was 70%, while for evening raags (class 1), it was 76%. The recall for class 0 was 38% and for class 1, it was 92%. The F1 scores were 0.49 for class 0 and 0.83 for class 1, indicating the superior predictive capabilities of the proposed model. The findings of this research highlight the importance of considering time theory in raag classification and provide valuable insights into the emotional and cultural aspects of Indian classical music. The 1d-SRiyam network offers a promising avenue for further exploration and appreciation of the timeless artistry present in morning and evening raags, enriching the understanding of this classical musical heritage.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approach for Drowsiness Detection Using Facial Features
abstract: The suggested system uses the YOLOv5 object detection algorithm to look for signs of tiredness in driver. Using YOLOv5 object detection and facial feature analysis, this software project aims to develop a tiredness detecting system for drivers. Real-time video feeds via a camera installed in the vehicle will be employed by the system to monitor the driver's eye closure movements and mouth opening movements for yawning detection. The YOLOv5 method and the Python programming language will be utilized to create the suggested system. To process images and videos, the OpenCV library will be employed. When the system notices tiredness, it will analyze the patterns of these facial traits and sound an alarm alert to warn the driver.

articleTitle: Optimizing Performance: Ideal and Practical Switching Analysis of Totem-Pole Converters with Average Fidelity-Based Charger
abstract: This research paper investigates the performance of a totem-pole converter, specifically focusing on both ideal and practical switching scenarios. The totem pole converter is analyzed with an average fidelity-based charger, considering parameters such as capacitor voltage or DC bus voltage, grid voltage and current, battery terminal voltage, battery charging current and battery state of charging. Under ideal switching conditions, the converter demonstrates stable capacitor voltage at 400 V, synchronous alignment between grid voltage and current and consistent battery charging parameters. The practical switching analysis acknowledges real-world limitations, showcasing a slight deviation in DC bus voltage and closely aligned values for other parameters compared to theoretical expectations. The comparison between theoretical and practical values highlights the converter's effective performance, emphasizing its suitability for real-world applications. This study provides valuable insights into the behavior of totem-pole converters under different operating conditions, contributing to the understanding and optimization of power conversion systems.

articleTitle: Control Law Development and Implementation for a One Degree-of-Freedom Copter
abstract: In this work, the design, implementation, and analysis of a modified PID control-ler to stabilize the angular position of a 1-DOF copter system. A dynamic model of the system was obtained using classical mechanics. Simulation was performed to showcase the effectiveness of feedback control in stabilizing the system. The control algorithm was implemented on the ESP32 microcontroller. The controller performed well within the linear operating region of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pm\ 30^{\circ}$</tex> but showed increased oscillations, settling times and overshoot beyond that range. However, the controller could not guarantee stabilization for hover angles beyond 50°.

articleTitle: Unveiling Kale Diversity in Indian Agriculture: CNN - Logistic Regression Classification
abstract: The presented study looks into the different types of kale used in India by using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Logistic Regression. collected around 12.,000 high-quality pictures of three types of kale - Dwarf Green Curled., Siberian., and Red Russian. made sure these images were ready to use before starting working with them. The information was split into 70% to train the model, 15% for checking it out, and another 15% to test. The suggested design includes layers for feature getting and Logistic Regression to make final decisions. The model is 95.18% accurate and can strongly tell the difference between different types of kale. use accuracy, completion rate, and F1-score to check if its strong performance is the same for all classes. This guarantees good classification every time. This study shows how machine learning methods can help with farming tasks, giving a good automatic system for sorting different kale types. Future work could be about making the model better for big things, faster computers, and using it properly in real farms. This will help grow crops that are good for everyone in India while using resources well.

articleTitle: Elevating Images to Vibrant Realism Through Conditional GAN Colorization
abstract: Image colorization elevates the aesthetic charm by infusing vibrant hues into black-and-white images, creating a more immersive and engaging viewing experience across various contexts, from photography to film and digital media. It plays a pivotal role in modernizing and revitalizing visual content, impacting audience perception. The study navigates the domain of image colorization, emphasizing grayscale images using Conditional Generative Adversarial Networks(CGANs) for visual restoration. By seamlessly integrating technologies like U-Net and PatchGAN, it tackles the challenge of creating visually appealing and contextually coherent colorizations. The methodology employs CGANs with performance metrics defined by a set of equations, ensuring accurate colorizations. Results showcase the efficacy of CGANs in producing lifelike images, setting new benchmarks in practical image colorization. The proposed architecture incorporates a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) Loss with a measured value of 1.90, showcasing its robust performance in generating compelling results.

articleTitle: Web Machine Learning Based Gym Trainer
abstract: In this paper, a new approach of guidance for your daily routine of exercises and to avoid unexpected injuries is proposed. Nowadays many people are aware about their physical health so they turn towards a healthy routine of exercise, but without a proper guidance many people face certain injuries by doing the wrong exercises. On an average, 31% of people face body injuries while working out at home or gym due to lack of proper guidance or training. We here propose a model of body tracking using Web ML which helps the user get a complete guidance of his/her exercise routine. This project uses Javasccript's Tensorflow.js moveNET tool to track the body and the real time feedback is given to the user while performing exercises.

articleTitle: Improving Emotion Detection in Real-World Scenarios
abstract: The recognition of emotions based on facial expressions holds significant importance in the realms of humancomputer interaction, the evaluation of mental health, and the facilitation of personalized user experiences. Nevertheless, the demanding nature of model training, coupled with the necessity for extensive datasets, presents notable obstacles in resourceconstrained environments. Transfer learning emerges as a promising solution to these challenges, though it introduces its own set of complexities, including domain adaptation, the risk of catastrophic forgetting, model selection, and shifts in data distribution. In our research, we delve into the realm of transfer learning for emotion recognition, conducting a comparative analysis of three pretrained models: ResNet50, MobileNet, EfficientNet and CNN.

articleTitle: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Detection Using Machine Learning Techniques
abstract: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) is a widespread and worsening respiratory condition that affects millions of people globally. Early identification and prediction of COPD can dramatically improve patient outcomes by enabling timelyinterventions and tailored treatment plans. The advancement of accurate prediction systems for various diseases, including COPD, has demonstrated the potential of machine learning approaches. This studyaims to create a system which predicts COPD with the help of machine learning techniques. The system employs a dataset of clinical and demographic characteristics to train predictive models. The study evaluates multiple machine learning algorithms, analyzing their accuracy and performance metrics. The ultimate objective is to seamlessly integrate the developed system into clinical practice, offering advantages such as detection of COPD as early as possible, the formulation of personalized treatment plans, and the implementation of preventive measures. Notably, the study leverages the capabilities of the Artificial Neural Network (ANN) machine learning algorithm for its analytical framework.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Enabled Supply Chain Transparency and Smart Contracts for Efficient Humanitarian Aid Operations in NGO
abstract: In the face of global crises, humanitarian aid organizations are crucial for delivering assistance to vulnerable populations. However, the effectiveness of aid operations is hindered by challenges in transparency, accountability, and operational efficiency. This paper explores the transformative potential of blockchain technology in revolutionizing humanitarian aid delivery. Blockchain, with its decentralized and immutable ledger system, promises to address issues of trust and transparency. The research outlines a strategic vision to enhance supply chain transparency, improve operational efficiency and foster accountability within the humanitarian aid sector. A key focus is the development and implementation of the “HumanitarianAid” smart contract, leveraging blockchain to automate and ensure equitable resource distribution. The paper details the system design, transaction flow, and deployment using Remix IDE, presenting successful testing scenarios. The visual representation of executed transactions in the blockchain model illustrates dynamic interactions between donors, NGOs, and beneficiaries. The findings underscore the potential of blockchain to in shaping the future of humanitarian aid operations, streamline processes, enhance transparency, and facilitate efficient and fair humanitarian aid delivery.

articleTitle: Crawling and Analysis of Child Car Seat Evaluation Data Based on Python
abstract: The evaluation data crawling and analysis is critical in child car seats, however it has an issue with erroneous performance positioning. The typical Neural network algorithms is unable to address the inaccurate analysis and positioning issue in child car seats, and the result is insufficient. As a result, a Python-based crawling and analysis of child car seat evaluation data is provided, and the crawling and analysis of child car seat evaluation data is assessed. To begin, the human-computer interaction theory is used to discover the influencing elements, and the indicators are split based on the evaluation data crawling and analysis's needs to decrease interference factors in the evaluation data crawling and analysis. The human-computer interaction theory is then used to create a Python evaluation data crawling and analysis scheme, and the outcomes of the evaluation data crawling and analysis are thoroughly examined. The MATLAB simulation results reveal that, under particular evaluation conditions, the Python outperforms the standard Neural network algorithms in terms of evaluation data crawling and analysis accuracy and time of influencing variables.

articleTitle: Prognosis and Preception of Senile Systematic Amyloidosis Using Deep Convolutional Network
abstract: Senile systematic amyloidosis, a condition that primarily impacts older individuals, often going unnoticed as a contributor to heart failure, is marked by the abnormal accumulation of Amyloid fibrils in various organs and tissues. Systemic senile amyloidosis (SSA) can affect various vital organs, including the heart, kidneys, liver, and gastrointestinal system, even though it is commonly associated with older age. The prognosis for SSA can differ based on factors like the size and location of amyloid deposits, the presence of accompanying health conditions, and other related variables. Heart failure and other possibly catastrophic consequences can result from cardiac involvement, which is a considerable danger. To enhance the outlook and enhance the well-being of individuals affected by cardiac amyloidosis, it is essential to achieve an early diagnosis of the accumulation of amyloid deposits within the heart muscle and the adjacent tissues, a subtype of amyloidosis. The Atria, Valves, or Ventricles of the heart may develop deposits of the insoluble, misfolded Protein amyloid. Different heart chambers may get thicker as a result of these deposits, which will reduce the heart's ability to pump blood. The deep learning model will be used to merge data from diverse sources in order to independently generate a database without assistance from a third party.

articleTitle: Tomato Plant Disease Classification Using Transfer Learning
abstract: Detecting and categorizing diseases in tomato plants poses a significant hurdle for farmers, resulting in considerable agricultural losses and economic harm. The prompt underscores the significance of promptly identifying and classifying diseases to enact successful management strategies. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have demonstrated their effectiveness in tasks involving image classification, notably in categorizing diseases that impact tomato plants. However, CNN models can be computationally expensive to train and require large datasets of labeled images. Utilizing advanced CNN models can enhance the efficacy of classification models for tomato plant diseases, simultaneously decreasing computational expenses and the demand for extensive training data. Enhanced CNN models can be developed using a variety of techniques, such as transfer learning, data augmentation, and residual networks. This project aims to implement a tomato plant disease classification model using an enhanced convolution neural network. This work uses the lifelong learning method which is the model that allows one to learn new tasks without forgetting previous knowledge. Leveraging sophisticated CNN models can improve the effectiveness of classification models for tomato plant diseases, while also reducing computational costs and the need for extensive training data. It is beneficial for tasks where there is limited data available to train a model from scratch.

articleTitle: Sorting of Fresh and Damaged Apple Fruits using Machine Learning Approach
abstract: The research investigates how machine learning algorithms and Internet of Things (IoT) technologies might be combined to solve the crucial problem of separating fresh fruits from damaged apple fruits. Using Internet of Things (IoT) devices with sensors, the system collects extensive data on important characteristics, such as real-time apple picture analysis and available apple database. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and YOLO are two examples of sophisticated machine learning models that are used with this data to accurately classify the apples into different groups according to their quality. This initiative fosters enhanced efficiency, production, and profitability in the agricultural supply chain while providing a sustainable solution to the problems connected with fruit sorting. It represents a synergistic convergence of IoT, machine learning, and agriculture.

articleTitle: Real-Time Satellite Tracking and Switching Algorithm
abstract: The need for efficient real-time tracking and seamless transitions between these satellites has grown significantly in an era where the use of low-earth orbiting satellites has expanded across several industries. One of the main technological challenges is developing an algorithm that can track these satellites precisely in real time and allow for smooth transitions even when the link budget is constrained. This project involves the intricate interplay of state-of-the-art computer methods, satellite tracking techniques, and optimization strategies to enable continuous connectivity and data transmission with satellites in low Earth orbit. This project has the potential to significantly increase the efficacy and dependability of satellite-based operations across a range of industries, including telecommunications, scientific research, remote sensing and more.

articleTitle: Combined Prediction Model of Transportation Carbon Emissions Based on Richards-BP Neural Network
abstract: In view of the limitations of the traditional ant colony algorithm in the transportation carbon emission combination prediction model, a carbon emission combination prediction model scheme based on Richards-BP neural network was proposed. Firstly, the influencing factors is accurately located through the neuron theory, and the indicators is reasonably divided to reduce interference, and the Richards-BP neural network is used to construct a carbon emission combination prediction model scheme. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the proposed scheme is superior to the traditional ant colony algorithm in terms of the accuracy of the carbon emission combination prediction model and the processing time of influencing factors, and has obvious advantages. Carbon emission portfolio prediction model plays an extremely important role in transportation, which can accurately predict and optimize the growth characteristics and product generation of transportation. However, the traditional ant colony algorithm has certain limitations in solving the simulation problem of transportation carbon emissions, especially when dealing with complex problems. In this paper, this paper proposes a carbon emission combination prediction model based on Richards-BP neural network to better solve this problem. In this scheme, the influencing factors is accurately located through the neuron theory, so as to determine the division of indicators, and the Richards-BP neural network is used to construct the scheme. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the accuracy and speed of the scheme is significantly improved for different problems, and it has better performance. Therefore, the simulation scheme based on Richards-BP neural network can better solve the limitations of the traditional ant colony algorithm and improve the simulation accuracy and efficiency by using the Richards-BP neural network in the transportation carbon emission combination prediction model.

articleTitle: Improving THD% Using Multilevel Inverter and Comparing Different Types of Multilevel Inverter
abstract: The present study demonstrates a cascaded h-Bridge multilevel inverters. Inverters with multiple levels are commonly utilized in applications requiring significant power and minimal harmonics. Energy distribution and control domains. Simulations is used to evaluate the performance of 5-Stage, 7-Stage, and multiple-level inverters with 9-stages of a cascaded H-Bridge, including waveform pattern, total distortion caused by harmonics, the voltage at the output, harmonic spectrum, and voltage stress across. Create a multiple-level cascades using a MTLAB/SIMULINK multilevel H-bridge inverters.

articleTitle: Monsoon Rainfall Prediction in Tamil Nadu Using Machine Learning: A Time Series Analysis
abstract: Crop cycle planning primarily relies on precise precipitation forecasts and the mitigation of disasters and other diverse environmental factors. Typically, precipitation patterns exhibit high variability, making it challenging to accurately forecast the specifics of future rainfall. In addition to these meteorological factors, the study also examines the impact of invasive alien species such as Prosopis Juliflora. This plant does not contribute to rainfall through evapo-transpiration and has a harmful effect on the environment. This research utilizes the Randomforest Regressor to estimate rainfall and examines the impact of Prosopis Juliflora on rainfall patterns. The presence of this tree leads to a decline in groundwater levels, resulting in significant implications for agriculture, industry, and sustained economic development. Comprehending the patterns and alterations in precipitation is crucial for addressing climate-related issues, and ensuring the availability and sustainable management of precipitation is vital for ensuring access to uncontaminated water.

articleTitle: Predictive Analytics for Heart Diseases Using Machine Learning
abstract: The diagnosis and prediction of cardiovascular illness are critical medical responsibilities that assist cardiologists correctly classify patients and treat them accordingly. Since ML algorithms are here to identify a similar pattern in the patient data. Misdiagnosis in diagnosis of CV diseases is also decreased by the doctorsusing ML Patterns. In order to bring down the death rate from cardiovascular disorders. In the creation of this paper the used model can accurately forecast the CVDs conditions. This paper suggests a Fresh beginning k-modes clustering approach that can increase classification accuracy. There are several models that are employed, including DT, RFClassifier, K-Nearest Neighbor, SVM etc., was utilized to hyper tune employed ML model's parameters. On real-world dataset of 300+ instances from Kaggle, the suggested model is used.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Alzheimer Stages by Using CNN Architecture
abstract: Alzheimer's disease, a widespread neurodegenerative condition predominantly affecting the elderly on a global scale, underscores the critical need for timely and precise diagnosis to improve intervention and patient care. This study introduces a pioneering methodology for diagnosing and staging Alzheimer's, utilizing cutting-edge Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architectures applied meticulously to brain imaging datasets. The intricately crafted CNN models demonstrate a sophisticated ability to autonomously extract nuanced features from Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans. This involves discerning both local and global patterns intricately associated with the disease's progression. Through leveraging advanced machine learning techniques, our approach aims to improve the accuracy of Alzheimer's diagnosis, enabling personalized and targeted treatment strategies. Validation of our method entails a comprehensive evaluation using an impartial test dataset. Thorough analysis is done on strict performance parameters, such as the Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (AUC-ROC), sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy. These metrics serve as robust indicators of the diagnostic and staging capabilities inherent in the CNN models, ensuring the reliability and effectiveness of our innovative approach.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Low-Carbon Economic Development Level Based on Fuzzy Synthesis Algorithm
abstract: In view of the limitations of traditional image recognition algorithms in the evaluation of low-carbon economic development level, a scheme for evaluating economic development level based on fuzzy synthesis algorithm was proposed. Firstly, the influencing factors is accurately located through the fuzzy identification theory, and the indicators is reasonably divided to reduce interference, and the fuzzy synthesis algorithm is used to construct the evaluation scheme of economic development level. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the proposed scheme is superior to the traditional image recognition algorithm in terms of the evaluation accuracy of economic development level and the processing time of influencing factors, and has obvious advantages. The evaluation of economic development level plays an extremely important role in the low-carbon economy, which can accurately predict and optimize the growth characteristics and product generation of the low-carbon economy. However, traditional image recognition algorithms have certain limitations in solving developmental level simulation problems, especially when dealing with complex problems. In this paper, this paper proposes an economic development level evaluation scheme based on fuzzy synthesis algorithm to better solve this problem. In this scheme, the influencing factors is accurately located through the fuzzy identification theory, so as to determine the division of indicators, and the fuzzy synthesis algorithm is used to construct the scheme. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the accuracy and speed of the scheme is significantly improved for different problems, and it has better performance. Therefore, the simulation scheme based on fuzzy synthesis algorithm can better solve the limitations of traditional image recognition algorithms and improve the accuracy and efficiency of simulation in the evaluation of low-carbon economic development level.

articleTitle: Enhancing Disease Severity Classification: Unveiling the Complexity of Sugar Maple Tar Spot with CNN-GAN Framework
abstract: Sugar maple tar spot is caused by the water mold Rhytisma acerinum and is one of the unique systemic leaf pathogens affecting sugar maple (Acer saccharum) in North America and Europe. The exact tar spot of the sugar maple class fraction is paramount to developing effective control practices. As our task, we suggest a new Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN)- Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN)-based framework for increasing the accuracy of severity classification through a convolutional neural network-generative adversarial network architecture. The CNN-GAN infrastructure blends machine intelligence methods to make the process of automation and increase disease classification accuracy. We carried out the multistep process of collecting a comprehensive dataset of sugar maple leaf images representing different levels of degree of tar spot and finally trained the CNN-GAN network using a systematic methodology. Experiments conducted indicate successful implementation of the algorithm based on the CNN-GAN model as the network system has yielded the accuracies of classification of sugar maple tar spot severity being 95.62%. The tabular results with details and analysis as well as an indication of the model's performance among patients with different severity levels of this psychiatric disorder. This aspect expands the field of automated disease detection and management in agriculture and forestry which can be used in earlier screening and suitable interventions. The proposed method of a CNN-GAN framework entails great promise as it enhances the precision in diagnoses and instead provides more efficient disease-fighting strategies such as sugar maple tar sport and other plant diseases.

articleTitle: Speaker Verification: Attention Based Deep Learning Architecture
abstract: Speaker verification verifies the claimed identity of a person through speech signal. Speaker verification methods are classified into two types text dependent and the other is text independent. Speaker verification systems play a crucial role in security systems. Deep learning has been widely applied in speaker verification, Deep learning methods have shown significant improvements in various aspects of speaker verification. Some of them are CNN, RNN, LSTM. This paper introduces an attention-based model for speaker verification. The proposed model leverages attention mechanisms to focus on the speaker speech. Experimental results demonstrate efficacy of attention-based model showcasing the improved verification performance compared to normal speaker verification.

articleTitle: Knowledge Extraction from Distributed Heterogeneous Data Sources
abstract: The growing volume and complexity of unstructured and semi-structured data pose a significant challenge in extracting meaningful and relevant information. Information Extraction (IE) emerges as a powerful technique to transform unstructured data into structured format, facilitating further analysis and knowledge discovery. IE techniques can effectively extract information from unstructured data in the form of entities, relationships, objects, and events. Our objective is to develop a method for extracting or filtering out the most relevant information from data sources which are heterogeneous in nature as well as they are distributed over many systems and hence build a unified schema based on the collective knowledge extracted from the data sources. Several existing methods have been developed to extract knowledge from heterogeneous datasets. We focuses on datasets in the medical field that are distributed over multiple systems. Specifically, we aim to extract valuable information from patient records, including patient details, medical conditions and medications consumed. The unified schema can be utilized to study a new patient's condition and assist doctors in making a pre-examination of a patient by querying it.

articleTitle: Gesture Intelligence - Advancing Deaf-Mute Communication
abstract: For individuals classified as deaf or mute, hand gestures serve as their primary mode of communication, enabling them to convey their ideas, emotions, and thoughts through precise hand movements. But interacting with those who don't understand sign language is a problem. A hand gesture recognition software that can be utilized in hardware is created to close this gap. To achieve greater accuracy, this presentation compares two approaches - Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and a hybrid model - for hand gesture detection as input. To achieve optimal accuracy and show the results in an intuitive interface, preprocessing methods and feature extraction principles are employed.

articleTitle: “Design and Analysis of Microstrip Patch Antenna with Air-Gap for Narrow Bandwidth Applications”
abstract: This work investigates microstrip patch antenna design with an integrated air gap for performance enhancement through optimization. The antenna has been designed using an air gap and employing a U-shaped slot and Rogers R04003C substrate. We aim to enhance crucial antenna parameters such as gain and bandwidth. Through extensive simulations and analysis, we have achieved a gain of 8.66dBi and a bandwidth of 4.5 GHz. The S11 obtained is -20 with a gain of 8dBi. These findings provide valuable insights for further examination and verification. The proposed antenna design exhibits promising potential for narrow-band applications such as Shortwave communication systems, RADAR Technologies, and Medical Applications. This research contributes to the advancement of antenna technology and its practical implementation

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Ternary 2-Trit Comparator Based on FinFET Models
abstract: The introduction of multivalue logics has been proven to be advantageous in the realm of digital system design, as it aids in diminishing circuit complexity and enhancing energy efficiency. Within the field of multivalue logic, ternary logic is generally considered an innovative approach. This article presents a comprehensive overview of the design of a ternary 2-trit comparator using 18nm FinFET technology, implemented via the use of the Virtuoso tool offered by Cadence. The evaluation of the comparator's performance is carried out by a comparison of the results obtained using SVT and HVT FinFET models. The obtained simulation results reveal power consumption values of 81.35 and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{111.8}\ \boldsymbol{\mu} \mathbf{W}$</tex>, transient delay values of 49.57 and 29.46 ns, and power delay product values of 4032.51 and 3293.62 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathbf{x}\ \mathbf{10}^{-\mathbf{15}}\ \mathbf{J})$</tex> for the SVT and HVT FinFET models, respectively. The proposed design of a ternary 2-trit comparator can be used for data sorting, decision making applications.

articleTitle: Digital Inheritance and Development of Ethnic Folk Oral Literature Based on Genetic Algorithm
abstract: Genetic algorithm is an optimization algorithm that simulates the process of biological evolution. It is based on natural selection and genetic evolution theory, and searches for the optimal solution of a problem by simulating the crossover and mutation of chromosome genes. In genetic algorithms, the problem-solving process is transformed into chromosome gene operations similar to those in biological evolution, thereby achieving optimized solutions for complex problems. In the process of digitizing ethnic and folk oral literature, genetic algorithms have wide applicability. Firstly, oral literature often contains rich cultural connotations and unique artistic forms, which need to be accurately and completely preserved and inherited in the process of digitization. Genetic algorithm can effectively process a large amount of oral literature data by simulating the process of biological evolution, extract key information and features, and achieve accurate representation and transmission of oral literature content.

articleTitle: Feature Driven Machine Learning Models for Early Parkinson's Disease Detection in Healthcare Datasets
abstract: The nervous system of a person serves as the control centre for all physical activities. It causes thoughts to arise in the mind, produces responses, and makes it possible for body parts to move. It further controls additional functions, including digestion and breathing. This nervous system is made up of billions of cells that can translate the information received by sensory organs into actions carried out by body parts. However, as we get older, these cells begin to die, which causes the amount of the dopamine compound to decrease. This causes unexpected progression in the movement of the body parts, which is known as Parkinson's disease (PD). Although the disease is very challenging to cure but its production can be decelerated with early prediction. In this work, five machine learning models namely, random forest, decision tree, linear regression, naive bayes, and logistic regression have been used for the early PD diagnosis. For the implementation of the model, the dataset has been collected from Kaggle containing the normal cases and PD patients. The results have depicted that random forest models outperform with an accuracy rate of 86.24%, however, the naive shows the least accuracy value of 73.94%. Furthermore, the work can be helpful in diagnosing the active cases of PD in real-time medical treatment if enabled by the healthcare departments. In future, the work can be extended with the enhanced dataset and deep learning models can be implemented for better prediction outcomes.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach for Kannada Handwritten Character Recognition
abstract: Handwritten character recognition is a crucial process that involves converting handwritten text on different surfaces, such as paper and postcards, into digital formats, making it distinguishable from scanned images. Remarkable advancements have been made in this field, particularly in India, where many languages with complex scripts like Kannada, English, and Marathi are used. Kannada is one of the widely used languages in southern India, and recognizing its handwritten characters is challenging due to its complicated script. The article explains how CNN, a type of dense net, is used to recognize Kannada's handwritten characters. This technology can help protect many historical documents from damage and destruction, which is a significant achievement. The article also highlights that the versatility of this machine learning model extends beyond Kannada and can be used in various applications and technology development. The proposed research has used CNN and transfer learning due to its efficient layers, and the data set from Kaggle consisted of 16 classes of 25 images each for experimentation. The results showed a remarkable 97.50 percent accuracy in 50 epochs, demonstrating the potential of the CNN network in character recognition.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of DFIG Grid Connected System Using Hysteresis Current Controller
abstract: The increase in demand for electrical energy and constraints towards production of carbon dioxide has dragged the attention of many power researchers to develop and integrate wind energy harvesting system with the conventional power grid. The increase in interconnection of all these renewable energy resources will also create power quality issues and challenges for easy operational point of view. The rising interconnection of hybrid systems such as solar PV and DFIG also creates an uncontrolled coordinated system among the relays. A perfect grid interconnection requires control, of both current control loop and voltage control loop in such a manner that the coordination among grid side controller and source side controller must be maintained.in this paper an attempt has been made to design hysteresis based current control technique using MATLAB Simulink model. The result and comparative analysis have been carried out to showcase the robustness of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: Semantic Segmentation of Computed Tomography Scan of Lungs
abstract: In medical imaging, segmentation is a crucial first step toward precise diagnosis and therapy planning. In this context, lung examination using Computed Tomography (CT) scans is extremely important for the early identification of lung diseases. However, the complexity of lung structures and the requirement for accurate delineation provide considerable problems in this domain. The traditional method of manual segmentation is time-consuming and prone to human mistake, which makes the need for automated and precise solutions even more pressing. A revolutionary advance in medical imaging has been made with the introduction of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), particularly the U-Net architecture. By successfully retaining spatial information and capturing multi-scale properties, the solution obtained from u net model tackles the complex issues. By utilizing skip connections in conjunction with its encoder-decoder structure, the model is able to maintain important contextual elements even when downsampling presents challenges related to information loss. In this work, we provide an extensive analysis of the use of U-Net for CT scan lung segmentation. Our work not only demonstrates U-Net's accuracy in lung structure delineation, but it also provides a preview of the possible influence on clinical practice by automating lung segmentation. This powerful automated segmentation can facilitate more efficient treatment planning, speed up diagnosis, and open the door to more individualized patient care approaches. Our study demonstrates the effectiveness of this model with an Intersection over Union (IoU) score of 0.95 and an accuracy of 0.98.

articleTitle: A New Hybrid RNN-LSTM Model for Predicting the Health Insurance Prices
abstract: Health care expenditures are currently rising and will keep doing so in the future because of the growing incidence of lifestyle diseases. As the health insurance policy offers large financial coverage in the crucial medical emergencies, people always prefer taking it. But before signing up to a policy, it is important to predict the amount of medical expense which can be incurred in the future based on the lifestyle that a person leads. By accurately predicting the health insurance amount, the person can sign up to the best suitable policy and be benefitted from it. Also, this prediction can be alarming to few people who can later decide to change their lifestyle. To make accurate predictions, we have done a comparative analysis of deep learning and machine learning models and evaluated with various evaluation metrics such as Mean Squared Error, R2 Score and Cross Validation score. Usage of Flask, JavaScript, Docker and Azure along with the chosen Deep Neural Network (DNN) model ensures the end-to-end solution for the study. The end users of this system can be of two types, either the user is having their own past medical record, or the user does not have the track of their medical expense and wants to predict the amount based on the charges incurred for other people leading similar lifestyle. The first type of users can be handled with the hybrid model of Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model to identify the pattern in the given record to forecast their future monthly medical expense.

articleTitle: Optimizing Color Preservation in Artistic Style Transfer with VGG-19 and Luminance Transfer Approach
abstract: Artistic Style Transfer(AST) a fascinating aspect of Neural Style Transfer(NST) has redefined the creative manipulation of digital images by imbuing photographs with the aesthetic characteristics of famous paintings. However a persistent challenge in NST-color distortion—often compromises the color fidelity of the content image during the style transfer process. This paper introduces an innovative approach employing the VGG-19 neural network to extract style features while preserving the color harmony of the content image through luminance transfer. This method ensures that the original color palette remains unaltered achieving an authentic blend of style and content characteristics. In our experimentation, we applied the innovative artistic style transfer technique to a variety of content images, incorporating the aesthetic elements from renowned paintings. Notably, our method successfully preserved the color fidelity of the content images throughout the style transfer process. This approach contributes significantly to the field by offering a improved technique for NST that harmonizes artistic style with natural coloration serving a valuable asset for artists and technologists.

articleTitle: Predicting Short-Term Photovoltaic Power Station Output Using Combination of Fruit Fly Optimization Algorithm and an Improved Adaptive Genetic Algorithm
abstract: In the process of short-term output prediction for photovoltaic power stations, it is difficult to avoid various errors. The existence of these errors severely constrains the research and development of short-term output prediction systems for photovoltaic power stations. With the increasing penetration rate of photovoltaic power stations, these errors pose a significant threat to the stable operation of the power system. Accurate prediction of photovoltaic power output can effectively reduce the impact of large-scale photovoltaic integration on the power grid and improve the grid's capacity for accommodating photovoltaic power. Furthermore, it allows for the optimal utilization of solar energy resources, leading to higher social and economic benefits. The output power of a photovoltaic power station fluctuates due to various factors. Improving the accuracy of photovoltaic system output prediction can effectively reduce the impact on the power grid after the photovoltaic system is connected, thereby enhancing the stability of the power system. In this paper, a prediction model for photovoltaic power based on a combination of the fruit fly algorithm (FOA) and adaptive genetic algorithm (AGA) optimized BP neural network is established. The results show that the BP neural network model with the combined optimization algorithm can effectively avoid the drawback of the BP neural network easily falling into local minimum points. Compared to the BP neural network model that only optimizes weights and thresholds, it improves prediction accuracy and demonstrates certain practical value.

articleTitle: Sparse Identification and M.P.C. Based Closed Loop Control of Nonlinear Quadruple Tank Process
abstract: The technique known as Sparse Identification of nonlinear dynamics (SINDy) has demonstrated effectiveness in determining system's underlying equations from empirical data. SINDy is a sparsity-promoting technique that identifies the most important terms in the dynamical system equations. This paper discusses the nonlinear model identification of nonlinear dynamics of a Quadruple Tank process using SINDy. After identifying the appropriate dynamics, the dynamical model of Quadruple Tank process can be determined by the evolution of states which can be compared with the original dynamical system. Then, linear and nonlinear model predictive control based techniques are applied to the identified model for achieving the control objectives. The passivity based approach is utilized in nonlinear model predictive control to ensure the closed-loop stability of the discovered nonlinear model. Our findings pave the way for accurately modelling complex physical systems and using the findings for applying different control strategies.

articleTitle: Intelligent Design and Application of Health Monitoring and Early Warning System for Rural Empty Nesters
abstract: The support of the elderly is not just a financial and material investment, but also requires time and spiritual companionship.
