Addressing the problem at hand, the paper proposes a multilayered approach that combines homogeneous and heterogeneous ensemble learning models, alongside integrating deep learning architectures. It introduces powerful ensemble learning strategies such as RandomForestClassifier, GradientBoostingClassifier, XGBClassifier, Support Vector Classifier (SVC), MLPClassifier, Logistic Regression, and a variety of other models. Through this ensemble approach, it leverages the strengths of these models to enhance the accuracy and robustness of crop recommendations. Additionally, the study delves into the realm of deep learning, employing Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), and RNN-LSTM models, which are finely tuned to capture subtle data patterns essential for accurate crop yield prediction. Our study carefully evaluates the performance of these models through rigorous cross-validation and fusion techniques, highlighting their transformative potential to revolutionize crop recommendation practices. By providing data-driven insights to farmers, we aim to pave the way for sustainable agriculture and improved food security in an ever-evolving agricultural landscape.

articleTitle: Utilizing Error-Related Potentials to Assist in Decision-Making at Crossroads
abstract: This study initially conducted an offline simulated driving experiment to detect Error-Related Potentials (ErrPs) produced by subject s, achieving an average classification accuracy of 79.99% using the Polynomial Kernel Support Vector Machine (PSVM) classification algorithm. Subsequently, an online experiment on human-machine cooperative driving was carried out to assess the feasibility of applying ErrPs in real-time cooperative driving scenarios. The results indicated that while rule-based autonomous driving systems ensured basic safety, the integration of ErrPs into human-machine cooperative driving further incorporated the drivers' decision preferences. This research validates the practical feasibility of utilizing Error-Related Potentials for human-machine cooperative driving and offers a new direction for the development of EEG-assisted human-machine cooperative driving systems, with the aim of enhancing system performance and driving experience.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of FinFET Models Based Ternary 1-Trit Comparator
abstract: The advent of multivalue logics in the domain of digital electronics has been acknowledged as a noteworthy accomplishment, providing solutions to the limitations imposed by binary logic. Ternary logic is considered an innovative method within the field of multivalue logic. This article outlines the design of a ternary 1-trit comparator employing 18nm FinFET technology using the Virtuoso tool provided by Cadence. The analysis of the comparator's performance is conducted by comparing the outcomes acquired using SVT and HVT FinFET models. The simulation findings obtained indicate power consumption values as 29.24 and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{51.10}\boldsymbol{\mu}\mathbf{W}$</tex>, transient delay values as 30.33 and 40.57ns, and power delay product values as 886.84 and 2073.12 (x 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−15</sup> J) for SVT and HVT FinFET models, respectively. The suggested architectural design of 1-trit ternary comparator proves to be energy efficient for applications where data sorting and decision-making is necessary.

articleTitle: The Use of a DenseNet201 CNN and Other Deep Learning Techniques for Exploratory Data Analysis of Red Wine Quality
abstract: This study delves into the exploration of red wine quality using a DenseNet201 CNN model and various other machine learning methodologies for Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA). The dataset encompasses a diverse array of chemical and sensory attributes associated with red wines. Rigorous data preparation steps, including addressing missing values and outliers, are undertaken to ready the dataset for analysis. The simplicity and local pattern-capturing capability of the DenseNet201 CNN model are leveraged to unveil intricate connections within the dataset. The research evaluates the effectiveness of the DenseNet201 CNN model and several other machine learning approaches through appropriate metrics, thereby assessing their predictive capabilities and generalization to unfamiliar data. The objective of exploratory investigations is to explore and evaluate the potential benefits of combining feature engineering and dimensionality reduction techniques to enhance model interpretability and overall performance. The study's findings make significant contributions to understanding the complex relationships between chemical and sensory characteristics in red wines. These insights carry practical implications for professionals in viticulture, winemaking, and research in this field. Furthermore, the research underscores and utilizes the adaptability of machine learning in deciphering patterns within intricate datasets, opening avenues for further exploration in the realm of wine quality analysis.

articleTitle: Traffic Signal Detection System for Autonomous Vehicles in Abnormal Environmental Conditions
abstract: This paper presents a new autonomous driving vehicle capable of detecting traffic signals in abnormal environmental conditions. The system uses advanced machine learning algorithms and CNN to accurately identify and interpret traffic signals in challenging conditions, such as poor lighting, rain, or fog. The authors demonstrate the system's effectiveness and robustness in various real-world scenarios through extensive testing and evaluation. The paper comprehensively analyzes the system's performance, including its ability to detect traffic signals in abnormal environmental conditions and adapt to the environment. The study shows how technology plays a vital role in the safety and efficiency of autonomous vehicles and helps advance the development of autonomous driving technology.

articleTitle: PI Sliding Mode Control and Active Control Based Stabilization Scheme for a Chaotic System Having Single Stable Equilibrium and its Circuit Implementation
abstract: This paper presents Sliding Mode Control (SMC) and Active Control technique for stabilizing a new three-dimensional chaotic system characterized by a single stable equilibrium. Appropriate Proportional-Integral (PI) switching surfaces are selected for designing sliding mode controllers, such that the sliding motion occurs and stabilization of the system is ensured. Lyapunov stability theory is utilized to design and guarantee the stability of switching surfaces and controllers. Additionally, analog circuit design and simulation are conducted in MULTISIM, using off-the-shelf analog components. Numerical simulations using MATLAB have been conducted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed stabilization strategies and their corresponding circuits.

articleTitle: Enhancing Workforce Diversity: Leveraging Diversity and Inclusivity Dashboards in HR Practices
abstract: The goal of the paper is to increase workforce diversity by implementing diversity and inclusion dashboards into HR procedures. It emphasizes how crucial diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) strategies are to creating a productive workforce and promotes the use of appropriate metrics to gauge their efficacy. The advantages of implementing a DEI dashboard are highlighted, with a focus on how it can enhance hiring, retention, and recruiting procedures as well as promote equitable treatment of staff members and a diverse workforce. It also emphasizes how important it is to foster an inclusive culture that welcomes a diverse workforce, pointing out the advantages in terms of innovation, brand perception, and customer satisfaction. It is stressed that businesses must incorporate DEI into all HR procedures, such as workforce planning, performance management, and talent acquisition. The advantages of HR dashboards as people analytics tools are explored, allowing businesses to use workforce data to achieve significant business goals. The paper offers suggestions for creating HR dashboards, inclusion of machine learning for a holistic approach, and utilizing a variety of visuals.

articleTitle: Integrating Keyframe Extraction and MoveNet Thunder for Robust Video Pose Estimation and Classification
abstract: This paper introduces a new method to improve the efficiency of video pose estimation, including keyframe extraction, convolutional neural networks (CNN), and the MoveNet Thunder model. Keyframes, which are central images capturing important movements, undergo extensive processing by a CNN to extract complex pose features. Joint integration with MoveNet Thunder significantly increases the system's ability to recognize complex posture-related features. Our experiments, including different architectures such as ResNet-50, HRNet, and DenseNet121, highlight the effectiveness of the proposed approach. We achieved promising results with accuracies of 97.23%, 96.34%, and 94.06% for ResNet-50, HRNet, and DenseNet121, respectively, highlighting the adaptability of the model in a variety of scenarios. In particular, the model is trained and evaluated based on the UCF101 dataset, highlighting its real-world applicability. The fusion of keyframe extraction, CNN, and MoveNet Thunder creates a powerful framework for accurate and context-rich video pose estimation and classification, promising significant advances in a variety of real-world applications.

articleTitle: Smart Industrial Load Switching
abstract: Smart industrial load switching enables the efficient control and management of electrical loads in industrial settings. The system aims to enable efficient control, monitoring, and automation of industrial loads. It involves the use of intelligent switching devices that can automatically turn equipment on and off based on load factors. A prototype is created and demonstrates an overload scenario using loads as bulbs. When the load is excessive, it promptly switches off, and the data is updated on the server in a matter of seconds. The authorities are keeping an eye on this and can take appropriate action. The paper highlights the significance of software and IoT in revolutionizing industrial load management for enhanced efficiency and sustainability. The integration with IoT enables real-time data collection, analysis, and decision-making capabilities, leading to improved load balancing, predictive maintenance, and overall productivity. In addition, smart load switching can improve the reliability and safety of industrial equipment by reducing the risk of overloading and power surges. It can also help extend the lifespan of equipment by minimizing wear and tear caused by unnecessary use. In industries where there are flammable gases, conventional switches that generate sparks pose a risk to human life. Hence, replacing them with a safer and smarter system is necessary. Currently, touchscreen-based switches are being used, but they still require human interference. To eliminate the risk of human exposure to hazardous environments, this is to automate the system, and remove the need for a person to be present at the location. Overall, smart industrial load switching offers significant benefits to industries in terms of energy efficiency, sustainability, and operational efficiency. Its adoption is likely to increase in the coming years as more industries prioritize sustainable practices and seek ways to reduce their energy costs and environmental impact.

articleTitle: EcoSense: A GSM-Enabled IoT Solution for Intelligent Waste Management
abstract: Waste management is a major problem on a global scale. We often observe that the trash cans that are placed in public spaces are full. This pollutes people's surroundings. To prevent such things, we have introduced a project called “A GSM-Enabled IoT Solution for Intelligent Waste Management”. These bins come with inexpensive built-in technology that makes it easy to keep track of how much trash is inside. The amount of waste can accumulate in each bin, when it reaches the edge or threshold level, an automatic alarm will be sent to the registered range through the GSM module, indicating that the waste value has reached the threshold value of about 5 cm nearby ultrasonic sensor. Have a unique ID to help identify its location and current status. The relevant authorities will receive this information and with their help, urgent steps can be taken to clean up the rubbish in the bin. The garbage monitoring system is a new invention that uses ultrasonic sensors to detect and show the amount of garbage in a regular trash can and sends a message to the relevant department manager who updates the status of the trash through a GSM modem.

articleTitle: Pesticide Usage Forecasting for Agriculture Using Prophet Model
abstract: Agriculture plays a vital role in our day-to-day life for the life sustenance of not just human beings but also various domestic and livestock animals. In addition to this, agriculture also contributes significantly to the economy of a country, impacting its growth across the globe. India had always been an agriculture-dominated country before the companies from the West started investing in India. But alongside agriculture come various challenges such as infestation by insects or weeds which eventually lead to the damage of crops and even diseases. But pesticides can even contribute to the contamination of soil, water, and other vegetation in areas where they are been used. In this paper, we have used the Prophet model to study the use of pesticides and analyze the trends of usage of organic pesticides over inorganic pesticides.

articleTitle: Predicting the Red Wine Quality using Exploratory Data Analysis and VGG19 Convolutional Neural Network in Deep Learning
abstract: The quality of red wine is a multifaceted characteristic influenced by various chemical components. This study adopts a dual approach, integrating Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) and the VGG19 CNN Model from Deep Learning to anticipate red wine quality. The dataset encompasses diverse chemical features such as acidity, alcohol concentration, volatile acidity, and quality ratings. Utilizing histograms, scatter plots, and correlation matrices, the distribution and interplay of variables are clarified. Subsequently, the robust VGG19 CNN Model is employed to categorize red wines into quality groups. Trained on a subset of the dataset, the model estimates the likelihood of wines falling into distinct quality categories using a binary classification approach. The dataset is divided into training and testing sets for model training and evaluation. Model performance is assessed through metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. Feature selection techniques are applied to identify key chemical properties influencing wine quality. The acquired VGG19 CNN model serves as a valuable interpretive tool, allowing an examination of the relative importance of each factor through coefficient analysis. A comprehensive understanding of chemical constituents is pivotal for enhancing wine production processes, empowering producers to optimize quality and meet customer expectations.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence Factors of Green Building Energy Consumption Based on the Apriori Algorithm
abstract: Energy consumption analysis is crucial in green construction, but it has a problem with incorrect performance placement. The usual Clustering analysis technique is incapable of addressing the phase limit problem in green construction, resulting in unsatisfactory results. As a consequence, an Apriori algorithm-based analysis of the elements affecting green building energy consumption is offered, and the analysis of the factors influencing green building energy consumption is evaluated. To begin, the common item set theory is used to identify the influencing variables, and the indicators are divided depending on the demands of the analysis of energy consumption to reduce interference factors in the analysis of energy consumption. The frequent item set theory is then used to develop an Apriori algorithm analysis of energy consumption scheme, and the results of the energy consumption analysis are extensively investigated. According to the MATLAB simulation findings, the Apriori algorithm beats the traditional Clustering analysis method in terms of analysis of energy consumption accuracy and time of influencing factors under specific evaluation settings.

articleTitle: Single Layer Multi Band U-Slot Patch Antenna Modeling and Analysis
abstract: The capacity to support various frequency bands inside a single compact design has drawn significant attention to multi-band Patch antennas in U-slots supporting numerous bands in the wireless communication field; this research explores the examination and prediction of these signals to understand their performance characteristics and potential applications. The frequency range in which a single-band U-slot patch antenna is intended to operate is specified. Its U-shaped slotted compact design improves radiation characteristics and bandwidth. Because the U-slot lessens cross-polarization, it can be used for a variety of communication applications. It is a well-liked option for applications with space restrictions because of its performance and versatility. With the ability to function efficiently in two different frequency bands, an antenna featuring an antenna with a dual-band U-slot patch is adaptable and reasonably priced for applications requiring multi-frequency capabilities. In addition to supporting a variety of wireless standards, this antenna can eliminate the need for additional antennas, saving money on installation and equipment. It is frequently used in gadgets like Wi-Fi routers and cellphones for dual-band communication, improving connectivity possibilities and spectrum efficiency. Its tiny size makes it well-suited for applications with space constraints. Compared to its dual-band counterpart, a triple-band U-slot patch antenna has an extra frequency band for greater compatibility and versatility. Applications that need to communicate in three different frequency ranges can use this antenna, which supports a greater variety of wireless standards and services. Combining several frequency bands into a single antenna, lowers the complexity and expense of the equipment and simplifies system design. Its small size makes it perfect for modern wireless devices and communication systems with a variety of frequency needs, especially in spaces where space is at a premium.

articleTitle: Improve Performance of the Grid Connected Induction Motor Under Unbalanced Voltage Sags with ANFIS-Based Floating DC Link Converter
abstract: This manuscript presents the modeling of a floating DC link capacitor as a series compensator for operating a grid-connected induction motor. In conventional three-phase H-bridge converter's voltage sag compensation, the converters can produce high-frequency harmonics and further, it leads to electromagnetic interference (EMI) during switching action. For EMI mitigation filter circuits are required to comply with regulatory standards. The proposed floating DC link converter topology allows the same functionality of the three-phase VSC series compensation with an optimum number of components and low-frequency harmonics. In the proposed method additional power supply, injecting transformers, and power filters are not required to mitigate the EMI effect. Energy-minimized compensation (EMC) technique is employed to regulate a floating DC link converter that operates floating capacitors in charging and discharging modes. For effective switching operation of the floating converter circuit, an Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) is developed. The proposed ANFIS controller for a floating DC link capacitor power converter is a sophisticated approach to voltage sag mitigation. This involves combining ANFIS, a type of artificial intelligence, with power electronics to optimize the control strategy for voltage sag compensation. Simulation study performed on three-phase Induction motor. The proposed ANFIS-based floating DC link converter was well operated during voltage sag conditions and maintained induction motor torque and speed at constant and obtained optimum THD in grid currents.

articleTitle: Product Authenticity: A Blockchain-Based Solution
abstract: The field of supply chain management has long grappled with problems regarding redundancy in services, lack of coordination among various industries, and a lack of standardization, mainly due to the inherent lack of transparency. Nowadays, the proliferation of synthetic products is a rampant issue, making it incredibly challenging to distinguish a genuine item from a counterfeit one through visual inspection alone. Counterfeit goods present substantial challenges for legitimate businesses, yet the full extent of their impact on brands often remains underestimated by the public. Over time, many methods have been devised to combat the problem of product counterfeiting, including popular techniques like tags, A. I., and bar code-based systems. However, each of these approaches has its limitations, such as the vulnerability of QR codes to copying and placement on fake products, or the resource-intensive nature of artificial intelligence, which relies on complex computational power. The central idea is to enhance the detection of counterfeit products by effectively tracing its entire logistics network. This can be achieved through the application of blockchain technology, which ensures the tracking of authentic products throughout the entire network. A Blockchain systems decentralize data access, allowing multiple parties to access it simultaneously. A key advantage of this technology is that the registered data is exceptionally resistant to alteration without the unanimous consent involved, making it highly secure and protected against vulnerabilities. In summary, this paper presents a system designed using blockchain technology to improve the detection of synthetic products by providing a comprehensive and secure means of tracking their journey through the logistics network.

articleTitle: SupplyB: Revolutionizing Supply Chain with Blockchain Transparency
abstract: Through the seamless integration of manufacturers, retailers, and customers through blockchain technology, SupplyB is a decentralized application (dApp) revolutionizing the supply chain industry. Manufacturers and retailers can register on the platform, customers can use cryptocurrency to place and prioritize orders, and manufacturers can request raw materials based on preorders. All of these features enable efficient communication and transactions. Smart contracts manage safe and automated payment settlements, and the transparent workflow guarantees constant information on order status. The frontend design utilizes Tailwind CSS, prioritizing responsiveness, customization, and modularity to improve user experience in this cutting-edge blockchain-powered supply chain environment.

articleTitle: Low Power Approximate Ternary Multiplier Architecture for Image Processing Applications
abstract: Approximate computing is a developing technology that seeks to significantly enhance the speed, and power usage in image processing applications, particularly in cases where exact precision isn't necessary. This paper presents an energy-efficient approximate ternary full adder with CNTFET technology, which is used in the reduction stage in the implementation of a 6x6 approximate ternary multiplier. The proposed ternary full adder design has better performance than most of the existing designs in terms of speed and power, which exhibits an improvement in power upto 40%. The proposed approximate 6x6 multiplier design has power savage up to 51.76%. Further to verify the effectiveness of the proposed multiplier, it is validated in image processing applications.

articleTitle: Understanding the Influence of Deep Learning on Mitigating Leaf Diseases: A Bibliometric Analysis
abstract: Plant diseases that affect the leaves represent a substantial risk to the production of agriculture all over the globe. In the topic of leaf disease management, the purpose of this bibliometric study is to offer a thorough picture of research trends, citation patterns, important keywords, and crucial papers. In order to construct a complete collection of publications relating to leaf diseases that were published over the course of the last several decades, a methodical methodology that included exploring the SCOPUS database was used. The study consists of both co-occurrence analysis of keywords and citation networks, which are used to discover prominent publications and authors. Additionally, the analysis highlights developing trends and main areas of research. The geographical distribution of research is also investigated in this study, with the goal of identifying regional concentrations and collaborative efforts in the fight against leaf diseases. This bibliometric study presents significant insights into the development of research, crucial contributions, and future directions in the fight against leaf diseases. This provides researchers, practitioners, and policymakers in the agricultural sector with vital assistance.

articleTitle: Improving the Efficiency of Solar Panel by Using PCM's and TEG's Influence
abstract: Utilizing of photovoltaic cells innovation has been intensified quickly. So the effectiveness and the strategies to control it are in still awesome interest. So, by introducing the thermoelectric generators (TEG) and stage changing materials (PCM) have been nursing within the final a long time. PCM anticipates the framework from warming and retains the warm vitality. TEGs assimilate that warm vitality and changes over it into power. In this try we have sent a PV/T-TEG-PCM with two stage changing materials with metallic warm exchange enhancers and a normal PV/T-TEG were introduced. Comes about have appeared that the PV/T-TEG-PCM with two PCMs has higher positioning with 84.9% and diminish in sun oriented cell temperature by 1.2%.

articleTitle: An Efficient Network Attack Detection System Using Recurrent Neural Network Models
abstract: This study addresses the escalating complexity of cyber threats through the application of deep learning models and time series visualization, aiming to enhance the efficiency of network attack detection. To establish robust defense mechanisms, we develop a predictive framework utilizing neural networks. This framework incorporates a unique structure that synergizes long short-term memory (LSTM) and recurrent neural networks (RNN s) to effectively handle sequential data, leading to the identification of potential threats. Diverse datasets, encompassing network traffic patterns, system vulnerabilities, and historical attack data, are employed to train the models. The developed framework achieves an impressive 99 % accuracy in attack detection, emphasizing its effectiveness in ensuring cybersecurity. Furthermore, our approach integrates model predictions with visual representations of network activity, augmenting overall de-tection accuracy. Performance evaluations are conducted across various attack scenarios and network configurations, contributing to a comprehensive understanding of the model's capabilities and practical implications.

articleTitle: Precision Agricultural Classification of Indian Turnip Varieties: CNN and Naive Bayes Methodologies
abstract: This study uses picture-identifying Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Naive Bayes models to tell three big Indian turnip kinds apart - Pusa Swarnima, Purple Top White Globe, and Snowball. It focuses on different things they look like. The study uses about 10,500 high-quality pictures taken by the researcher to look at ways of identifying different types of images. The CNN design made for sorting different types of turnips did very well. It was 96.95% right overall in what it could do. Measuring success by looking at accuracy, recall and F1-score shows how well the model finds small differences between types of turnips. A good comparison chart shows that the CNN model is better than other methods for correctly sorting different types of turnips. While showing great results, know there might be problems with picture quality and surroundings that can limit what's possible. Ideas for things to do in the future are expanding data collection with various environments and using transfer learning. This helps improve model flexibility. This study shows how the CNN model helps farming by choosing turnip kinds accurately. This is good for saving plant diversity and improving ways of growing crops in India.

articleTitle: A Deep-Learning Model Based on Channel and Spatial Attention for Cervical Fractures Prediction Using CT Images
abstract: Traumatic cervical spine vertebrae injuries are dangerous and require accurate and quick diagnosis for treatment. The majority of cervical spinal cord injuries, 56%, are cervical spine fractures, which increase trauma patient morbidity and death. Given the importance of this healthcare environment medical issue, our research suggests the CNN with Channel and Spatial Attention-based solution. The neural network architecture of the proposed model is designed to identify cervical spine fractures in CT images. To enhance cervical fracture predictions, this model uses channel and spatial attention processes in a Convolutional neural network to focus on key features and spatial areas in pictures. It had 99.50% accuracy, 99.50% precision, and 97.25% recall on a large dataset of 4200 CT scans from Kaggle. A low loss function of 0.075% highlights the model's amazing learning ability. The model method, which emphasizes attention mechanisms, advances medical imaging and fracture detection, improving cervical spine injury diagnosis.

articleTitle: A Fine-Tuned YOLOv5 and Exception Model for Oral Cancer Detection
abstract: Oral cancer remains a significant concern in public health, and early diagnosis is vital for adequate intervention. In this study, we present a dual-model approach of oral cancer detection via two methods—the Xception model and the YOLOv5 model. This dataset has pictures on oral lesions categorized into malignant and benign. Xception model is known for efficient feature representation, and this oral cancer detection shows promising results with 96.73% accuracy of this model at epoch 30 showing sufficient power to differentiate between malignant vs benign cases. Getting closer to an impressive accuracy of 97.84% at epoch preferably by the Xception model as training. Similarly, YOLOv5 is a powerful object detection model that harnesses its power to detect and classify lesions in images. YOLOv5 model gets an accuracy of 76.54% on epoch 38. It is to be noted that as you train YOLOv5, it shows significant improvement and by epoch 38 reaches an accuracy of 85.44<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>. Comparative study reveals that the Xception model is more accurate than YOLOv5 across all stages of training and testing epochs. The Xception model outperforms consistently and continually, indicating the potential to diagnose between malignant or benign oral lesions. These outcomes highlight the need to use appropriate models for specific medical imaging tasks, and it is shown that Xception serves as a reliable model candidate when diagnosing oral cancer. This study offers important information regarding utilization of deep learning models for oral cancer detection, revealing minor distinctions in effectiveness between the Xception and YOLOv5 architectures. The yielded results in terms of the accuracies achieved at different epochs provide a detailed understanding about how these models learn and thus whether they can help clinicians diagnose oral cancer early enough and with great accuracy.

articleTitle: Harnessing Natural Entity Recognition for Intuitive Spreadsheet Control: A Voice-Driven Google Sheets Extension
abstract: This paper introduces an innovative Voice-Controlled Google Sheets Extension employing Natural Language Processing (NLP) capabilities. The system seamlessly integrates a Chrome extension and a meticulously trained Named Entity Recognition (NER) model. Trained on custom datasets, the NER model proficiently extracts crucial entities, such as command types, cell references, and values from user speech, enabling accurate interpretation of complex commands. The extension enhances user interaction with spreadsheets, offering a voice-driven interface that simplifies spreadsheet management. The backend, utilizing Flask-based REST APIs, facilitates seamless communication with the Google Sheets API, ensuring precise execution of actions dictated by the interpreted commands. Experimental results underscore the system's accuracy and efficiency, establishing its potential as an intelligent productivity tool. This research contributes to the evolution of smart computing interfaces, providing users with an intuitive and accessible means of interacting with spreadsheet applications.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Safety Supervision System of University Laboratories Based on Internet of Things Technology
abstract: The optimal design of safety supervision system is critical in university laboratories, however it has an issue with erroneous performance positioning. The typical Bee colony algorithm is unable to address the optimization design issue in university laboratories, and the result is insufficient. As a result, a Internet of things technology-based this paper proposes the optimal design of the safety supervision system of university laboratories is provided, and the indicators is divided according to the requirements of the optimization is assessed. To begin, the network communication theory is used to discover the influencing elements, and the indicators are split based on the optimal design of safety supervision system's needs to decrease interference factors in the optimal design of safety supervision system. The network communication theory is then used to create a Internet of things technology optimal design of safety supervision system scheme, and the outcomes of the optimal design of safety supervision system are thoroughly examined. The MATLAB simulation results reveal that, under particular evaluation conditions, the Internet of things technology outperforms the standard Bee colony algorithm in terms of optimal design of safety supervision system accuracy and time of influencing variables.

Author Keywords: Optimal design of safety supervision system;Security supervision system

articleTitle: Leaf Diseases Detection using Android Kotlin App with Deep Learning Algorithm
abstract: An Android app is being created using Kotlin to support the agricultural industry. Leaf issues might be brought on by a shortage of nutrients, fungi, diseases, or insects. The most typical bacterial, fungal, and viral diseases. To ddetermine the characteristics of the disease spot quantitatively in accordance with its colour, texture, shape, and other elements. We will find and recognize leaf disease using Deep Learning (DL) approaches. One of the techniques employed in this study to detect leaf disease is deep convolutional neural networks (Deep-CNN) with a pre-trained DL model called ResNet-50. Images are categorized using the TensorFlow image classification model. All of these parameters have been taken into consideration when developing a deep-CNN-based disease detection model for leaves using Keras. The ResNet-50 model then processes the testing data set using the validation parameters it has learned. We may take a leaf image from the camera and choose it from the gallery to use as input for the software, which will then determine what kind of ailment the leaf has as well as whether it is healthy or not.

articleTitle: Design of Automatic Path Follower Robot Using Matlab
abstract: A differential drive robot can follow trajectories that combine straight travel with in-place turning primitive with ease. In this study, a predetermined regular geometrical path composed of these primitives is presented, together with trajectory monitoring and control of differential drive robots. To steer the robot along various paths, a control algorithm was created. The algorithm receives input from the user via a user interface where the user can choose the trajectory type, the dimensions of the tracking speed and trajectory. To determine the course the robot tracked, simulations were run using commercial software MATLAB, Release 2010, is available. Tests were carried out to monitor regular paths, and the outcomes of these tests showed a strong correlation with the outcomes of the simulation.

articleTitle: Glaucoma Detection through Synergistic Combination of Image Processing and Deep CNN using MATLAB
abstract: This study introduces an innovative Glaucoma detection framework that significantly outperforms existing methodologies by employing a hybrid approach combining advanced image processing and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). The key to our approach is the precise segmentation of the optic cup using state-of-the-art image processing algorithms, which allows the CNN to accurately identify glaucomatous changes from retinal images. Our Glaucoma detection method had 95.45% sensitivity, 93.59% specificity, and 94.44% accuracy, surpassing other contemporary techniques such as the SVM Classifier, which showed an accuracy of 90%, and a Convolutional Neural Network approach by other researchers with an accuracy of 91.52%. These results affirm the potential of our method as a highly reliable tool for early Glaucoma diagnosis in clinical practice, promoting better patient outcomes through earlier treatment interventions. This study introduces an opportunity for enhancing glaucoma screening and early treatments through using of MATLAB software.

Author Keywords: retinal image database. Neural network with convolution

articleTitle: Integrating Convolutional Neural Networks and Random Forest for Accurate Grading of Rice Spot Disease Severity
abstract: Rice Spot disease is known to cause a severe problem that not only affects yield quality and quantity but also poses a considerable challenge to rice farmers all over the world. The traditional method which uses eyesight visual attribution intuitively all time-consuming, subjective, and often inaccurate. This study presents the initial implementation of a novel hybrid model integrating convolutional neural network (CNN) and Random Forest algorithm that may serve to effectively evaluate the spot disease severity grade on the target with high accuracy. The proposed methodology involves gathering exhaustive data, meticulous preprocessing, and the integration of a CNN into a feature-extracting process as well as classification, that applies Random Forest, as a solution to the issue brought about by the existing diagnostic approaches. Applying the method to a varied dataset verges a 95.83% precision rate, clearly beat as well as landline model. Moreover, this model competes at the rank of state-of-the-art. This effort in the first place provides an effective tool for precision agriculture and then could serve as a precedent to contribute to the wider acceptance of artificial intelligence in crop disease management. The achievement of the hybrid system evidences the fact that ML technologies can cause a ‘revolution’ in the agriculture field through the shift to scale and effective solutions to the critical challenges of food security.

articleTitle: Optimized Power Control in Off-Grid DC Microgrids with Hybrid Energy Storage Solutions
abstract: This study focuses on how solar cells, wind turbines, and battery charging and discharging help manage power across multiple sources on the grid. In order to maintain the necessary voltage in the PV block, we have connected the inverter to convert the solar DC supply to an AC supply, and we have also linked the load to the inverter. The battery block's bidirectional DC-DC converter is utilized to both boost and buck the voltage. Controlling charging and discharging is done via the PI controller. A permanent magnet synchronous machine was attached to the turbine block, and the microgrid was connected to it after a rectifier was developed to change the output AC voltage into DC voltage.

articleTitle: Bayesian Ridge Regression for Power System Fault Localization
abstract: A power system consists of numerous components making it very complex. The likelihood of a fault occurring in any of these components is considerable. Should a fault arise in key elements such as insulation, transformers, transmission, or distribution lines, it may result in a disruption of power supply to consumers. Thus, it is a must to diagnose the fault timely and find the exact location of the fault. In the presented paper Bayesian Ridge Regression has been proposed for exact fault location estimation. Bayesian ridge regression has been reported to perform excellent for datasets with multicollinearity. Thus, on initial inspection, it was found that the power system's three-phase voltage and current data have a high degree of correlation among them. Hence Bayesian ridge regression has been investigated for fault localization performance of transmission lines in comparison to other regression models. The results demonstrate that Bayesian ridge regression outperformed other models for IEEE 9 Bus system fault localization.

articleTitle: A Novel Light Weight CNN Model for Brain Tumor Classification
abstract: This research explores the dynamic landscape of medical image analysis, with a specific emphasis on leveraging ad-vancements in machine learning. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), recognized for their prowess in image classification, are at the forefront of this exploration. The project centers on the implementation of the MobileNet architecture, a lightweight CNN variant. The primary objective is to classify Brain MRI images into two pivotal categories: the identification of a brain tumor and the absence of a brain tumor. Striking a crucial balance between model efficiency and accuracy, this study emphasizes the development of a lightweight model that is arround 14mb, we have compressed the model size with the same accuracy of 99% that maximizes computational efficiency. This research aims to contribute to the evolving intersection of medical imaging and machine learning, offering potential insights for enhanced diagnostic capabilities in brain tumor detection.

articleTitle: Harnessing ML Methodologies to Forecast TEC and Classify Ionospheric Scintillations
abstract: Ionospheric scintillation, a common occurrence in equatorial, polar, and auroral regions, poses challenges to Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) performance. Over the past two decades, GNSS Radio Occultation (RO) plays a vital role in supplying top-tier atmospheric data that seamlessly integrates with Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP) models and contributes to Meteorological research. However, scintillations impact measurements in satellite-to-satellite GNSS-RO geometry, impacted by solar flares, seasons, geomagnetic activity, geographical positions, and local time. These disturbances introduce errors in positioning and degrade GNSS performance, making detection vital for accuracy. Traditional algorithms often lack sensitivity, especially in identifying strong scintillation due to its sporadic nature, resulting in imbalances in datasets. To address this, we employed diverse machine learning algorithms to detect varying degrees of ionospheric scintillation, aiming to improve accuracy by rectifying dataset imbalances. The article explores Total Electron Content (TEC) and Ionospheric Phase Scintillation identification, TEC prediction using regressors like Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), Decision Tree Regressor, and Random Forest Regressor, and ionospheric phase scintillation classification using classifiers like Support Vector Machines (SVM), Decision Tree, and Random Forest. The comprehensive comparative analysis evaluates regressors and classifiers using standard metrics such as Mean Squared Error, R2 Score, Accuracy, Recall, Precision, F1 score, and confusion matrix.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Green Building Landscape Space Environment Based on Niche Genetic Algorithm
abstract: In view of the limitations of traditional image recognition algorithms in the optimal design of green building landscape space environment, a landscape space environment optimization design scheme based on niche genetic algorithm was proposed. Firstly, the influencing factors were accurately located through the adaptive degree theory, and the indicators were reasonably divided to reduce the interference, and the niche genetic algorithm was used to construct the optimal design scheme of landscape spatial environment. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the proposed scheme is superior to the traditional image recognition algorithm in terms of the accuracy of landscape space environment optimization design and the processing time of influencing factors, and has obvious advantages. Landscape space environment optimization design plays an extremely important role in the green building landscape, which can accurately predict and optimize the growth characteristics and product generation of the green building landscape. However, traditional image recognition algorithms have certain limitations in solving space environment simulation problems, especially when dealing with complex problems. In this paper, this paper proposes an optimal design scheme of landscape spatial environment based on niche genetic algorithm to better solve this problem. In this scheme, the influencing factors were accurately located through the adaptive degree theory, so as to determine the division of indicators, and the niche genetic algorithm was used to construct the scheme. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the accuracy and speed of the scheme is significantly improved for different problems, and it has better performance. Therefore, the simulation scheme based on niche genetic algorithm can better solve the limitations of traditional image recognition algorithms and improve the simulation accuracy and efficiency in the optimal design of green building landscape spatial environment.

articleTitle: Fettle: Unveiling a Personalized Nutritional Odyssey through Cutting-Edge AI and Data Integration
abstract: Fettle revolutionizes personalized nutrition through cutting-edge AI and integrated data solutions, offering a unique culinary journey transcending generic recommendations and data fragmentation. Driven by advanced machine learning and data fusion, Fettle tailors an unparalleled experience, considering individuals' distinct palates, genetic makeup, and health goals. Utilizing deep learning and natural language processing, Fettle decodes taste preferences intricately, providing personalized recommendations beyond fundamental food analysis. Incorporating Polygenic Risk Scores for genetic considerations, Fettle empowers users to make informed dietary choices aligned with their DNA. Prioritizing privacy with federated learning, Fettle marks a paradigm shift in customized nutrition, seamlessly bridging the gap between taste and health. It envisions a future where personalized nutrition is not just a concept but a delectable and empowering reality for all.

articleTitle: Based on Deep Learning of Foreign Language Translation Robot Automatic Question and Answer Retrieval Study
abstract: The role of automatic question answer retrieval in foreign language translation robots is very important, but there is the problem of inaccurate result evaluation. The TF-IDF algorithm cannot solve the automatic question answering retrieval problem in foreign language translation robots, and the retrieval is unreasonable. Therefore, this paper proposes a deep learning method for automatic question answering retrieval and analysis of innovation and entrepreneurship. Firstly, the theory is used to evaluate scientists, and the indicators are divided according to the requirements of automatic question and answer retrieval to reduce automatic question and answer retrieval in the interfering factor. Then, the automatic question and answer retrieval scheme of the foreign language translation robot is formed in theory, and the automatic question and answer retrieval results are synthesized Analyze. Science sins simulation shows that deep learning for foreign language translation robots under certain evaluation criteria. The accuracy of automatic question answering retrieval and the retrieval time of automatic question answer are better than TF-IDF algorithm.

articleTitle: Integration of Machine Learning Algorithms for Predictive Maintenance in IoT-Enabled Smart Safety Helmets
abstract: This paper focuses on the combination of ML algorithms for predictive maintenance through Internet of Things (IoT)-based smart safety helmets in order to increase not only the level of safety operations and but as well equipment life in industrial settings. We study the present helmet technologies and reveal the weaknesses by tomorrow foreseeing technologies which exist in current predictive maintenance strategies. Proposing a new technique, ML algorithms suite is applied as an analyzing tool to collected data from sensors within the helmets. The system architecture is real-time data processed by an IoT framework to predict and act on maintenance needs up front. The results of the experimental validation confirm the implementation of our approach, that shows the significant increase of the predictive accuracy and timeliness as compared to the traditional methods. The research has not only enabaled to create smart safety equipment but also a scalable approach that could be maximized across other Internet of things applications.

articleTitle: A Deep Dive into Precision Horticulture: Unravelling Olive Peacock Spot Intensity with Hybrid Deep Learning
abstract: The old olive tree, a big part of farming around the world is constantly facing problems from an unknown sickness called Olive Peacock Spot. This disease comes from a hard-to-find fungus named Spilocaea oleagina. Our research is focusing on this problem and we are introducing a new way to manage illness through something called Olive Peacock Spot Intensity Analysis. Our way of doing things is special because it uses a new mixed model for deep learning. This includes layers that find patterns (Convolutional Neural Networks or CNN) and another system to figure out past predictions using two related values in math, known as Logistic Regression. This amazing invention is strongly supported by a carefully made collection of 26000 pictures. These pictures show all types and places where the special mark called olive peacock spots can be seen among many kinds of plants or countries' land areas. Our main goal in our study is to help improve exact farming methods like picking and monitoring diseases on plants. We want people involved with this problem to have a smart computer system that can figure out how bad diseases are. The hybrid model's great all-around correctness shows how good it is at using olive peacock spot strength numbers as it resulted in an overall accuracy of 99.29%. These help us figure out things accurately throughout complex tasks. A tough side-by-side check says our mix model is a front-runner in finding out diseases surpass traditional methods of identifying options that have a longer lifespan and have unfavorable outcomes. This study emphasizes the significance of employing an alternative model. It possesses the ability to provide comprehensive and accurate information through several means, hence greatly aiding in the complete comprehension of various subjects. Confusion matrices, which display visual representations of data, assessing the accuracy of a model.

articleTitle: EmoAI: Artificial Intelligence in the Realm of Emotion Recognition with the CNN-SVM Model
abstract: The abstract of the research article includes an in-depth analysis of emotion recognition using the CNN-SVM hybrid model. In particular, the study conducts a detailed analysis of five classes of emotions and utilizes various performance measures that allow the results to be accurately quantified. The presented model accuracy through precision, recall and F1-score for each class shows an overall high score. The accuracy is 88.75, the sensitivity is 0.13, and the F-score is.24 The Class 2 performance can be described as follows: the accuracy is 89.49%, sensitivity = 0.9365, and F1-score = 09245. Class 3 model utilizes an accuracy of 91.19%, recall at the level of 90.40% and F-Measure score in terms resumed to be equal to. Class 4 is quite good with precision at 91.41%, recall of the one-time advantage being ninety-three point six, and f-scores are calculated to be ninety-two point five two per cent. Class 5 shows excellent precision with a rate of 95.93%, recall at 92.32% and an F1-score worth noting for having reached a value of ninety-four point ten per cent (76). The overall accuracy of the model is a whopping 91.610%. The mean overall values for accuracy, recall, and F1-score are 91.37% and 91.55%. These scores are obtained by assigning the same weight to all classes in the given dataset regardless of their population. The weighted averages, which consider the uneven distribution of courses by assigning different weights to each class, are as follows: Accuracy was 91.66, recall -91.60. The micro average represents the aggregate measurement of all classes, with a fixed score value of 91.61 for each measure mentioned above.

articleTitle: Exploring Various Government Health Schemes and the Use of AI in the Changing Dynamics of India
abstract: Artificial intelligence refers to computer systems or devices that can learn and become better at doing tasks by mimicking human intellect. There are many places where AI is being put to good use, from hospitals and clinics to research facilities and labs. Management of treatment and examinations are essential to AI's use in medicine. The success of AI systems in healthcare is due to the creation of complex algorithms that can pull valuable information from vast amounts of healthcare data. Auto-learning capabilities may be added to the algorithms to boost efficiency and precision. Artificial intelligence technologies provide doctors with sophisticated medical information from journals, clinical papers, and textbooks for quick patient treatment. AI has the potential to reduce human error in both diagnosis and treatment. Medical data, especially that relating to patients, may be used for the learning process. Biomarkers, NLP, expert systems based on rules, and physical robots are all examples of forms of AI that have applications in healthcare. Treatment planning, illness tracking, diagnostic help, and patient monitoring are all areas where AI has been useful. This paper attempts to demonstrate the importance of AI in healthcare by looking at the different technologies used in India's Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) and Ayushman Bharat health protection schemes to improve the quality of care and patient satisfaction. In India, proper health screening is one of the most important things. So, learning how AI will affect healthcare services, professional practice, and infrastructure is essential.

articleTitle: Hybrid CNN-RNN Modelling for Precisely Classifying the Seriousness of Mustard White Rust Disease at Five Levels
abstract: Mustard white rust disease is a severe threat to the cultivation of mustard plants, influencing quality and yield. This study developed a hybrid Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) model to predict Mustard white rust disease severity in five predefined levels. A dataset of about 12000 captured and chosen myself was carefully arranged; it contained the ratio for training, validation, and test sets as grouped below. The overall accuracy of 95.45%, shows considerable strength in identifying differences between stages of different diseases. Changes in performance metrics, accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score refined understanding of the model's strong points. It indicated high degrees of precision but some small limitations concerning recall; most notably due to frequent incidence among samples lacking disease characteristics. Analyzing the confusion matrix showed that although one of the model's advantages was predicting true positives, it sometimes had problems identifying severe disease. The study points to the model's potential and offers ways for its future refinement, including making it more sensitive, especially about severe forms of disease expression. In summary, the hybrid CNN-RNN model exhibits potential for Mustard white rust disease severity assessment. With this methodology in place, agricultural productivity can be improved and foster targeted disease management strategies.

articleTitle: Cervical Cancer Diagnostics Using Machine Learning Algorithms
abstract: A rising number of people and businesses are using Deep Learning (DL) and Machine Learning (ML) to analyze vast volumes of data and provide insights that can be put to use. In medical practice, it is becoming more and more usual to use machine learning methods to predict major illnesses such as cancer, kidney failure, and heart attacks in their early stages. One of the most common illnesses affecting for women is cervical cancer, which may be prevented with an early diagnosis. As a result, this work considers suitable ML algorithms to detect cervical cancer. Predictive Model Selection (PMS), data preprocessing, are performed for the chosen dataset. A variety of traditional machine learning techniques, such as Decision Trees (DT), Logistic Regression (LR), Support Vector Machines (SVM), adaptive boosting, gradient boosting, random forest, K-Nearest Neighbors algorithm (KNN), and XG-Boost, are tested and reported in the PMS section. Regarding the prognosis of cervical cancer. In this work trained the dataset on three models, VGG16, Inception-v3, ResNet-50, and also developed and analyzed the performance of Ensemble model.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive AI-ML Study on Enhanced Classification of Benign and Malignant Cells in Brain MRI
abstract: AI-ML integration into medical diagnostics will revolutionize the way cellular formations in brain MRI are recognized and classified. This research article focuses on the creation and validation of highly-sophisticated AI-ML models specifically designed to accurately distinguish between benign and malignant cells within MRIs of the brain, with an intention of contributing to the early detection and treatment strategies for brain tumors. The work starts with an AI-ML framework that is based on deep learning and convolutional neural networks, which is used to analyze brain MRI data with high accuracy. This approach is constructed to recognize minor trends and differences suggestive of cancers and is quite accurate in its detection. Validation on a set of huge MRI scans of the brain shows that the model outperforms current diagnostic methods for many metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. Data handling, model training as well as ethical challenges are explored in detail which reveals the complexity of implementation of AI-ML in the medical imaging area. The proposed model is integrated into existing clinical workflow which in turn gives it a place in assisting diagnosis and decision making by the healthcare workers. The results emphasize the effect of AI-ML technologies on the improvement of the accuracy and the speed of the targeting of brain cells in MRI scans. The presented research shows that AI-ML has a high potential to improve the diagnostic process and therefore increases the patient care outcomes in neuro-oncology.

articleTitle: Utilizing TFLite and Machine Learning for the Early Detection of Mango Leaf Disease: An Automated Flutter Application
abstract: The mango, one of the most important tropical fruits in the world economically, is constantly in danger of going extinct due to a number of diseases. In order to achieve optimal production and quality, prompt intervention and efficient management depend on the early and accurate detection of these diseases. Expert visual inspection is a common component of traditional illness diagnosis techniques, although it can be laborious, subjective, and prone to human mistake. In this research work, we applied Machine Learning techniques to create an automated system for detecting mango disease. The application uses a TFLite model, which was trained on a huge set of images of mango leaves with the following classifications: Powdery Mildew, Bacterial Canker, Black Sooty Mold, Cutting Weevil, Die Back, Anthracnose, and Healthy Leaves. The mango leaf disease dataset is obtained from Kaggle with 300 images. We have evaluated the model with 10 epochs and achieved 100% of accuracy.

articleTitle: Hierarchy in Disease Severity Classification in Banana Leaves through the Integration of Convolutional Neural Network and Decision Tree Models
abstract: Accurate and timely identification of banana leaf diseases is very important for effective disease control, because such diseases are some of the most serious threats to agricultural productivity. Banana disease severity classification across six levels (Level 0 to Level 5) using machine learning models is the novel feature of this study. With about 900 collected samples (including images captured for diseases at various stages), and manual annotation done as a rigorous process of preprocessing, customized versions Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) were constructed with Decision Tree. Their ability to differentiate nuanced variations in severity of the disease was demonstrated by models' excellent overall accuracy 96.04%. Balanced classification capabilities of the models were reflected in performance evaluation metrics such as precision, recall and F1-score. Comparative studies showed the developed models to be superior, so that they may become integral parts of early disease detection and intervention in banana cultivation. Though limited in scope, this paper has value for the agricultural sciences. It presents a framework that can accurately classify disease severity and provides basic material upon which more effective crop management strategies may be built or higher yielding standards established.

articleTitle: Advanced Computational Approaches to Gun Detection with CNN-SVM Model
abstract: This study tries to marry Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Support Vector Machine (SVN) techniques to form a very advanced gun identification system. The system's unique feature is that it is designed to see five categories of weapons. This was done by carefully evaluating the validity of the model using various performance parameters tailored according to individual classes, which demonstrated the ability of the model to withstand and its precise nature. The model's performance for Class 1 was as follows: An accuracy of 89.91%, a recall of 88.29%, and an F1-score of 89.09%. In class 2, an accuracy rate of 91.64%, a recall of 91.08%, and a mean value of the F1-score of 91.36% were obtained. The combination of parameters classifying Class 3 was corroborated with an accuracy of 93.84%, a completeness of 94.96%, and an F1-score of 94.40%. The accuracy rate for Class 4 was 96.69%, the recall rate was 95.38%, and the F1 score was 96.03%. The experimental results of class 5 showed excellent precision of 97.70%, recall of 99%, and F1-score of 98.35%. We used the macro, micro, and weighted averages to help us evaluate the performance of all the classes. The macro averages for precision, recall, and F1-score were 93.96, 93.74, and 93.85%, respectively. It should be noted that the weighted averaged results showed firm persuasion with the accuracy, precision, and F scores of 1-94.90%,94.92%, and 94.91%, respectively. With subsequent micro-averages, accuracy, recall, and over-equal scores, they remained at 94.92%, reflecting the model's consistent performance in all classes. Our model performed interestingly, with a total system accuracy value of 94.9185%. The results highlight the accuracy achieved in perceiving guns in these CNN-SVM hybrid models and suggest that such advanced systems may have further benefits for the protection and security of the general population. Our study's robust methodology and impeccable weapon detection achieve optimal results, making it one of the first research trends in weapons detection technology.

articleTitle: Enhanced Magnetic Resonance Imaging for Accurate Classification of Benign and Malignant Brain Cells
abstract: The difficulty in differentiating between the normal and cancerous cells in the brain through the frequent magnetic resonance imaging approaches is one of the major obstacles to realization of diagnostic precision. The presented work reveals a new MRI image processing technology, which includes an original software that contains complex algorithms and trained machine learning models, as the programs that make the images much better than before. Carefully calibrated computer vision dataset which features brain scans is subjected to the well-defined novel approach, whose performance is compared with the traditional MRI methods by calculating multiple metrics such as classification accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, ROC are and so on. This paper is the climax of a deep cognition of various cell types revealed by the newest MRI method which presents a better contrast than the old techniques. Next, the quality in the detection and recognition of the tumour after, comparison of these modalities displays that the modality of higher resolution, the ability to detect the tumour earlier and better. Such technological improvements in MRI machines will enable the surgeons to identify the growth of tumors at the early stages that will lay the right groundwork for the design of personalized treatment plans and also will have positive impact on the lives of the patients. Through this effect, the level of quality followed by MR imaging has been improved as well as arising new alliances between major imaging companies and machine learning technologies. It can be thought as the border - eraser diagnostics and imaging which will obey medical laws. Therefore, it states that the present hypothetical world should be improved while the advanced and proven diagnostics systems should be developed. The daily clinical applications of these advanced MRIs may well be the beginning of a new era in diagnostic oncology, which will be a very important way forward in improving treatment combined with service in this area.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Photovoltaic (PV) Panels Fault Detection Using VGG16 Architecture
abstract: The study is aimed at the urgent need for accurate detection of Photovoltaic (PV) panel faults, using deep learning technology specifically exploiting the architecture of the VGG16 type. The primary task here is to create a strong model that will categorise photovoltaic panel fault images into these six different categories. To achieve this, a training set of 885 images is used and the VGG16 model is trained over 15 epochs with a batch size of 32 and its default learning for learning rate. Mainly through accuracy performance, the effectiveness of the proposed model is evaluated in accurately classifying PV-photovoltaic panel faults. The results show that the proposed VGG16 model achieves an impressive accuracy of 86% in PV-panel fault classification. This study suggests that the model can identify a wide range of fault categories, thereby demonstrating the potential usefulness of this technology in real-world applications for detecting and maintaining faults in photovoltaic panels. The study highlights the benefits of incorporating Deep Learning techniques, particularly the VGG16 architecture, into the IDS sub-project of the Solar Power System. This integration can improve efficiency, and reliability, and facilitate troubleshooting. Property management for renewable energy infrastructure is the natural next step for this research. Opportunities thus arise to improve system performance and guarantee that solar arrays produce optimal energy levels.

articleTitle: Nail Insight: Enhanced Nail Image Analysis for Early Disease Detection
abstract: The human nails serve as vital indicators of overall health, reflecting potential underlying conditions and diseases. Examining their appearance and texture can provide valuable clues to various health disorders, facilitating early diagnosis and prevention. Images depicting these nail conditions were classified using five standard deep Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architectures: Mobile Net, ResNet50, Dense Net, Google Net, Vgg16, and Yolo v8. Upon observing these standard models, the study proposes a fusion model that combines VGG16 and Google Net through concatenation and weighted average methodologies. Across the standard architectures Mobile Net, ResNet50, Dense Net, Google Net, Vgg16, and Yolov8, the accuracies were 38.83%, 67.14%, 88.42 %, 94.95%, 97.50<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, and 92.35%, respectively. The fusion architecture of VGG16 and Google Net using concatenation and weighted concatenation at the feature level yielded accuracies of 88.11 % and 88.17%, respectively. The fusion architecture of VGG16 and Google Net using concatenation and weighted Average at Decision level yielded accuracies of 84.62% and 89.48%, respectively.

articleTitle: Deep Neural Network Model for Improved DDoS Attack Detection in Cloud Environments
abstract: As the prevalence of Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks continues to escalate, safeguarding cloud environments against these threats becomes paramount. This paper introduces a Deep Neural Network (DNN) model designed to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of DDoS attack detection in cloud environments. Leveraging the inherent capabilities of deep learning, the proposed model exhibits improved performance on the widely recognized NSL-KDD dataset. The research findings demonstrate a substantial increase in accuracy, underscoring the efficacy of the DNN model in fortifying the security posture of cloud infrastructures. The escalating frequency and sophistication of Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks pose a substantial threat to the security of cloud environments. In response to this pressing concern, this paper introduces a Deep Neural Network (DNN) model engineered to significantly enhance the accuracy and efficiency of DDoS attack detection in cloud infrastructures. By harnessing the inherent capabilities of deep learning, the proposed model represents a breakthrough in fortifying the security posture of cloud systems. This research employs the widely recognized NSL-KDD dataset, a comprehensive resource for Intrusion Detection System (IDS) evaluation, to evaluate the model's performance. The proposed DNN model transcends conventional methods by autonomously learning intricate patterns within network traffic data, adapting to the evolving landscape of DDoS attacks. The literature survey delves into the vulnerabilities associated with DDoS attacks in cloud environments, emphasizing the need for innovative detection mechanisms. Previous research has underscored the effectiveness of deep learning, particularly DNNs, in addressing complex cybersecurity challenges, positioning them as ideal candidates for enhancing threat detection capabilities.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Grape Plant Leaf Disease Detection - Methods and Challenges
abstract: Grape leaf diseases significantly threaten global viticulture, leading to substantial declines in grape yield. These diseases, attributed to various factors such as bacteria, viruses, fungi, and pests like mealybugs, can propagate through diverse means, including wind, rain, and human activities. They identify symptoms such as leaf spots and yellowing for effective disease management. Current strategies for disease control involve biological agents and chemical pesticides, with challenges arising from the lack of treatment options for certain viral infections like grapevine fan leaf and rupestris stem pitting. This review explores the myriad methods employed for grape leaf disease detection, emphasizing the use of emerging technologies to address these challenges. Integrating IoT (Internet of Things) and image analysis has demonstrated efficacy in disease detection, enabling farmers to make informed decisions promptly. While fungicides prove effective against diseases like downy mildew and powdery mildew, viral infections present persistent challenges. Technological interventions, particularly IoT and image processing, offer promising avenues for identifying grape leaf diseases, providing farmers with timely and valuable information to enhance disease management strategies. The review underscores the importance of continued research and technological innovation to address the complexities of grape leaf diseases and ensure sustainable grape cultivation.

articleTitle: Financial Foresight: Predictive Power of CNN-SVM in Fake Currency Detection Analysis
abstract: The stability of national economies depends on the resilience of their currency verification. This paper conducts a comprehensive analysis of counterfeit detection using the CNN-SVM combined approach. The study classifies the detection into five categories: Optical Analysis, Physical Property Analysis, Chemical Analysis, Sensor-Based Detection and Digital Image Processing. The CNN-SVM model was thoroughly trained and tested using a 6500-picture dataset that included actual cash and counterfeit notes. Consequently, it attained an excellent overall accuracy of 97.2071%. For every class, the accuracy recalls and F1-score of the model were calculated with precision. Five classes were assessed for precision; Class 1 yielded a precision value of 95.48%, while Class 2 attained an estimate levelling on exactly ninety-six and point thirty-seven per cent (%). Furthermore, results obtained in dealing with three to five resulted in seventy-nine per cent (%), eighty per cent (% ), and one hundred. The recall rates also showed a similar trend in Class 3, with a commendable score of 99.14%. The F1 scores, indicative of the model's balanced performance, achieved a maximum value for Class 3, reaching as high as 98.27%, demonstrating its distinctive nature in determining difficult counterfeits from others. The model's performance in different classes was evaluated using macro, micro and weighted averages. So, the macro averages of accuracy recall and F1-score were calculated to be 97.13%, 97.27%, and 96/5, respectively. Specifically, the weighted mean micro averages generally reached 97.21% for everything measured. The results indicate the remarkable ability of CNN-SVM system in detecting fake money, setting a new trend for AI use in

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of various CMOS designs for Signal Processing Applications
abstract: The signal processing module or system in establishing communication needs to be proficient to make it cost and quality-effective and this is possible by forecasting right from the bottom (sub-system) level design. To achieve the intended performance of the module (like IIR filter), the design constraints of the sub-system at its block level need to be explored in terms of area, power, or delay. So, to strengthen the IIR filter the internal blocks (like ADDER, MULTIPLIER, and Delay elements) need to be refined. Circuit topologies like Complementary Metal Oxide Semiconductors (CMOS) serve the purpose to a great extent, because of their low power consumption and robustness, but not in the modern era, as the CMOS for N input logic to realize, we need 2N transistors, which results in large area requirement i.e., the complexity of circuit increases with Fan-in. The alternative for static CMOS design came into the picture i.e., Clocked CMOS logic gates like pseudo, dynamic, and domino logic families. To increase the efficiency of the IIR filter, one can consider the transistor level schematics in the best alternate CMOS logic design style and build an adder, multiplier. Comparing all the alternative CMOS designs such as Pseudo, dynamic, domino, Enhanced NMOS, and depletion NMOS in terms of area, power, and delay. Possible to realize logic using NAND or NOR gates. The NAND gate is the most preferred universal gate because of its superior delay performance.

articleTitle: A Novel Transfer Learning based CNN Model for Wildfire Susceptibility Prediction
abstract: Wildfires are one of the most commonly occurring natural disasters in the world, posing significant threats to ecosystems and human settlements alike. One of the most important risk mitigation strategies is to implement early warning systems by identifying the regions more susceptible to wildfires. The development of remote sensing technologies combined with the increasing success of deep learning algorithms has greatly accelerated the development of such systems. Significant research has been done so far for wildfire detection in ground level imagery using neural network classifiers, but there is a lack of research focusing on satellite imagery. This paper proposes a method of wildfire risk assessment of large land regions focusing on remote sensing satellite imagery. The dataset used consists of 31280 satellite images each of size 350 x 350 pixels in jpg format from the Quebec region and was built using wildfire data from Canada's Open Government Portal website to identify regions where wildfires have occurred, and satellite images of those regions before or during occurrence have been used as the wildfire class in the binary classification. We implemented different CNN based classification models, namely VGG16, ResNet50, Xception and InceptionV3 as well as four VGG-16 based transfer learning models. All the models were simulated on 5640 test images and their performance was compared. Our proposed transfer learning model having a three layered pyramid structure with Batch Normalization and Dropouts yielded the best results, with an accuracy of 0.9650, 0.9715 precision and an F-1 score of 0.9648 outperforming all of the traditional as well as the basic transfer learning models by a notable margin.

articleTitle: Automation of Text Summarization Using Hugging Face NLP
abstract: Within the expansive domain of “Natural Language Processing” (NLP), the task of “text summarization” emerges as a foundational element, playing a pivotal role in distilling relevant information from extensive textual corpora. In the digital age, the importance of efficient summarization becomes increasingly critical, given the overwhelming volume of textual information. This comprehensive study delves into the intricacies of both extractive and abstractive summarization techniques, placing a specific focus on transformer-based models like BERT and GPT.
