These models, celebrated for their remarkable capabilities in context comprehension and coherent summarization, are rigorously evaluated alongside established methods like TF-IDF, TextRank, Sumy, Fine Tuning Transformers, Model-T5, LSTM, greedy, and beam search. The practical implications of text summarization extend across diverse fields, encompassing news stories, academic papers, and social media content, underscoring its broad utility in various domains. This study not only incorporates cutting-edge models but also explores a gamut of evaluation methods to discern the quality of summarization. By intertwining theory and application, this research positions itself at the forefront of evolving summarization approaches, shedding light on the transformative impact on information consumption patterns. The dynamic landscape of summarization methods underscores the need for continuous research and innovation, as technological advancements continue to reshape how individuals access and comprehend information.

articleTitle: Detection of Mental Stress using EEG signals - Alpha, Beta, Theta, and Gamma Bands
abstract: Mental stress, or psychological stress, arises when individuals perceive emotional or psychological strain beyond their coping abilities. Various factors such as personal relationships, work pressure, financial problems, or major life changes, impact both emotional and physical well-being. Electroencephalography (EEG) signals serve as insightful indicators of brain activity, resembling tiny electrical whispers exchanged between brain cells. These brain cells are characterized by EEG patterns such as alpha, beta, theta, and gamma frequency band waves, and offer valuable insights such as frequency analysis, categorization of valence and arousal, and machine learning techniques, into distinct mental states and neural activity. The exploratory data analytics (EDA) techniques using ML methods (KNN, SVM, and RF) on EEG dataset is being performed to analyze mental stress detection. Furthermore, Mean Absolute Error (MAE) scores of the KNN, SVM, and RF models are compared based on the number of folds, which shows that KNN has the lowest MAE of 0.62, compared to SVM scores of 0.83 and RF score of 1.47 respectively. As a result, the KNN model is selected for stress detection due to its superior performance in reducing MAE in both iterations and training data sizes. Furthermore, the study concisely also reviews an existing literature on mental stress detection using EEG signals, highlighting prevalent challenges and research gaps.

Author Keywords: EEG Signals (Alpha, Beta, Gamma and Theta)

articleTitle: Integrative CNN-RF Frameworks for Stratified Human Monkeypox Virus of Severity Assessment
abstract: The paradigm for defining the severity of human monkeypox virus disease is proposed in this research into ten separate stages, which can be mild (1-10%) to severe (91-100%). Developing a prediction model with high accuracy is done by combining convolutional neural networks (CNN) and random forest (RF) classifiers. This model can differentiate accurately among the phases of the illness. The model was trained and validated using a dataset consisting of clinical imaging, and medical specialists classified the dataset by the severity of the condition. Various statistical metrics were employed to evaluate the model's performance over its ten severity levels. The model achieved a macro-average accuracy of 94.91 %, recall of 94.860/0 and an F1-score of, scoring highly balanced results across the classes regardless of their frequency, which resulted in a perfect healthy diversity training based on ensemble models that aggregate all learners from dependent sampling methods where difficulties are added to previously solved cases or tasks overcoming the common The weighted average that takes into account the skew in classification distribution came close to macro-level results, with an accuracy of 9475%, recall = %, and Pros F1-score all standing at %, which establishes the model's performance under different class conditions of balance. The micro average is calculated as overall performance and responded to 94.90% for all three criteria, meaning a stable level of forecasting accuracy in individual predictions. Significantly, the model showed a general 79.62% accuracy, with true positives ranging from the mildest category to its maximum in the most severe one. The highest rate was recorded as high as equal to six hundred and fifty-eight (1: 508). This suggests its capability as a predictive tool for early detection and assessing monkeypox disease levels. Hence, the results imply that applying the physicians' CNN-RF model helps classify and handle patients with Monkeypox.

articleTitle: Stratifying Leaf Disease Impact in Strawberry Agriculture with Federated Learning CNNs
abstract: Rapid diagnosis of crop diseases at the early stages is an essential instrument to build up agriculture adaptability, specifically for developing countries. The present work fails to describe a novel technique for identifying strawberry leaf diseases by implementing Convolutional Neural Network structures in the condition of Federated Learning architecture systems. The problem was divided into four levels of leaf affliction, and a model was trained on four different consumers. Customers and all the local data were used. The models illustrated the range of diseases and patients being accurate. The FL-CNN model manifests excellent results; the accuracy scores vary between 94% and 96%; such an approach is deeply differentiated on disease level. We combined all these individual data studies into a sound model through aggregation by the federated averaging technique. The macro F1-score, accuracy, and recall ranges were between 87.42% and 91.91%, which can be interpreted as a well-balanced model with relatively even performance across the different severity classes that were the case of class imbalances. Through weighted averages, which considered class majority (56%) to class minority (31%), the model performance was exhibited, ranging from 87.38% to 91.84%. The micro averages, an expression of the model's overall accuracy, were composed of many indicators ranging from 87.38% to 91.8%, substantially in line with the weighted averages. Another crucial factor affecting our ability to act on KPIs from the company depended on the federated learning approach, during which we guaranteed the privacy of every customer data at a local level and enabled the integration of local knowledge of our customers to the global scope of the company. Achieving the objectives indicates that the FL-CNN models work for detecting strawberry diseases and are, therefore, scalable in agriculture as they are privacy-protecting technologies.

articleTitle: Channel Attention Based on ResNet-50 Model for Image Classification of DFUs Using CNN
abstract: Diabetic Foot Ulcer (DFU) is one of the leading causes with high imputation rates, foot deformities, and even death. It is an open wound or skin infection that occurs in diabetic patients and leads to the lower limb. Despite preventive measures, DFUs are still a problem for patients and the healthcare system. Due to the rapid increase in DFUs, effective preventive strategies need to be addressed. With respect to the traditional clinical approach, in the present era, Machine Learning (ML) methods such as Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) approaches an essential role in DFU classification and achieving promising results. In this work, a CNN-based ResNet-50 with Channel Attention (CA) Network model is proposed to classify the foot images (healthy and diabetic). CA extracts channel-wise features used in ResNet-50 that employ a 3-layer bottleneck architecture to enhance the model's accuracy. The DFU dataset considered in this work is collected from a Kaggle repository having 1048 images, where 80% of the dataset is used for training and 10% each for testing and validation, respectively. Further, data augmentation is performed on the original dataset to prevent overfitting of the model. In the result analysis, training and validation accuracy attained 93% and 90%, respectively, which shows better performance than other State-Of-The-Art (SOTA) methods.

articleTitle: Image Generation Using AI with Effective Audio Playback System
abstract: This paper presents an innovative approach to image generation and audio playback through the fusion of deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and natural language processing. We propose a system that generates textual captions from images and converts these captions into high-quality audio narratives. The deep CNN model is trained to understand and describe visual content effectively. We then integrate a text-to-speech system to convert these descriptions into audio, ensuring a seamless synchronization with the images. Our experiments demonstrate the system's capability to produce accurate and contextually relevant audio descriptions, enhancing accessibility and user experience for visually impaired individuals. The application of this technology spans across various domains, including digital content accessibility, educational materials, and assistive technology. This paper discusses the methodology, experimental results, challenges, and potential applications, highlighting the significance of this innovative approach in bridging the gap between visual and auditory perception.

articleTitle: IoT Malware Detection: Navigating Challenges in Securing Smart Environment
abstract: This article examines accuracy measurements and how the Random Forest, Boost, and KNN (K-Nearest Neighbors) algorithms use them to identify distinctions between each of the algorithms in detecting malware that was installed on Internet of Things devices. Specifically, the paper focuses on how these metrics are taken into account by the algorithms. By comparison to all of these algorithms, the KNN method stands out as a distinct anomaly. Our research requires us to do a large number of tests and analyze a large amount of data, and the data that we have gathered is understandable in this particular circumstance. If we want to defend smart spaces from harmful behavior, we need to demonstrate how precise we are in this use case by demonstrating how we efficiently distinguish and categorize the malware that is related to the Internet of Things (IoT). According to the findings of our research, these algorithms have both advantages and disadvantages. The resilience and general security of the infrastructure that supports the Internet of Things will, as a result, be improved to some degree, although new threats are always emerging daily.

articleTitle: Precision Medicine in Oncology - Leveraging Machine Learning for Accurate Neoplasm Diagnosis
abstract: The precision medicine in oncology provided a novel era where the patients have better chances of being cured and improved outcomes if they adopted the personalized treatment strategies. The core part of this change is the utilization of the ML (machine learning) algorithms which showcases good specificity as compared to humans in making neoplasm diagnoses. This research paper will be exploring an application of ML approaches within precision medicine area for oncology patients and will be trying to fill-up the gap between big genome data and decision making processes in the clinical area. This work proposes a complete study which investigates the usefulness of several strategies of ML in diagnosis under cancer with the help of the detailed dataset that consists of genomic and clinicological profile of patients. In our study we investigated several types of ML algorithms covering decision trees, neural networks as well as support vector machines. Every algorithm underwent strict test and validation for its diagnostic power to be identified. Our approach inaugurated the use of ROC curves, precision-recall curves, as well as survival analysis to objectively evaluate model performance, along with feature importance rankings which allowed for identification of biomarkers as well as genetic signatures known to be predictive of specific cancer subtypes and treatment responses. ML work is seen to show a substantially higher sensitivity, specificity and accuracy compared to conventional diagnostic methods. Having ML integrated with precision medicine, makes the screening of cancer in early stages and the accurate diagnosis possible. Additionally, it provides the opportunity to devise personal treatment plans depending on the various genetic tumor types. Besides that, the results from survival analysis illustrated that these ML-based prognostic models can be used for accurately forecast patient outcomes. This has an implication of not only better management of existing treatment plan but also to making survival rates more promising.

articleTitle: An Ensemble Based Convolutional Neural Network Modelling for Classifying Medulloblastoma Subtype
abstract: Medulloblastoma a heterogeneous pediatric brain tumor, requires specific subtype identification in order to determine the most effective treatment strategies. To evaluate the accuracy of classification, this study examines state-of-art leading Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), models like ResNet-50, MobileNet, Xception model, ensembles, etc in differentiating between medulloblastoma subtypes using histopathological images. The models undergo rigorous training and fine-tuning using a comprehensive benchmark dataset encompassing a variety of medulloblastoma subtypes. We also employ advanced image pre-processing techniques to optimize feature extraction. Through comparative analyses based on the accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity and precision of each model to uncover their unique strengths and weaknesses, the work identifies the top performing model for medulloblastoma subtypes classification. Then considering unique strengths of these models, we propose an ensemble methodology that combines top performing models for the underlying problem. Through experimentation, our ensemble approach proves to have the highest accuracy in medulloblastoma subtype classification. The combination of ResNet-50's depth, MobileNet's efficiency, and Xception's feature extraction abilities contribute to the ensemble's outstanding performance with 97% of acuuracy and F-score

articleTitle: Insights into Rhubarb Diversity: A Combined CNN-PCA Model for Three Class Categorization
abstract: This research introduces a new way to make it more accurate in figuring out different kinds of rhubarb. It brings together two methods: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Principal Component Analysis (PCA). Rhubarb, with many types available, is sorted in different ways based on what it naturally has. The suggested combined model plans to deal with this complexity by using the good points of CNN for getting features and PCA for reducing size. The way of doing this is by teaching a special kind of computer brain called CNN. It helps to learn details that can be seen in 6,000 pictures of rhubarb. These little and complex patterns are needed to know the differences between Victoria, Crimson Red, and Ruby types when divided up into groups by color or type. This helps show information more quickly. The mixed model combines these improved parts, giving a complete picture of different rhubarb kinds. The tests show that the new method works well. It makes rhubarb sorting more accurate at 97.25% and strong in distinguishing different types of this plant. The mix of CNN and PCA not only makes use of deep learning but also improves the feature space for better understanding. This study helps with how to sort out types of crops. It gives a good way to check rhubarb kinds right away and quickly in real-world use situations.

articleTitle: CAVIaR Crayfish Algorithm Enabled Deep Kronecker Network for Wormhole Attack Mitigation on Network Control System
abstract: Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) is expansively employed in the Network Control System (NCS). Wormhole (WH) attack detection is a burdensome process, specifically over WSN. A distributed passive state of WH attack makes the network extremely challenging to identify. Here, the CAVIaR crayfish algorithm enabled Deep Kronecker Network (CCA-DKN) is introduced for mitigation of WH attack on NCS. Firstly, the WSN model is simulated and routing is executed by Low Energy Adaptive Clustering Hierarchy (LEACH) protocol. Then, three stages namely in-band (IB)- WH detection, out-of-band (OB)-WH detection, and Neighbour Ratio Threshold (NRT) are accomplished for WH detection. After the accomplishment of the NRT stage, the transmission range stage is performed in OB- WH detection. Thereafter, the Packet Delivery Ratio (PDR) and Round Trip Time (RTT) are done on IB- WH detection. Next, the detection of WH attack is performed by ResNeXt-DSAE. Furthermore, ResNeXt-DSAE is designed by combining ResNeXt and Deep Stacked Autoencoder (DSAE). Lastly, attack mitigation is executed, whereupon a percentage of data reduction is carried out by exploiting the Deep Kronecker Network (DKN) and it is trained by the CAVIaR crayfish algorithm (CCA). Furthermore, CCA is an assimilation of Conditional Autoregressive Value at Risk (CAViaR) and Crayfish Optimization Algorithm (COA). Additionally, CCA-DKN achieved high PDR and throughput of 0.769 and 0.533Mbps as well as low delay of 0.712sec.

Author Keywords: Low Energy Adaptive Clustering Hierarchy (LEACH) protocol

articleTitle: An Adaptive Learning Method for Sign Language Detection
abstract: Advancements in hand gesture recognition technology are transforming the way we interact with computers, manipulate objects in virtual worlds, and communicate using hand gestures. In this paper, we present a system that leverages the combined power of Media Pipe's holistic model and machine learning to achieve real-time hand gesture recognition with remarkable accuracy and efficiency. The pre-trained machine learning model is employed to classify detected hand gestures, providing a robust framework for gesture recognition. The system operates live, capturing video frames from your camera. Using Media Pipe's magic, it pinpoints key points on your hands, creating a digital map of their position and configuration. Detected hand landmarks are visually overlaid on the video frames, enhancing user understanding and system transparency. This information is then fed into a pre-trained machine learning model, a master of decoding hand movements, which instantly deciphers the gesture you're making. Like a secret code translator, it converts this gesture into a corresponding label, transforming your hand movements into meaningful commands or words.

Author Keywords: Media Pipe Real-time machine learning and system transparency Digital Map

articleTitle: A Privacy Protection Application of Consumer Personal Information Based on an Improved K-Anonymity Algorithm
abstract: In view of the limitations of the traditional Data mining algorithm in consumer personal information privacy protection application, a research scheme of personal information privacy protection application based on K-Anonymous algorithm was proposed. Firstly, the influencing factors is accurately located through Differential privacy dispensing theories, and the indicators is reasonably divided to reduce interference, and the K-Anonymous algorithm is used to construct a research scheme for personal information privacy protection application. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the proposed scheme is superior to the traditional Data mining algorithm in terms of research accuracy and processing time of influencing factors of personal information privacy protection application, and has obvious advantages. The research of personal information privacy protection application plays an extremely important role in customer, which can accurately predict and optimize the growth characteristics and product generation of customer. However, the traditional Data mining algorithm has some limitations in solving the problem of information privacy protection simulation, especially when dealing with complex problems. In this paper, this paper proposes a research scheme of personal information privacy protection application based on K-Anonymous algorithm to better solve this problem. The scheme accurately locates the influencing factors through Differential privacy dispensing theories, so as to determine the division of indicators, and uses the K-Anonymous algorithm to construct the scheme. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the accuracy and speed of the scheme is significantly improved for different problems, and it has better performance. Therefore, the simulation scheme based on K-Anonymous algorithm in consumer personal information privacy protection application can better solve the limitations of traditional Data mining algorithm and improve the simulation accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Empowering a Violence Prevention with CNN-SVM based Classification
abstract: This research study comprehensively investigates the violence categorization using a hybrid Convolutional Neural Network-Support Vector Machine (CNN-SVM) model for five violence classes. We aim to create a model that can precisely and correctly discriminate between physical, verbal, psychological, sexual, and property violence. The model achieved class-specific accuracy measures from 89.38% to 95.28%, recall rates from 85.98% to 97.66%, and F1 scores from 90.02% to 95.35% as per the experimental results. A high accuracy of 92.6559% indicates the model's resilience. We employed multiple averaging methods to evaluate the general performance of the model. The macro averages of the accuracy, recall, and F1-score were 92.65%, 92.85%, and 92.69%, respectively, indicating similar performance across classes independent of classimbalance. The accuracy, recall, and F1-score of 92.74%, 92.66%, and 92.63%, respectively, were calculated considering the support of each class. This method provides a more comprehensive assessment of the model's performance since it thinks the number of samples in each class. Accuracy, recall, and F1-score micro averages were always at 92.66%, which indicates the model's ability to classify violence well, irrespective of class distribution. The measurements show that the CNN-SVM method effectively classifies complex, multi-class violent images. This study improves the research area for automated content moderation and monitoring by offering a detailed analysis of recognizing violent content in various settings and media.

articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Personal Care Robot Assistant for Hospital Medication Delivery
abstract: In recent times, the role of robotics in healthcare has emerged as a focal point of medical research, especially in the realm of disease management and control. The primary objective of this research is to protect medical staff and doctors, who play a critical role in patient care, from the hazards associated with infectious diseases by reducing direct human interaction within hospital settings, focusing on essential tasks such as cleaning, sterilization, and operational support. This personal care robot navigation system, designed for hospital environments, features a core robotic vehicle with 4-wheel drive for effortless navigation. The proposed system uses a dual-stage facial recognition process, initial detection by HAAR Cascade Classifier for rapid face detection, followed by the Local Binary Patterns Histograms (LBPH) method for face recognition ensures a high level of accuracy in patient identification. The key functionalities of this robotic assistant include live video surveillance via a camera module, and health monitoring facilitated by non-invasive sensors capable of measuring temperature, heartbeat, and oxygen levels. The system also features a critical safety feature—an emergency switch for immediate halting, an LCD display for interaction, voice output for auditory communication, and even a sprinkler mechanism for sanitation purposes. By leveraging remote control through a mobile application and internet connectivity, this robot presents a leap forward in intelligent healthcare automation, ensuring the efficiency of medical operations in the face of infectious disease challenges.

articleTitle: Smart CCTV Video Summarization: A Deep Learning Fusion of YOLO and DeepSORT Algorithms
abstract: Video summarization plays a crucial role in efficiently analyzing vast amounts of CCTV surveillance footage. In this research project, we propose a comprehensive approach that leverages state-of-the-art deep learning algorithms for object detection and tracking to create condensed and informative summaries of surveillance videos. The primary components of our framework include the YOLOv5 model for real-time object detection and the Deep SORT algorithm for robust object tracking. Initially, the YOLOv5 model is employed to detect objects within the CCTV footage, providing accurate bounding boxes and classifying the objects. Subsequently, the output from YOLOv5 is fed into the Deep SORT algorithm, which assigns unique IDs to each detected object and employs a Kalman filter to predict object motion and future coordinates. This predictive capability enables the system to discern moving objects within the video stream effectively. By calculating the difference between predicted and actual coordinates, the Deep SORT algorithm efficiently identifies and tracks moving objects, facilitating the extraction of relevant frames containing dynamic elements. These selected frames are then merged to generate a summarized CCTV surveillance video, highlighting key events and minimizing redundant information. The implementation of this approach has yielded promising results, demonstrating its efficacy in creating concise and meaningful video summaries. The proposed methodology not only enhances the efficiency of video analysis but also contributes to the optimization of storage and bandwidth resources in surveillance systems.

articleTitle: Parkinson's Disease Severity Assessment: A Comparative Study & Interpretability Analysis
abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is a progressive neurological disorder that mainly affects people over the age of sixty. Currently, there is no such cure for PD. However, Treatments are available to help relieve the symptoms related to PD. A rating tool called MDS-UPDRS III is used to gauge the severity and progression and stages of disease severity are measured by the Hoehn and Yahr (NHY) staging system. This study performs a comparative analysis of the effectiveness of various machine learning models such as AdaBoost, XGBoost, Gradient Boosting Classifier (GBC), Decision Trees (DT), K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Logistic regression (LR), and Gaussian Naïve Bayes (GNB) on a dataset containing a variety of PD-related features obtained from 2861 persons. Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) is employed to perform the analysis of the strength of each feature toward the outcome prediction for various classification tasks. It is observed that the AdaBoost classifier delivers superior performance of 93.2% accuracy and 84.2% F1-Score for the dataset.

articleTitle: Image Inpainting using YOLOv8 and LaMa Model
abstract: Image inpainting, a crucial component of computer vision, addresses challenges in image restoration, content cre-ation, and medical imaging. Traditional methods often struggle with complex scenes, prompting the integration of YOLOv8 for precise object detection and LaMa for generative inpainting. YOLOv8 identifies regions for inpainting, enhancing accuracy and speed. LaMa employs a latent space augmentation technique, generating contextually relevant content. The hybrid approach aims to improve inpainting quality and efficiency. In a rapidly evolving digital landscape, image inpainting finds applications in diverse domains. Our paper advances inpainting using YOLOv8 and LaMa, demonstrating superior accuracy and visual quality. Combining YOLOv8 for masking and LaMa for inpainting this paper has achieved some astonishing results.

articleTitle: Improved Potato Disease Classification: Synergy of CNN and SVM Models
abstract: Establishing a model to reliably diagnose potato leaf diseases is a challenging but crucial agricultural technology. The study proposes a robust classification model using CNN and SVM. The table displays the model's high F1-Score, accuracy, and recall across several illness classes. Recall and accuracy scores between 92.86% and 95.17% indicate how effectively the model finds acceptable instances and makes excellent predictions. F1-score, which ranges from 92.99% to 94.85%, indicates the model can distinguish circumstances. It works for 655 to 725 instances of each illness class, according to support figures. Our classifier can discover numerous potato illnesses with 98% accuracy. The wide, weighted, and micro means, which range from 94.24% to 94.26% across categories, further aid the model. The model's sickness detection accuracy and agricultural potential are shown using modern machine learning approaches. This precise model can distinguish healthy leaves from rust, Powdery Scab, Leaf Roll Virus, Late Blight, and Early Dying Syndrome. The model is reliable and constant among parameters, making it useful for potato disease detection. This breakthrough improves precision agriculture by helping farmers identify ill potato crops early. It reduces production costs and promotes environmentally friendly farming. For each illness class, 655–725 instances demonstrate the model's cross-dataset performance. With 98% accuracy, the classification model can identify potato illnesses. Global, weighted, and micro means, which vary from 94.24% to 94.26% depending on the measure, improve the model. Combining contemporary machine learning algorithms illustrates how precise the model can be for identifying diseases and farming. Model performance distinguishes rust, late blight, early blight, leaf roll virus, powdery scab, and early dying syndrome. The model consistently satisfies several variables, making it an excellent potato disease detection tool. This discovery helps us detect potato crop illnesses early and accurately, advancing precision agriculture.

articleTitle: Continuous Non-Invasive Gastric Volume Monitoring Using GMR Sensors and Machine Learning for Gastrointestinal Wellness
abstract: Accurate monitoring of gastric volume is crucial for understanding gastrointestinal (GI) health and optimizing drug therapy. Existing methods lack continuous monitoring capabilities, leading to potential drug dosage errors and adverse effects. We propose a novel method, termed Tunable Gastric Volume (TGV), leveraging Giant Magneto Resistance (GMR) sensors and advanced machine learning algorithms. The TGV method continuously measures gastric volume pre and post-food intake, enabling precise drug dosing based on real-time gastric conditions. Utilizing Tunable Q-factor Wavelet Transform (TQWT), Rational-Dilation Wavelet Transforms (RADWT), and multiple regression techniques, our approach achieves a 93% accuracy compared to laboratory ultrasonic methods. Integrated with Internet of Medical Things (IoMT), this technology promises seamless remote monitoring and personalized care for GI wellness.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Tomato Quality Evaluation: Computer Vision in Maturity Assessment and Disease Detection
abstract: Tomatoes (Solanum lycopersicum) are one of the most widely consumed fruits globally. Fruit maturity and disease estimation is a criticalfactors in determining its quality and marketability. Traditional maturity assessment requires huge labor, slow, subjective, and time-consuming activities. To address these challenges, the agriculture industry is subjected to automation using computer vision models. Accurate prediction of tomato maturity and diseases is important to decide on harvesting time. Several features such as color, shape, texture, and size are considered to predict the different maturity stages of fruits using deep learning and machine learning models. Assessing the maturity level and disease detection in the early stage of tomatoes is crucial. The proposed work explores the application of the VGG16 architecturefor tomato maturity classification and disease detection. The study leverages transfer learning with VGG16focusing on feature extraction and model optimization to achieve accurate classification. The datasets used in this work are self-created using the images that are collected from agricultural farms. The dataset consists of image samples of six different maturity stagesand diseased fruit images. The experiment results in an accuracy range between 95%-99% for six maturity stages of tomatoes and disease prediction resulted in 90%-97% accuracy.

articleTitle: Cotton Detection Using YOLOv5
abstract: Cotton Harvesting has always been a labor-intensive and time-consuming task which involved significant challenges. Manual harvesting resulted in inconsistencies in yield and quality. In traditional systems the cotton blooms could not be detected accurately due to obstruction due to leaves, or detecting the sky instead of the cotton based on features like color, etc. To address this issue Cotton Harvesting Rover implements a robotic system which can detect cotton blooms accurately using computer vision technology. The system autonomously identifies the cotton blooms amongst the fields based on particular features and then picks them using a robotic arm. This study reviews the state-of-the-art deep learning methods for object detection. This review paper will provide a comprehensive study of various deep learning methods which can be useful for automatic detection and various image processing methodologies. Additionally, it offers performance indicators for every technique used, including F-1 score, accuracy, and precision. The climatic condition for cotton productivity in various regions has been discussed. This paper gives a review about the alternative to traditional methods which needed prior knowledge, processing of large data, and reducingdifficulties caused due to computer hardware.

articleTitle: AI Assisted Plant Disease Detection, Crop And Fertilizer Recommendation System
abstract: Agriculture is a cornerstone of India's economy, employing nearly half of its population and contributing significantly to its growth. Understanding the importance of nutrient management for crop productivity is paramount. However, Indian farmers face formidable challenges, including unpredictable irrigation patterns and poor soil quality, often lacking the necessary knowledge and resources for informed decision-making in crop selection and fertilizer use. Crop failures have profound consequences, affecting livelihoods and food security, while also posing risks to the environment. To address these challenges, our research presents an innovative solution in the form of an open-source, user-friendly web application. This application offers support for crop and fertilizer recommendations, a forecast of plant diseases, and an interactive news stream. Additionally, our approach incorporates interpretability techniques to elucidate predictions made by our disease detection model, making it a comprehensive tool for farmers and stakeholders in the agricultural sector. Our research endeavors to provide a practical and efficient solution to enhance crop production, thereby contributing to the sustainable development of India's agriculture and economy.

articleTitle: Cricket's Computational Core: Enhanced Shot Classification with Convolutional Neural Networks And SVM
abstract: In the abstract of the research paper titled “Enhancing Cricket Shot Identification Using the CNN-SVM Approach: In our paper “Five-Class Analysis,” we introduce a novel model that combines the positive features of convolutional neural networks (CNN) and support vector machines (SVM) to detect five different classes of cricket shots: cover drive, cut shot, pull shot, leg glance, and straight drive. The model has been carefully evaluated using a solid set of metrics, allowing the results to reflect good accuracy across all classes: 87.85% in leg shots and 90.433% in pull shots,924 L cut shots, and deep straight drives, respectively. Considering leg glance, this value goes as high as. The macro-averaged scores show that the classification performance is balanced, with precision and recall of 91.77% and F... The weighted averages corrected for class imbalance exhibit an accuracy of 92.64%, a recall of 93.58%, and a score of 92.56%. The micro, which records the total contribution of all classes' accuracy rate, is 92.58% across precision curve recall and F score, displaying consistency to a high level in performance. These statistical values indicate the effectiveness of the CNN-SVM model in classifying complex cricket shots and emphasize its potential as a valuable tool for analytics sports technology.

articleTitle: Fine Grain Image Classification Using Fine-Tuned MobileNet Model
abstract: The paper focuses on the development of an image classifier, which classifies various fine-grained floral images based on their species. Classification of flowers has many advantages in various fields like Science, Medical, Industries etc. By classifying various types of flowers, one can study their characteristics, etiquette, considering to our knowledge of ecosystems and plant life. Our focal point rests upon the image features woven into the pixels. Through various Convolutional neural network models, the work is able to propose an efficient model based on fine-tuned MobileNetv3 architecture and sel-attention mechanismsthat classifies fine-grained flower images into their respective species.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approaches for Enhanced Precision in Crop Yield Prediction
abstract: Accurate crop yield prediction is a vital tool for farmers to make well-informed decisions in the field of agriculture, which Ais crucial for developing economies. The work explores the complex challenges that researchers encounter when predicting crop yields. These challenges are distinguished by dynamic, noisy, non-stationary, and non-linear characteristics found in varied data sets. An in-depth exploration is conducted to understand the various factors that impact crop yield. These factors include changes intemperature, the amount of rainfall, diseases of plants, pests, the use of fertilizer, and the quality of the soil. Furthermore, the study carefully looks at the features used and evaluates the various deep learning techniques and performance measures used in the context of crop yield prediction. The comprehensive investigation advances our understanding of the complexities involved and provides insightful information that will help develop reliable and efficient crop yield forecast models.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach for Mathematical Representation of Parallel Design
abstract: The best software development approaches are encapsulated in design patterns. Parallel design patterns are the patterns used in the development of parallel software. The proposed mathematical representation of design patterns provides better representation and understanding. The hybrid representation of the pattern includes all the key features such as visualization, relationship, class representation, and order specification from the existing languages (i.e., LePUS, ExLePUS, BPSL, and LOTOS) of the design patterns specifically for the parallel design. Furthermore, this proposed parallel design representation incorporates ordering constructs such as sequencing, synchronization, and parallel processing as a unique approach. The proposed pattern representation helps with the structural, behavioral, and collaborative aspects of the parallel design. The mathematical and visual representation of this approach leads to the robust and comprehensive parallel design of the software.

articleTitle: Analysis of Prediction of Pneumonia from Chest X-Ray Images Using CNN and Transfer Learning
abstract: A good design for image classification problems is the CNN architecture you presented, which consists of 5 convolution blocks followed by 4 fully connected layers. From the input X-ray images, the convolutional blocks extract pertinent features, and the fully connected layers assist in determining the final classification based on those learned features. You have integrated various approaches to improve the performance of your model. The inputs to each layer are normalized through batch normalization, which can speed up training and enhance generalization. By removing certain neurons at random during training, dynamic dropout helps avoid overfitting. L2 regularization weight decay and learning rate decay are two efficient strategies for preventing overfitting and enhancing the model's capacity to expand to new data. Popular optimization algorithm Adam optimizer effectively neural network training. For binary classification problems like the diagnosis of pneumonia, the loss function for binary Cross-Entropy is the best option. You can evaluate your model's effectiveness by comparing its performance to that of current methods by conducting experimental investigations on these datasets. Your model performs well as evidenced by accuracy scores of 90.93%, 89.17% for multi-class classification and binary classification. tasks. It's also crucial to take into account potential drawbacks and difficulties, such as data quality, the model's decision-making process's interpretability, and the requirement for ongoing validation and refinement.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-based Threat Detection for DDoS Prevention in SDN-Controlled IoT Networks
abstract: The combination of machine learning (ML) methods with Software-Defined Networking (SDN) is examined to detect Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks. The growing size and sophistication of DDoS attacks is a challenge to conventional defence measures as they continue to pose serious dangers to network infrastructures. SDN-based DDoS detection in practice is explained, including how SDN controllers are deployed to monitor entire networks and how ML models are integrated to continuously monitor and analyse network traffic. The adoption of SDN-based DDoS detection is not without its challenges; these include compatibility with current infrastructure, the choice of suitable ML algorithms, including Support Vector Machine (SVM), Logistic Regression (LR), Random Forest (RF) and K-Nearest Neighbour (KNN) and the requirement for ongoing model training to adjust to changing threats. Beyond just mitigating immediate threats, this integrated approach has the potential to improve network infrastructure resilience generally and lessen the impact of DDoS attacks on vital services. Performance metrics such as recall, accuracy, precision, and F1-score have been applied to these models. The results show that the LR model, with an accuracy rate of 86%, performs better than other models such as SVM, RF and KNN, which have accuracy rates of 71%, 60%, and 65%, respectively, when applied to the UNB CIC-IOT 2023 dataset.

articleTitle: Fake Product Identification System
abstract: The largest issue facing the retail industry today is product counterfeiting. Products that are counterfeit are just poor copies of authentic brands. Various techniques have been implemented to fight product counterfeiting, including RFID tags, machine learning, artificial intelligence, QR code-base systems, and many more. However, these techniques have drawbacks as well. For example, a QR code can be used to distinguish a real product from a fake one, artificial intelligence and machine learning require a lot of processing power to perform tasks, and numerous other techniques have been adopted but no workable solution has yet been created. With the aid of blockchain technology, we have attempted to enhance the detection of counterfeit goods in this project.Our approach involves using a QR code to store the product supply chain at each stage of the product's transaction with a new party. One of the key benefits of blockchain is that once data is recorded in the system, it cannot be changed by anybody, making our data more secure and protected from outside parties. This makes blockchain useful for storing product supply chains since it creates a decentralized system.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Landscape Space Environment Based on Interactive Genetic Algorithm
abstract: In order to solve the challenges of landscape space environment optimization design, in view of the shortcomings of the existing dynamic programming algorithms, this study introduces an innovative spatial environment optimization design method based on interactive genetic algorithm. The new scheme uses the principles of natural selection theory to accurately identify and locate key influencing factors, and accordingly makes a sensible classification of indicators to reduce possible interference. At the same time, using the unique mechanism of interactive genetic algorithm, this scheme cleverly constructs a design strategy for landscape space environment optimization. The empirical results show that the proposed scheme shows significant improvement compisd with the traditional dynamic programming algorithm in terms of the accuracy of the optimal design of the spatial environment and the processing efficiency of key factors, showing its obvious strong advantages. In the landscape landscape, the spatial environment optimization design plays a vital role, which can accurately predict and optimize the growth trend and output results of the landscape spatial environment optimization design. However, in the face of complex simulation tasks, traditional dynamic programming algorithms show some inherent shortcomings, especially when dealing with multi-level challenges, their performance is often unsatisfactory. To overcome this problem, this study introduces a new idea of spatial environment optimization design optimized by interactive genetic algorithm, which accurately controls the influencing parameters through the theory of natural selection, and uses this as a road map for index allocation, and then uses interactive genetic algorithm to innovate and construct a system scheme. The test results clearly point out that in the context of the evaluation criteria, the new scheme has been significantly optimized in terms of accuracy and processing speed for a variety of challenges, showing stronger performance superiority. Therefore, in the process of optimizing the design of landscape space environment, the simulation scheme based on interactive genetic algorithm successfully overcomes the shortcomings of traditional dynamic programming algorithms, and significantly improves the accuracy and operation efficiency of simulation.

articleTitle: State and Parameter Estimation of Nonlinear Systems Using Extended Kalman Filter Based Sensor Fusion Approach
abstract: The primary objective of this paper is to devise and execute sensor fusion employing the Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) for parameter estimation in nonlinear systems. Sensor fusion tackles a data processing challenge where individual measurements from diverse sensors are conducted independently, yet the measured values exhibit correlation due to the system dynamics. Furthermore, these measurements are affected by various types of noise. Leveraging the Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) for sensor fusion enables the extraction of accurate information from imprecise measurements. The study employs the Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) algorithm for sensor fusion in the context of the Lorenz system and the Wilberforce Pendulum. Numerical simulations are conducted to validate the efficacy of the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Decoding Sunflower Downy Mildew: Leveraging Hybrid Deep Learning for Scale Severity Analysis
abstract: Growing sunflowers (Helianthus annuus) is very important in farming around the world. But it faces a big problem from downy mildew - mostly caused by Plasmopara halstedii. This pathogen brings damage to these beautiful flowers' growth and development process where millions all over earth suffer similar conditions just like them as well- known scientists. We need to stop this farming problem. It needs a smart way, so we can quickly find and get rid of sunflower leaf infections from something called downy mildew. This will help us manage the sickness better before it spreads more widely than necessary due to early detection efforts on farm lands known today as crop fields growing certain kinds such cotton etc., where usually grow potatoes only. To meet this need, our research begins a new adventure. It creates a mix of deep learning models that effortlessly uses both Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and AdaBoost to sort different types of downy mildew scales in complex ways. Our main plan is to pick out carefully 3300 big pictures that cover many different areas. We will use these images for study. These photos show the different kinds of downy mildew. They include many types and how it is in various places, which helps us understand more about a disease called Downy mildew. This big data set is not just for fun, but it gets painted on by our mix model. It sees small changes and hard things in photos of tiny bugs on plants that cause disease called downy mildew scales. It is been so accurate it could show correct results 98.16%. This numbers win is not only a big number standard; it shows how well the model really can understand and group soft white mildew spots into about four different levels. These are all bad situations. This careful view of badness levels is very important for farming workers. It lets them make their fixes according to how serious and fast-growing the bug problem might be. Our mix method always beats single CNN and AdaBoost models when comparing different models. Accuracy, remembering, and F1 score measures all show that joining deep learning's power to find features with AdaBoost's help for changing collections works together. This comparison shows our mix model does better. It also makes it clear we need combined ways of dealing with the complications of crops and their diseases problems.

articleTitle: Flutter Technology-Based Hyper-Local E-Commerce Marketing Application
abstract: As the name suggests, Hyper-local focuses on the close-by region/marketplace. Hyper-local delivery is a concept where the delivery service provider concentrates on local (nearby geographical area) customers. A hyper-local business model integrates the offline and online marketplace and optimizes the workflow, increases efficiency, meets customer demand, and improves local business. By developing this app, our goal is to reduce the impact of Covid-19 (Corona Virus) on small-scale businesses and local stores. We aim to provide the local customer with the products they need in a timely and safe manner at their convenience. This application provides local shop owners and business owners an opportunity to expand. We will use a hybrid hyper-local model to reach our goal as it provides both quality assurance and the possibility to scale. Our app will be cross-platform compatible because of the use of the Flutter framework. Flutter is a user-interface software development framework de- developed by googled for developing high-performance applications using Dart as a base programming language.

articleTitle: Secure and Efficient Web Services Recommendations using Data Science Techniques
abstract: Secure and Efficient Web Service Recommendations performance is the breadth and depth of this study. With the goal of recommending services to consumers that are highly relevant to their interests, this study primarily aims to facilitate service consumption for individual usage. In the future, when it comes to service composition, it will be possible to suggest services that connect certain points in a planned process with suitable services. In order to enhance the Web service discovery process, it is possible to conduct a thorough evaluation of Wikipedia's usefulness as a source of semantics. Service quality forecasting in a mobile computing context is complicated and requires attention. The cloud environment can easily accommodate the requested tasks. A cloud provider's implicit and explicit data may be used to find the right services for a company's processes. The relationships between services may also be deduced from the messages exchanged in the cloud. Last but not least, we present and implement a new architectural model for service selection systems that makes use of implicit feedbacks, suggests a CF-based service selection algorithm that takes into account user requirements during the ranking process, and employs the proposed Web service technique, support-based kernel, and enhanced vector-based ranking method. By taking into account the interests of all other users, the suggested model is able to solve the cold start issue for new users and new services. We proposed data science approach (WSDS) allows us to provide a tailored way for predicting the quality of service (QoS) of online services. We create a homomorphic hash-based user verification method and use the Byzantine agreement to weed out untrustworthy individuals. Next, we assess the suggested WSDS on a dataset of actual web services, and we use matrix factorization to improve prediction accuracy. The suggested strategy is much more successful than conventional procedures, according to the experimental findings.

articleTitle: Optimizing Software Effort Estimation Accuracy with a Machine Learning Model
abstract: Accurately estimating the work required for soft-ware development is essential to success in today's fast-growing software business. Erroneous project estimates can result in project failures and overruns, which can have an impact on budgets, schedules, and client satisfaction. This research presents a novel strategy to overcome these obstacles: a heterogeneous en-semble model optimized for software effort estimating accuracy. To capitalize on the advantages of each approach and produce a more reliable estimation model, our suggested model integrates several modeling techniques, such as Use Case Point (U CP), Artificial Neural Network (ANN), and EJ. This method improves the accuracy of software effort estimation by combining multiple feature selection techniques with machine learning algorithms. Data quality evaluation, feature selection, handling of missing values, productivity analysis, and the transformation of nominal data are all included in the technique. UCP, ANN, and EJ algorithms are used to train the ensemble model. Its accuracy and performance are then evaluated and tested against ISBSG datasets. An extensive examination of the methods and techniques used in the heterogeneous ensemble model is given in this study. In the dynamic and demanding software business, we present a promising way to increase the accuracy of software effort estimation greatly by utilizing the diversity of modeling techniques.

articleTitle: Efficient Computing for Immersive VR: Real-Time Panoramic Video Stitching on GPU Platforms
abstract: The growing demand for immersive Virtual Reality (VR) experiences necessitates seamless stitching of panoramic video. VR unlocks the potential for applications like deep-sea exploration and self-driving car visualizations where a real- time first-person perspective is crucial. Existing panoramic video stitching methods face challenges in achieving real-time performance with multiple videos. Most solutions are offline, limiting their applicability. We explore different approaches to video stitching and propose an optimized stitching pipeline utilizing OpenGL, a widely available graphics library, to leverage the superior processing power of GPUs. By employing off-the-shelf GPUs, we aim to make our solution accessible and cost-effective for a broad range of applications. Post-stitching, a stereo vision module enriches depth perception when using VR headgear. Our approach achieves a significant improvement in stitching speed compared to traditional CPU-based methods. By harnessing the power of OpenGL, we observed a remarkable 17x frame rate increase (reaching 450fps with three video streams). The substantial improvement in frame rate paves the way for a new generation of immersive VR experiences with a seamless, real- time first-person view.

articleTitle: Exploring Deep Learning Methods for Diabetic Retinopathy Detection and Classification
abstract: The prevalence of diabetes, a chronic condition influenced by lifestyle factors, has experienced a significant surge across several age cohorts. The incidence of diabetes has exhibited a more pronounced upward trend in underdeveloped and developing nations compared to developed nations. Diabetes has a significant impact on multiple organs inside the human body, including the retina. Diabetic Retinopathy is a diabetic consequence characterized by retinal blood vessel swelling and the development of lesions, resulting in impaired vision in affected individuals. Failure to recognize Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) in its early stages may result in the development of visual impairment or blindness. Fundus images of the retina are examined by ophthalmologists as a component of the manual diagnostic approach for diabetic retinopathy (DR). In contrast to computer-aided diagnostic technology, traditional diagnostic methods are characterized by time-consuming procedures, high costs, and a susceptibility to misdiagnosis. In recent times, deep learning has gained significant prominence as a highly favored approach, demonstrating enhanced performance across several fields, with a notable emphasis on the examination and categorization of medical images. This study provides a comprehensive survey of deep learning techniques employed in the identification and categorization of diabetic retinopathy. Additionally, it examines the several publicly accessible datasets containing retinal fundus images.

articleTitle: Quantifying Stellar Energy Exchange: Image Analysis with OpenCV and Machine Learning
abstract: Stellar energy exchange, fundamental to the dynamics of celestial systems, remains a captivating yet challenging area of study in astronomy. This paper introduces an innovative methodology for quantifying stellar energy exchange through sophisticated image analysis techniques, harnessing the power of OpenCV and machine learning. Our approach integrates OpenCV's robust image processing capabilities with state-of-the-art machine learning algorithms to automate the intricate task of analyzing astronomical images and predicting energy exchange rates within stellar constellations. The methodology begins with the preprocessing of astronomical images using OpenCV, where radiometric and atmospheric corrections are applied to ensure accurate representations of stellar luminance. Subsequently, features relevant to energy exchange dynamics are extracted from the processed images, employing advanced computer vision techniques. These features encapsulate intricate spatial, spectral, and radiometric characteristics of stars, providing rich representations for subsequent analysis. Machine learning algorithms are then employed to predict the energy exchange rates of stars based on the extracted features. Leveraging the power of convolutional neural networks and ensemble learning techniques, our model learns intricate patterns within the data and delivers accurate estimations of energy exchange dynamics. Through extensive experimentation on real astronomical datasets, our approach demonstrates exceptional performance, achieving precise predictions of energy exchange rates across diverse stellar systems.

articleTitle: Transforming Bookstore Dynamics Through Blockchain Integration for Revolutionizing Trust, Transparency and Efficiency
abstract: Blockchain technology has emerged as a transformative and disruptive innovation, revolutionizing traditional systems by offering decentralized, transparent, and secure solutions across various industries and operational landscapes. This research delves into the integration of blockchain technology within bookstore systems, outlining its profound implications. The implementation of a blockchain-based bookstore system revolutionizes transparency, trust, and operational efficiency. It enhances customer confidence by providing an immutable view of inventory, book authenticity, and transaction history. Additionally, the system ensures data integrity and security, reduces costs through smart contracts, and optimizes supply chains, combating counterfeit book issues. However, challenges in technical complexity, scalability, integration, regulatory compliance, costs, user adoption, security, and interoperability exist in its implementation. Solutions proposed involve collaborations, strategic planning, education, security measures, and adherence to regulations. Various models detailing deployment strategies on Sepolia network with different approaches are presented, showcasing the integration of Inter Planetary File System (IPFS) and Pinata Software Development Kit (SDK). The study concludes by emphasizing the importance of meticulous planning, stakeholder engagement, and continuous adaptation for successful blockchain integration in bookstore systems.

articleTitle: Multimodal Information Extraction:A Systematic Review of Subtask, Modal Types and Applications Based on Deep Learning in Banking Sector
abstract: Deep Learning has been widely applied in all application domains namely Healthcare, Entertainment, Banking & finance, Agriculture, Aerospace & defence etc. Due to stupendous achievement of deep learning as a data processing technique has fascinated in all research areas. Handling of Deep learning in Banking and Financial sector is pervasive. Advancement of Information extraction especially because of different formats of information such as text, image, sound, video can be extracted simultaneously by the usage of deep learning techniques. This study reviews and analyses multimodal information extraction based on deep learning techniques especially on banking and financial sector. It aims to enhance the efficiency of document-intensive business tasks in the financial sector. Deep review analysis will be carried out to understand subtasks of Information extraction and techniques involved in Banking domain. Finally, how multimodal information extraction using deep learning enhances the efficiency than unimodal and its use cases in current AI based automation world will be highlighted.

articleTitle: Neural Network-Based Hybrid Recommendation System
abstract: The main goal of this study is to improve the user experience by providing personalized product recommendations based on user preferences and behaviors. The study examines the various methods and frameworks commonly used in e-commerce recommendation processes, including collaborative filtering, content filtering, and using these methods in neural networks system. Additionally, the proposed algorithm solves the “cold start problem” by newly visited users. Results obtained by proposed approach that use popularity-based algorithm to create the initial set of recommendations highlights how effective the system is at providing accurate and relevant recommendations to users, ultimately increasing customer satisfaction and sales conversion rates of supply. These findings and insights contribute to the development of e-commerce recommendation systems, and present possible avenues for future research and development.

articleTitle: Precise Diagnosis of Heart Disease with Stacking Classifier
abstract: Heart disease stands as a significant global health challenge, marked by a worrying rise in prevalence and substantial mortality rates. Despite the wealth of healthcare data, early detection of heart conditions remains elusive. This endeavor aims to address this issue by crafting a predictive model that integrates individual medical histories and lifestyle factors. The proposed methodology centers on the use of a Stacking classifier for heart disease prediction. To gauge the model's efficacy, the Framingham Heart Disease dataset is employed, sourced from the widely recognized Kaggle repository, endorsed by numerous researchers. Evaluation encompasses ensemble model assessments, incorporating critical metrics such as sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, and f-measure. Furthermore, the investigation delves into the application of ensemble methods for forecasting heart disease incidence over a decade, aiming to contribute to more effective strategies for early detection and management. Through the fusion of advanced modeling techniques and comprehensive datasets.

articleTitle: Brain Tumour Detection Using Advance Machine Learning: A Literature Review
abstract: This paper proposes a machine learning-based model for highly accurate detection of brain tumors in magnetic resonance images. A Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is employed for feature extraction and segmentation in the proposed algorithm for brain tumor detection from magnetic resonance images. The dataset for the study has been obtained from an internet website. Brain tumor detection is a critical aspect of medical diagnostics, where early and accurate identification plays a pivotal role in successful treatment. This survey paper explores the transformative impact of advanced machine learning techniques on the field of the brain tumor detection through the analysis of medical images. It looks for to offer a intensive understanding of the most recent strategies and advance in leveraging progressed machine learning calculations to realize heightened effectiveness and exactness within the distinguishing proof of brain tumors.

articleTitle: High-End Approximate Multiplier Using Brent Kung Razor FlipFlop
abstract: In this paper, we proposed the design of an approximate multiplier using Brent Kung Razor flip flop. An approximate multiplier technique is used for low energy consumption and high performance. To satisfy the requirements in the proposed system, the length of carry is selected dynamically. By using a tree compressor, the partial product is optimized. Hence compared to existing multipliers the proposed approximate multiplier using Brent Kung razor flip flop produces effective results in terms of area and delay. The proposed approximate multiplier is synthesized on the Xilinx ISE, EDA Tool.

articleTitle: Detection of Gravitational Waves Using Machine Learning
abstract: Gravitational wave detection has become a land-mark in astrophysics, shedding light on the most dynamic processes in the universe. However, extracting important signals from noisy data is still a challenge. This review explores the use of machine learning techniques, specifically Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), and Random Forests, to improve the accuracy and operation of gravity detection. We perform a comparative analysis of the algorithms in the context of gravitational wave astronomy, evaluating their performance, advantages, and limitations. The results of this investigation lead to an ongoing debate about the best combination of the machine learning techniques to improve gravitational wave signal extraction.

articleTitle: Dynamic Economic Scheduling Problem Based on PSO-BBO Hybrid Optimization Algorithm
abstract: In order to solve the challenge of dynamic economic scheduling problem in financial economy, in view of the shortcomings of the existing machine Xi algorithms, this study introduces an innovative dynamic economic scheduling problem method based on PSO-BBO hybrid optimization algorithm. The new approach leverages the principles of biogeographic distribution theory to accurately identify and locate key influencing factors, and accordingly enables a sensible classification of indicators to reduce potential interference. At the same time, using the unique mechanism of PSO-BBO hybrid optimization algorithm, the design strategy of economic scheduling is cleverly constructed. The empirical results show that the proposed scheme shows a significant improvement compared with the traditional machine Xi algorithm in terms of the accuracy of the dynamic economic scheduling problem and the processing efficiency of key factors, showing its obvious strong advantages. In intelligent finance, the dynamic economic scheduling problem plays a crucial role, which can accurately predict and optimize the growth trend and output results of the dynamic economic scheduling problem of the financial economy. However, in the face of complex simulation tasks, traditional machine Xi algorithms show some inherent shortcomings, especially when dealing with multi-level challenges, their performance is often unsatisfactory. To overcome this problem, this study introduces a new idea of dynamic economic scheduling problem optimized by PSO-BBO hybrid optimization algorithm, and accurately controls the influencing parameters through the bibliographic distribution theory, and uses it as the road map for index allocation, and then uses the PSO-BBO hybrid optimization algorithm to innovate and construct a system scheme. The test results clearly point out that in the context of the evaluation criteria, the new scheme has been significantly optimized in terms of accuracy and processing speed for a variety of challenges, showing stronger performance superiority. Therefore, in the dynamic economic scheduling problem of financial economy, the simulation scheme based on PSO-BBO hybrid optimization algorithm successfully overcomes the shortcomings of traditional machine learning Xi algorithm, and significantly improves the accuracy and operation efficiency of simulation.

articleTitle: Elastic Resource IT Analysis Technology for Distribution Station Area Based on Genetic Optimization Algorithm
abstract: In view of the limitations of the traditional selection and ranking algorithm in the elastic resource IT analysis technology for distribution station area, a flexible resource IT analysis technology scheme based on genetic optimization algorithm was proposed. Firstly, the influencing factors is accurately located through the population optimization theory, and the indicators is reasonably divided to reduce interference, and the genetic optimization algorithm is used to construct the technical scheme of elastic resource IT analysis. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the proposed scheme is superior to the traditional selection and ranking algorithm in terms of the accuracy of elastic resource IT analysis technology and the processing time of influencing factors, and has obvious advantages. The elastic resource IT analysis technology plays an extremely important role in the distribution station area, which can accurately predict and optimize the growth characteristics and product generation of the distribution station area. However, the traditional selection and ranking algorithm has certain limitations in solving the simulation problem of IT analysis, especially when dealing with complex problems. In this paper, this paper proposes a technical scheme for the analysis of elastic resources based on genetic optimization algorithm to better solve this problem. In this scheme, the influencing factors is accurately located through the population optimization theory, so as to determine the division of indicators, and the genetic optimization algorithm is used to construct the scheme. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the accuracy and speed of the scheme is significantly improved for different problems, and it has better performance. Therefore, the simulation scheme based on genetic optimization algorithm can better solve the limitations of the traditional selection and ranking algorithm and improve the simulation accuracy and efficiency in the elastic resource IT analysis technology for the distribution station area.

articleTitle: Transforming Waste, Safegurading Cities: An IoT-Driven Revolution for Smarter and Greener Urban Management
abstract: India, one of the economies that is expanding quickly, faces a rising problem with waste management. The nation generates an astounding 64 million tons of rubbish per year, placing it seventh in the world. Unfortunately, the effects of this waste are becoming more obvious in many communities, where trash is carelessly dumped, and roadways are littered. This haphazard approach not only ruins the aesthetics but also creates serious issues that could lead to dangerous infections. An efficient waste management system that can handle this problem and offer thorough control of trash disposal procedures is urgently required. The purpose of this study is to monitor and track the waste in our surroundings. We suggest using an Internet of Things (IoT)-based solution to accomplish this. This system continuously monitors trashcan fill levels and sends that data to a cloud platform with IoT capabilities for real-time analysis. Automated alarms are sent directly to the municipal corporation when the dustbin is getting close to its maximum capacity, allowing for rapid intervention. In summary, the goal of this project is to use IoT technology to build a proactive and effective waste management system. By doing this, we hope to lessen the issues caused by illegal waste disposal and help India become a cleaner, healthier, and more sustainable country.

articleTitle: Emotion Recognition from Facial Expression Using Deep Learning Model : A Review
abstract: Emotion recognition is a well-known and extensively studied subject having applications in many scientific and busi-ness domains. In order to categorise expressions like happiness, sadness, contempt, surprise, fear, and wrath, it entails extracting facial elements from static facial photos. People communicate non verbally by using their facial expressions to transmit information to one another. It is essential to recognise the emotions on people's faces, and efficient techniques like (MTCNN, SVM, HAAR classifier, SIFT, MLP) are required to do this. This article aims to investigate current approaches for Facial Emotion Recognition (FER), offering an in-depth review of the approaches used by researchers to analyse facial emotions. Due to the variety of methods used to convey resemblance and the impact of the selected dataset like (JAFFE, FER2013, CK+, The Yale Face Database B, LFW) on the outcomes, comparing various facial emotions becomes challenging.

articleTitle: IoT-Driven Predictive Maintenance for Energy-Efficient Industrial Systems
abstract: This research examines the deployment of the internet of things (IoT) technologies for predictive maintenance in industrial facilities in an effort to achieve energy efficiency and ensure the integration of renewable energy sources. Through the application of various IoT sensors and predictive algorithms at different industrial spaces, the study will show what the effect of predictive maintenance on operating costs, equipment life, and energy consumption. The results show that the reduction in downtime and energy expenditure, which, in turn, helps in the optimization of renewable energy usage in favor of environmental sustainability. The study brings to the foreground the practical obstacles, like the privacy of data and system integration problems, and puts forward the measures that would enhance their resolution. Such results support the potency of IoT focused preventive maintenance in constructing a ‘green’, smart and productive industrial sector.

articleTitle: Federated Learning on Blockchain Networks
abstract: This paper contributes to ground-breaking advancement in the ever-expanding realms of federated learning on blockchain data towards analytics for forecasting and predictions using the LSTM deep learning algorithm. An incremental progression is achieved by extracting blockchain blocks and communicating between decentralized blockchains, cloud, and edge networks. One of the key takeaways from the approach fostered in this article is a purpose that pervaded a global federated model with analytics for forecasting's and recommendations across blockchain networks as an endeavor. It is an exceptional experience of connecting vast and dynamic networks to unveil patterns and enhancing explorations to leave an indelible mark of predictions over data with endless possibilities. The driving objective behind the multi-vector push of this work is ensuring gratified recommendations and helping users with fortitude in decision-making and power shift to profits.

articleTitle: User Feedback Module for Women Self Help Group Chatbot for Increased Usability
abstract: The recent advancement in AI and deep learning is revolutionizing various sectors, such as healthcare, education, and entertainment, to name a few. In this work, we explore the use of AI chatbots in rural digital empowerment and how AI chatbots can be utilized for supporting the small-scale businesses of rural self-help group members. The work explores the need for a user feedback module for a multi-lingual chatbot designed for a rural women's self-help group (SHGs) in India. Integration of the user feedback module will further enhance the usability and usefulness of the multi-lingual SHG chatbot. The work also examines the need for increased usefulness of the multi-lingual chatbot for improved adoption in SHGs. The work also emphasizes the need to design software based on the context of use considering the needs and objectives of the user group.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Power Conversion Systems Tailored for Renewable Energy Resources
abstract: Concerns worldwide regarding climate change and the rapid depletion of fossil fuels necessitate immediate action to expedite the production of clean energy through available renewable energy resources (RER). The global proliferation of photovoltaic (PV), wind, fuel cell, and other RER, coupled with their advantages such as low operating costs and enhanced energy security, has resulted in a surge in the integration of RER-based power generation into utility grids. Consequently, optimizing the efficiency of interface inverters becomes paramount for overall efficiency enhancement. Various inverter topologies have been proposed and adopted by PV panels, wind systems, and other renewable sources, each presenting its own set of benefits and drawbacks. These topologies can be broadly categorized into single-stage and two-stage inverters. Addressing the limitations of standard inverters, impedance network inverters aim to harness the advantages of a two-stage system while minimizing the number of power conversions. Bidirectional converters offer the benefits of single-stage conversion along with the capability of voltage boosting. To the best of the authors' knowledge, there is a lack of comprehensive analysis of impedance source inverters and bidirectional converters employed in PV and wind systems, encompassing control methods. This study focuses on following primary research issues to review current topologies. These include: 1) Exploration of different bidirectional converters, impedance network inverters, and dual-leg DC converters; 2) Comparison of control strategies for bidirectional converters, impedance source inverters, and dual-leg DC converters based on their complexity and theoretical performance.
