By putting the class imbalance within medical datasets into consideration, the weighted loss function targets the underrepresented pneumonia cases. By prioritizing these classes during model training, the weighted loss function seeks to give a boost and attention on sensitivity and consider false positives and negatives effectively, thus refining the diagnosis process. Along with this, our study holds the potential of GANs for data augmentation, aiming to almost nullify the impact of data scarcity. By generating synthetic but realistic chest X-ray images, GANs improve the training dataset, leading it to improvement in the model's robustness and generalization. The comparative analysis and study of both the models in enhancing pneumonia detection accuracy, provides critical points into the strengths and limitations of each approach. The outcomes of this comparative assessment not only offer valuable benchmarks for future advancements but also enlighten the way heading towards more reliable and effective pneumonia diagnosis from chest X-ray images.

articleTitle: Voice-Based Automated Detection of Mental Health Considering Comparative Performances of Multiple Machine Learning Models
abstract: Depression and anxiety significantly threaten well- being, with extreme consequences. The rise in mental health conditions needs effective methods of detection and treatment. Machine Learning (ML) based models greatly facilitate various aspects of mental healthcare. This work addresses the effectiveness of the voice and its features in acknowledging mental health states. Voice analysis removes the bias inherent in self- reported psychological assessments. We use multiple spectral and chroma-related features to predict depression and anxiety. Further, forward feature selection, decision tree, and calculation of Fisher's score are performed to enhance the performance of the model and identify the most relevant features like spectral flux (SF), zero crossing rate (ZCR), chroma vector (CV), and standard deviation pitch (SDP). This work uses various ML models, such as support vector machine (SVM), multi-layer perceptron (MLP), XGBoost (XGB), K-nearest neighbour (KNN), decision tree (DT), random forest (RF), logistic regression (LR), AdaBoost (AB), and Naive Bayes (NB), for predicting and finding the model that best fits our data with an accuracy of 97%. From the result, we observe that the extracted voice features serve as markers for mental health conditions such as depression and anxiety and offer in the detection and monitoring of the disorders.

articleTitle: AI Enhanced-Smart Genome Editing: Integration of CRISPR-Cas9 with Artificial Intelligence for Cancer Treatment
abstract: The CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing system is a new technology that allows the modification of secret vital material using disruptions insertions or amendments of DNA sequence. It is an easy, widely accepted, and correct representation of gene modification. The potential for treating different genetic diseases is enormous. This paper discusses the latest approach to CRISPR-Cas9 integration with AI, aimed at improving efficacy, as well as the safety of cancer treatment. This paper highlights the cutting-edge integration of CRISPR- Cas9 with Artificial Intelligence (AI) to enhance the efficacy and safety of cancer treatment. Artificial intelligence is a simulation of human intelligence for computers, indicates the latest developments in the field, and mentions clinical trials' ability to help further the treatment of cancer and overcome current and upcoming challenges. Finally, the application of (AI) in the modification of the CRISPR/Cas9 system is highlighted. Taking case scenarios and futuristic approaches, this paper reveals excellent implementation initiatives by learning from the Clinical revolution together with human technology and aimed at a future in which new technologies improve patient outcomes without sacrificing ethics or putting patients first.

articleTitle: Identification of Counterfeit Goods by Implementing Blockchain Technology
abstract: Counterfeit goods refer to fraudulent or imitation products manufactured and distributed with the aim of misleading consumers into thinking they are acquiring genuine or authentic items. This research paper addresses the challenge of identifying counterfeit goods through the implementation of blockchain technology. Blockchain's inherent features of transparency, immutability, and decentralized consensus provide a robust foundation for building a secure and tamper- resistant system to trace and authenticate products throughout the supply chain. Regarding the idea implementation, a website has been established where the backend or product-related data is stored within the blockchain. Through this platform, administrators have the capability to input product details into the blockchain. Each product is assigned a unique block within the blockchain to accommodate all relevant information. Additionally, a distinctive QR code and product ID are affixed to each product. Customers can access the customer page of the same website to authenticate a product by either entering its Product ID or uploading the QR code. Upon inputting the Product ID or QR code, the website promptly indicates whether the product is genuine or counterfeit. If the product is registered within the blockchain, the website displays its information, confirming its legitimacy. Conversely, if the product is not found within the blockchain, the website identifies it as counterfeit.

articleTitle: Implementation of Hybrid Filtering for the Automatic Recommendations of Web Services
abstract: The fast and flexible exchange of data between people and companies is the responsibility of web services. Web services use the widespread availability of the Internet to connect applications, systems, and resources inside and across businesses, enabling exciting new ways of doing business and fostering relationships with suppliers, customers, and partners all over the world. Data that has been securely fastened into business systems and is accessible only via the use of certain software is made available to them. There is a real risk that sensitive information might be exposed to unauthorised parties while using Web Services, despite their many benefits. Researchers are particularly concerned about the potential security risks associated with Web Services in an appropriation scenario. The most often cited advantages are shorter development times and lower costs, more productivity, more affordable and better customer service, and more code reusability. In this paper we proposed Collaboration filtering and content-based filtering are two examples of state-of-the-art web service recommendation algorithms that we compared with our suggested solution. Compared to traditional methods of collaborative and content-based filtering, the experimental results demonstrate that the suggested hybrid filtering strategy yields superior results.

articleTitle: Optimizing Resource Efficiency in Smart Greenhouses Through IoT
abstract: In the pursuit of sustainable agriculture, smart greenhouses have emerged as a vital solution, enhancing crop productivity while assuring resource conservation. This research delves into the optimization of resource efficiency in smart greenhouses by leveraging the Internet of Things (IoT). Through a comprehensive review of current technologies and methods, the study identifies key challenges and opportunities within the domain. A novel framework is proposed, integrating IoT sensors and actuators to monitor and control the microclimate, ensuring optimal growth conditions while minimizing resource usage. Data from sensor networks are analyzed to predict resource needs, enabling precision farming practices. The framework emphasizes the use of Machine Learning algorithms to enable predictive analytics for resource allocation, ensuring that water, nutrients, and energy are distributed more efficiently. The potential of Lightweight Resource Allocation (LaRA) algorithms is also explored to maintain the delicate balance between maximizing yield and minimizing environmental impact. Ultimately, this research highlights the transformational potential of IoT in creating green, efficient, and productive agricultural practices within smart greenhouses.
